### [1] [Artificiality's First Exam: An LLM-Referenced C-test for Supraintelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14005)
*Jose Hernandez-Orallo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于 Levin's Kt 的新方法来评估大型语言模型 (LLM) 的能力，该方法能够生成比当前人类和前沿模型更难的测试项，从而填补了现有基准的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 AI 基准测试由于其难度是根据人类或当前 AI 系统设定的，容易饱和或变得循环。需要一种新的评估方法来衡量可能超越当前机器和测试设计者能力的 AI。

Method: 利用 Levin's Kt（Kolmogorov 复杂度的可计算变体）的逆问题概念，将 LLM 视为能够利用人类文化知识的通用图灵机 (UTM)。开发了一个生成和认证管道，为 LLM 创建高难度测试项，并考察了参考机器能力和测试者/被测者能力差距的影响。

Result: 成功生成了具有高难度（以比特为单位的比例尺）的测试项，这些测试项的难度超出了人类和现有前沿模型的能力范围。对十二个 LLM 进行了测试，结果显示，随着难度的增加，LLM 的能力曲线下降，进入了一个“超智能窗口”，即我们可以认证难度但超出当前模型能力范围的区域。

Conclusion: 该研究首次提出了基于 Levin's Kt 并利用 LLM 作为表示机器的评估测试。这种方法能够产生可认证的、远超当前能力范围的测试项，为评估未来更强大的 AI 系统提供了一种有前景的途径。

Abstract: Under the accelerated pace of AI development, any benchmark whose difficulty is calibrated with humans or current AI systems becomes circular, or saturates soon. How can we then evaluate machines that may become more capable than the current machines and the people who write the tests? One answer to the question hinges on inverse problems, inductive inference questions for which difficulty depends on the complexity of the underlying mechanism, given the observations and the previous knowledge. Levin's Kt, a computable variant of Kolmogorov complexity, puts a theoretical upper bound to that difficulty, balancing the simplest representation encoding for the mechanism and the logarithm of the time steps to run that mechanism. Previous tests derived from Levin's Kt, such as the original C-test, are based on minimalistic Universal Turing Machines (UTM), capable of very limited representations and no previous knowledge. Reasoning large language models (LLM) are UTMs that capture a compendium of human culture as knowledge, using prompts as natural language programs. This paper presents the first test based on Levin's Kt with LLMs as representational machines. Fresh test items can be produced at high difficulties, estimated in a ratio scale measured in bits, before any human or frontier model can solve them. We formalise the measure, devise a lightweight generation and certification pipeline, explore the effect of the power of the reference machine and the gap between examiner and examinee. We produce a first battery of certified items administered to twelve LLMs. The resulting agent characteristic curves decrease with difficulty, down to the uncharted high-difficulty region, the supra-intelligence window of items we can certify, yet beyond generations of frontier intelligence.

</details>


### [2] [The Silent Failures in Agentic Data Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14115)
*Xue Li,Hongqian Xia,Daniel Gomm,Aécio Santos,Cornelius Wolff,Madelon Hulsebos*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究评估了数据科学代理（agentic DS）在准确性之外的能力，发现它们普遍存在方法论和领域知识上的缺陷，即使在预测性能上表现良好。研究提出了一个全面的评估框架，包括失败模式分析、测试套件和与专家解决方案的定性比较，以促进更可靠的数据科学代理的发展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对数据科学代理的评估仅关注预测性能和代码正确性，忽略了数据科学的核心原则（方法论和领域知识）。这种评估方式掩盖了数据泄露和不当验证等方法论失败，阻碍了强大数据科学代理系统的发展。

Method: 研究采用了三种评估方法：1）对220个数据科学任务中常见数据科学代理框架和模型的失败模式进行大规模分析；2）开发了一个可重用、可扩展的测试套件，包含精心设计的数据科学任务，以可控的方式测试六种特定失败；3）对数据科学代理的流程与Kaggle竞赛中的专家解决方案进行定性评估。

Result: 绝大多数数据科学代理解决方案至少存在一种失败模式，尽管其系统复杂性或模型容量很高。研究发现数据泄露失败的发生与预测性能之间存在正相关，证实了超越准确性进行评估的必要性。定性分析表明，与竞赛获胜的数据科学家相比，数据科学代理在解决问题的创造力和领域知识方面普遍存在不足。

Conclusion: 对数据科学代理进行基于原则的失败模式分析是评估中不可或缺的一部分。本研究提出的见解对于开发值得信赖的数据科学代理流程至关重要，应在评估中引入更全面的指标，超越单纯的准确性。

Abstract: Large language models have significantly lowered the barrier to writing code. Naturally, this has also led to the development of data science agents that promise automating the design and execution of data science from task formulation to model development. Existing evaluations of agentic data science (agentic DS) assess downstream predictive performance and code correctness, providing preliminary insight in agentic DS capabilities. We argue that these evaluations overlook the fundamental principles of data science: methodological data science- and domain knowledge. As such, only assessing downstream performance masks methodological failures such as data leakage and inappropriate validation, limiting the development of robust agentic DS systems. In this paper, we evaluate agentic DS beyond accuracy from three different angles: 1) a large-scale analysis of failure modes in common agentic DS frameworks and models across 220 data science tasks, 2) a reusable and extensible test suite with curated data science tasks that test for six specific failures in a controlled manner, and 3) a qualitative assessment of agentic DS pipelines against expert solutions on Kaggle competitions. We find that the majority of agentic solutions contain at least one failure mode despite the complexity of agentic harness or model capacity. Moreover, we identify a positive correlation between the occurrence of data leakage failures and predictive performance, confirming the necessity to evaluate agents beyond accuracy. Our qualitative analysis shows that DS agents generally lack problem solving creativity and domain knowledge, compared to competition-winning data scientists. We believe that principled failure mode analysis, as presented here, should be integral part of agentic DS evaluations, and that the insights we surface will be key in developing trustworthy agentic DS pipelines.

</details>


### [3] [ClawLoop: Self-Improving Agents via Harness-Native Training Loop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14118)
*Hansi Yang,Linji Hao,Hongyan Hao,An Wang,Han Wu,Qi Gu,Xunliang Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为ClawLoop的框架，用于训练基于LLM的代理，使其能够自主改进。该框架通过任务合成、训练和诊断反馈形成一个自给自足的循环，无需外部教师模型，并能生成高质量的训练数据，即使迁移到小模型也能带来性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM工具使用代理训练方法大多是单次且依赖于教师模型，限制了代理的自学能力和性能提升空间。因此，需要一个能够实现自主改进的框架。

Method: ClawLoop框架包含三个阶段：1. 任务合成：通过两种方法生成多样化任务，并进行条件难度增长和任务验证（有无代理）；2. 训练：使用SFT和/或RL更新代理；3. 诊断与反馈：分析代理行为，生成能力报告，用于指导下一轮任务合成。

Result: 使用Qwen3.6-27B模型进行ClawLoop训练，在SkillsBench、Claw-Eval-Live和ClawGym-Bench基准测试上取得了持续的性能提升。此外，迭代生成的任务数据转移到Qwen3.5-4B和9B等规模较小的模型上，也带来了性能增益，证明了数据质量不依赖于循环模型。

Conclusion: ClawLoop框架成功实现了LLM代理的自学改进，无需外部教师模型，并能生成高质量的训练数据，促进了代理性能的提升，且该数据质量具有迁移性。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has driven their deployment toward general-purpose harness environments, where LLM-based agents operate in sandbox workspaces and interact directly with file systems and shells. While numerous post-training pipelines exist for tool-use agents, their counterparts for harness-based agents remain scarce and are predominantly one-shot and teacher-dependent: a stronger external model synthesizes tasks and collects trajectories, the target agent is trained once, and evaluation results are consumed by human researchers rather than fed back into the loop. Such pipelines are inherently bounded by the capability of the external model and the scope of human prior, leaving no room for self-improvement. To address these limitations, we propose ClawLoop, a framework that enables self-improving without any external teacher model and with minimal prior dependencies. ClawLoop composes three phases into a self-sustaining cycle: Task Synthesis, which generates a diverse pool of training tasks via two complementary construction routines, applies diagnosis-conditioned difficulty growth followed by both agent-free and agent-based task validation; Training, which updates the agent via SFT and/or RL; and Diagnosis and Feedback, which analyzes the agent's rollout behaviors to produce a capability analysis report that will be used as feedback for task synthesis in the next iteration. Using Qwen3.6-27B as the loop model, ClawLoop yields consistent improvements on SkillsBench, Claw-Eval-Live, and ClawGym-Bench. The iteratively refined tasks are further transferred to smaller-scale Qwen3.5-4B and 9B models with gains across all benchmarks, validating data quality independently of the loop model.

</details>


### [4] [Correction Training for Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14136)
*Donghoon Ahn,Runqian Wang,Alexei A. Efros,Taesung Park,Yash Belhe*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于扩散模型的校正步骤，以解决迭代采样中的误差累积问题，该方法通过迭代细化模型的预测来提高样本质量，且推理成本可通过蒸馏进行摊销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在推理过程中，由于输入是基于自身先前不完美的预测构建的，这与训练时仅使用真实图像和噪声的场景不同，导致了“暴露偏差”问题，可能损害样本质量。现有方法如CFG需要额外帮助。

Method: 引入一个校正步骤，该步骤以基础模型（denoiser）的预测为输入，并以相同的真实目标进行训练。在采样过程中，每个去噪步骤都会迭代地精炼模型的干净样本预测。该校正器可以迭代地应用于其自身的输出来获得更好的结果。此外，还可以通过将精炼后的预测蒸馏回基础扩散模型来摊销推理成本。

Result: 所提出的校正方法在DiT、SiT和JiT模型上显著提高了样本质量（FID分数），尤其是在无条件生成方面。该方法在不牺牲多样性的前提下，性能可与CFG相媲美，并且与CFG结合使用时能进一步提高多样性并减少过饱和现象。通过蒸馏，可以在不增加额外推理成本的情况下保持质量提升。

Conclusion: 通过引入一个显式的校正步骤，可以有效减少扩散模型在迭代采样中的训练-推理差距，从而显著提升样本质量，尤其是在无条件生成任务中。该方法易于集成，并可以通过知识蒸馏有效管理推理成本。

Abstract: Iterative sampling in diffusion models can lead to error accumulation due to exposure bias. The denoiser is trained on real images interpolated with noise, but at inference its inputs are constructed from its own imperfect predictions from the earlier steps, something it has never seen at training time. This might be one reason diffusion models often struggle without additional help, such as CFG. We introduce a correction step for diffusion models which attempts to reduce this training-inference gap. The corrector takes the base model's prediction as input and is trained against the same ground-truth target. This makes correction an explicit learning task, with training inputs provided by the base model. During sampling, at each denoising step, we iteratively refine the denoiser's clean-sample prediction. This allows us to correct predictions at intermediate denoising steps, preventing early artifacts from persisting into the final sample. Although the corrector is trained only on predictions from the base denoiser, it can be applied repeatedly to its own outputs at inference for better results. This simple framework leads to substantial improvement in sample quality while largely preserving diversity. We evaluate our method across DiT, SiT, and JiT. Our method substantially improves upon previously reported FID scores for unguided generation and, notably, unconditional generation, where producing high-quality samples without guidance has been particularly challenging. Our method achieves performance competitive with classifier-free guidance (CFG), and combining correction with CFG further improves diversity and reduces oversaturation typical of CFG. Finally, we show that the additional inference cost of correction can be amortized by distilling the refined predictions back into the base diffusion model, retaining the quality gains without additional inference-time overhead.

</details>


### [5] [Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 2.0: Automating Diverse Task Construction and Measuring Sustained Agent Progress](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14146)
*Zongxia Li,Zhongzhi Li,Yucheng Shi,Ruhan Wang,Junyao Yang,Chengsong Huang,Zhichao Liu,Xiyang Wu,Anhao Li,Yue Yu,Ergan Shang,Fuxiao Liu,Tong Zheng,Ninghao Liu,Lichao Sun,Haitao Mi,Leowei Liang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 2.0 (LHTB 2.0)，一个改进和扩展的任务基准，用于评估代理在长时间工作流中的持续进展能力，纠正了先前版本的缺陷，增加了任务数量和评估时长，并引入了更精细的奖励机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需要一种更全面的方法来衡量代理在复杂、长时间任务中的表现，而不仅仅是最终结果。现有基准在任务设计、评估基础设施和评估时长上存在不足，无法充分反映代理在实际长期工作流中的持续进展能力。

Method: 通过系统化的重建任务管道，从现有的科学或工程制品出发，生成新的任务场景。利用参数化参考实现生成多个场景，分离出用于行为证据、评估和训练的任务。使用密集的进度阶梯奖励部分进展，以防止对公开输出的记忆。将评估时长从90分钟延长到3小时，并增加验证器检查点频率，以便直接测量运行过程中的持续进展。

Result: LHTB 2.0 包含 77 个任务。在 1,145 次模型-任务运行中，GPT-6-astra 表现最佳，平均奖励为 0.69；GPT-5.6-sol 紧随其后，平均奖励为 0.67。在 30 个重建任务上，二元验证器分数平均为 0.221，而密集阶梯分数平均为 0.653，表明仅评估最终结果会忽略大量的中间进展。

Conclusion: LHTB 2.0 提供了一个更广泛、更稳健、更关注过程的测试平台，用于研究代理在数小时内的可靠执行能力，并且证明了密集进度奖励比二元结果评估更能准确地衡量代理的真实进展。

Abstract: Long-horizon terminal benchmarks measure whether an agent can sustain progress through extended workflows with process rewards, not only whether its final state passes a binary check. We present Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 2.0 (LHTB 2.0), an extension of Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench that preserves its 46 original tasks while correcting task and evaluation-infrastructure defects and extending 31 tasks. LHTB 2.0 contains 77 tasks across 13 domains and eight task types. The extended tasks are produced through a systematic reconstruction-task pipeline. We start from a working scientific or engineering artifact, then use a parameterized reference implementation to generate multiple scenarios, reveal six as behavioral evidence, hold out three for evaluation, and use dense progress ladders to reward partial progress while preventing memorization of public outputs. We also extend the evaluation horizon from 90 minutes to three hours and record verifier checkpoints every 30 minutes, enabling direct measurement of sustained progress within a run. Across 1,145 scored model-task runs from 15 frontier models, GPT-6-astra leads with dense mean reward 0.69 and 37 tasks at R at least 0.95, followed by GPT-5.6-sol with dense mean reward 0.67 and 32 tasks at the same threshold. On the 30 reconstruction tasks, binary verifier scores average 0.221, whereas dense ladder scores average 0.653, showing that outcome-only evaluation discards substantial intermediate progress. LHTB 2.0 provides a broader, hardened, and process-aware testbed for studying reliable agent execution over hours.

</details>

This framework addresses the gap between AI advances in human medicine and the fragmented state of veterinary AI development.

### [7] [Unconstrained CTI-REALM with Open-Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14180)
*Sahil Garg,Ruhi Gottumukkala,Vishal Agarwal,Shubham Vishwakarma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究发现在CTI-REALM基准测试中，经过充分交互后，开源模型在网络安全任务上的表现可以媲美最强的闭源模型，且成本显著低于闭源模型。此外，通过放松消息限制并评估各阶段的产出，表明应为工作流的不同阶段选择表现最佳的模型，而不是单一的综合评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组织在为安全工作选择语言模型代理时，面临开源模型和闭源模型之间的选择。研究旨在评估哪种类型的模型在网络安全任务上更具成本效益和性能。

Method: 在CTI-REALM基准测试上评估了26个模型（19个开源，7个闭源）。使用共同的测试框架、评分器和LLM评委。分析了基准测试消息限制的影响，并引入了评估代理提交的检测查询执行结果的阶段级指标。

Result: 1. 开源模型在成本不到闭源模型十分之一的情况下，可以匹配最强的闭源模型（在消息数量充足的情况下）。2. 基准测试的消息限制会影响结果，限制下领先的开源和闭源模型难以区分。3. 放宽消息限制后，开源模型表现更优。4. 模型的价格与其能力不成正比，高成本不一定意味着高性能。5. 阶段级指标显示不同模型在工作流的不同阶段表现最佳，建议按阶段选择模型。

Conclusion: 对于网络安全任务，优化的开源模型可以在显著降低成本的情况下实现与顶尖闭源模型相当的性能。应考虑为工作流的不同阶段选择专门的模型，而不是依赖单一的整体评分指标。

Abstract: Organisations that want language-model agents for security work face a choice between open-weight models, which they can run and audit themselves, and far more expensive closed frontier models. We study that choice on CTI-REALM (arXiv:2603.13517), a benchmark in which an agent turns a threat-intelligence report into a working detection by querying a live telemetry store. We evaluate twenty-six models, nineteen open-weight and seven closed, under a common harness, scorer and panel of LLM judges. Our main finding is that an open-weight model can match the strongest closed models at less than a tenth of their cost, provided it is given enough turns. The benchmark's published limit on agent messages is a confound: a task that exhausts the limit scores zero on every checkpoint, including those it had already passed, so results at that limit partly measure which models finish in time. At the published limit the leading open-weight and closed models cannot be distinguished. With the limit relaxed, the models it was truncating recover, and the highest rewards belong to open-weight models. Among the leading models, price is a poor guide to capability: models with similar rewards differ in cost by more than an order of magnitude. Because the benchmark's checkpoint scores largely record what an agent did or mentioned, we also introduce stage-level metrics that score what the agent submits, by executing its detection queries in the telemetry store and judging its outputs against the answer key. Rather than combining them into one more overall reward, we show that different models lead different stages, which suggests routing each stage of the workflow to the model that performs it best rather than choosing a single model by its overall score. We also report how many tokens each model generates, and find that the share of output spent on thinking does not track the reward.

</details>


### [8] [Visualizing the World Model in an Agent's Value Function](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14186)
*Shawheen Naderi,Fatemeh Akherati,Yubei Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究探讨了模型无关强化学习算法（特别是 PPO）是否在学习环境模型。通过反事实干预，我们发现 PPO 智能体的价值函数学习到了关于可收集物品、健康影响和物品栏等方面的概念，即使其训练目标仅为最大化奖励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究的动机是探究模型无关强化学习算法（例如 PPO）在优化奖励的过程中，是否会无意中学习到环境的内在模型，从而能够对环境有更深入的理解。

Method: 研究方法是应用反事实干预。这种干预方式在保持状态其他因素不变的情况下，只针对特定变量进行改变，以此来探索 PPO 智能体的价值函数是否能够形成一个世界模型。

Result: 研究发现，尽管 PPO 智能体只接受了最大化奖励的训练，但其价值函数学习到了关于环境的关键概念，例如：钻石的可收集规则、水和食物对健康的影响，以及关于物品栏管理的启发式规则等。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: Echo是一种4位全归约方法，它在低精度（4位）传输数据，但在高精度下进行求和。通过将注入的误差反馈到后续计算中，Echo能够抵消累积误差，并证明了累积误差在深度上是受界的。

Abstract: Tensor parallelism ends every layer with an all-reduce that sits between two dependent matrix multiplications, so its cost cannot be hidden and grows as compute outpaces interconnect bandwidth. We present Echo, a 4-bit all-reduce for training and inference that controls the accumulated error. Echo moves data in 4 bits and sums in high precision, so each value is quantized at most twice per call for any number of GPUs. The summation reveals each injected error, and Echo feeds it back into later calls, so old errors cancel instead of accumulating. We prove that the accumulated error stays bounded independently of depth. On A100 GPUs, Echo is 2.09x faster than the 16-bit NCCL all-reduce on 1 GB messages. It speeds up the time to first token by up to 1.16x and the training step by up to 1.09x on an idle interconnect, and by up to 1.44x and 1.38x as background traffic grows. It keeps the average accuracy over seven benchmarks within 0.4 points of 16-bit inference on Qwen3-8B. In 10B-token pretraining, its final loss is less than 0.9% above that of 16-bit training. </details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的流匹配模型在推理时面临约束采样的问题，即如何在满足硬性终端约束的同时，最小化与预训练轨迹的偏差并最大化奖励。

Method: 将约束采样问题建模为最优控制问题，采用递进视界控制策略，并结合递进视界对偶算法求解。同时提出一种终端估计变体，以减少截断误差。

Result: ConicFlow在低维和高维实验中均取得了高奖励和良好的约束满足度，同时减少了与预训练流的偏差。理论上，该方法在标准正则性假设下提供了次优性保证，在凸仿射结构下给出了更紧密的界。

Conclusion: ConicFlow能够有效地解决流匹配模型中的约束采样问题，在满足硬性约束的同时，保持生成样本的高质量和低轨迹偏差。

Abstract: We propose ConicFlow, which frames constrained sampling from a flow matching model at inference time as an optimal control problem that balances deviation from the pretrained trajectory against reward, subject to hard terminal constraints. We discretize this problem and adapt receding-horizon control, optimizing only a short window of the trajectory at each step for computational tractability. We address the resulting sequence of receding-horizon subproblems with a receding-horizon primal-dual algorithm. Its dual multipliers capture the difficulty of satisfying each constraint and are refined throughout sampling, steering generation toward feasible final samples. We further propose a terminal-estimate variant that avoids accumulating local truncation errors by evaluating the reward and constraints at the predicted terminal point rather than at the end of the current horizon. Under standard regularity assumptions, we establish finite-horizon guarantees on suboptimality. Under convex-affine structure, we derive a sharper bound that scales linearly with omitted horizon length, and we show that the terminal-estimate variant is provably tighter when the flow dynamics change slowly. Experiments in both low- and high-dimensional settings with a recent large-scale flow matching model show that ConicFlow achieves high reward and strong constraint satisfaction while deviating less from the pretrained flow than recent baselines.

</details>

*Xiaofan Li,Fengchun Qiao,Xing Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究发现，在模型上下文协议（MCP）系统中，大型语言模型（LLM）在选择工具时，参数模式（schema）的变化对工具选择的影响最大，其次是描述，名称的影响较弱。模型偏好扁平化的参数结构，并且当某个参数模式能直接满足请求时，即使有位置偏好，模型也会选择该工具。这表明参数模式的设计和工具的排序都会影响工具的选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在模型上下文协议（MCP）系统中选择工具时，参数模式存在显著差异，作者希望探究这些参数模式差异是否会影响工具的选择，以及影响的程度。

Method: 研究者通过控制性元数据干预实验，在五个不同的LLM和五个任务上，逐一改变元数据的一个因素（服务器名称、工具名称、描述或参数模式），并保持其他因素不变。他们通过平衡工具位置并使用条件逻辑回归来估计位置调整后的效应。

Conclusion: 参数模式不仅影响工具的调用方式，也影响工具的选择。因此，对于MCP的开发者和评估者来说，参数模式的设计和工具的排序会影响最终被调用的实现，即使其功能是相同的。

Abstract: In Model Context Protocol (MCP) systems, LLMs select tools from metadata rather than from their implementations. Names and descriptions summarize what a tool does, while the parameter schema specifies the fields a tool accepts and how they are organized. Our analysis of metadata for 367,174 MCP tools reveals substantial schema variation among functionally similar tools. Many of these tools share names and similar descriptions but expose different parameter schemas. This raises a key question: can parameter-schema differences influence tool selection before any call is made? We study this question through controlled metadata interventions across five LLMs and five tasks. Each comparison changes exactly one metadata factor (server name, tool name, description, or parameter schema) while keeping the others fixed. We balance tool positions and use conditional logistic regression to estimate position-adjusted effects. We find that: (1) parameter-schema changes produce the largest and most consistent selection shifts among the tested interventions. Models tend to favor separate top-level parameters over grouped or composite forms. (2) Descriptions that explain parameters also tend to increase selection, while name effects are weaker and less consistent. (3) Targeted comparisons show that schema effects depend on the specific parameter names and on how the request represents the same information. When only one schema satisfies an explicit request requirement, all five models select the compatible tool despite position preferences. These results show that parameter schemas influence not only how tools are called, but also whether they are selected. For MCP developers and evaluators, schema design and tool ordering can therefore affect which implementation is invoked even when functionality is unchanged.

</details>


### [16] [Actionable Meta-Requirements for AI Robustness Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14356)
*Joshua Owotogbe,Roya Nasiri,Indika Kumara,Damian Andrew Tamburri,Willem-Jan van den Heuvel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究提出了一套44条元要求，用于指导和评估AI鲁棒性审计框架的设计和实现，该框架通过系统文献回顾和128名从业者的反馈得到验证和完善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统在变化的操作条件下（如输入扰动、分布变化、外部依赖变化）需要保持可靠性，这使得鲁棒性审计至关重要。然而，设计一个AI鲁棒性审计框架面临挑战，特别是确定其所需支持的功能（元要求）尚未得到整合。

Method: 研究采用设计科学研究方法，首先通过系统性文献回顾（从2890条记录中筛选出74条）提取了43条初步的元要求，并将其归类到16个类别。随后，通过对128名从业者进行调研（收集了5504个评分和586条评论）来验证和完善这些元要求，并补充了关于外部组件和供应链依赖的新要求。

Result: 研究最终确定了44条元要求，涵盖16个类别。其中41条（占总数81.20%）得到了从业者的“同意”或“强烈同意”的评分。从业者的反馈还识别出一个关于外部组件和供应链依赖的额外要求。43条元要求获得了定量验证。

Conclusion: 这套经过验证的44条元要求可以帮助组织构建AI鲁棒性审计框架，评估现有框架的完整性，并对其进行改进，从而确保AI系统在不断变化的环境中的可靠性。

Abstract: AI-enabled systems must remain dependable when the conditions under which they operate change (e.g., due to input perturbations, distribution shifts, or changes in external dependencies). This makes robustness auditing of such systems important for judging whether the available evidence is sufficient to support a defined robustness conclusion. However, designing an AI robustness auditing framework is challenging. A key unresolved issue is determining the requirements such a framework should support; these requirements have not yet been consolidated. Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as scientific assistants, yet we still lack reliable ways to evaluate whether they can investigate a system rather than merely answer a prompt. A useful evaluation must let agents choose experiments, interpret finite evidence, and make causal decisions, while keeping the environment coherent across repeated observations and interventions and preserving objective ground truth. We introduce ACED-BENCH (Active Causal Evidence and Decision Benchmark), a neuro-symbolic benchmark built around this requirement. The key idea is to separate the readable scientific surface from the formal causal world: LLMs generate natural-language scenarios and task text, while hidden probabilistic graphical models define the causal graph, data-generating process, intervention semantics, validation checks, and oracle answers. This yields scientific worlds that are natural for agents to investigate but exact enough for scalable, programmatic evaluation. The main leaderboard ACED-CORE contains 180 tasks: 60 set-valued causal ancestry/descendancy questions and 120 constrained causal-decision tasks. ACED-QUAL checks whether agents can use the interface to draw conclusions from evidence, while ACED-CORE tests whether they can decide what evidence to collect and when to commit to an answer. Abstract: Agentic AI systems operating over geospatial data require more than autonomous reasoning and tool use; they must also support explicit orchestration, spatial validation, governance, provenance, failure handling, and human decision authority. Prior work introduced ANASSA, an agentic AI orchestration framework for spatial intelligence that established high-level components and responsibility boundaries for governed agentic execution (arXiv:2609.14824). However, the framework did not specify how those high-level responsibilities should be systematically decomposed into an implementation-facing low-level architecture. This paper addresses that gap by applying Design Science Research (DSR) to refine the ANASSA framework from high-level architectural (HLA) responsibilities into a low-level architecture (LLA). The resulting design preserves the responsibility boundaries of the foundational framework while translating them into executable architectural structures, including 47 logical roles, versioned task graphs, capability-based agent selection, typed contracts, explicit runtime states, spatial validation mechanisms, governance controls, failure and recovery paths, and provenance records. The architecture is demonstrated through an end-to-end execution trace and analytically evaluated for requirements traceability, internal consistency, responsibility preservation, and technology independence. The resulting high-level-to-low-level design provides an implementation-facing bridge between the ANASSA framework and future system implementations, defining how governed spatial agentic workflows can be made inspectable, reconstructable, and testable without binding the architecture to a specific AI model, geospatial platform, communication protocol, or deployment environment.

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in mathematical and logical reasoning, yet they still suffer from the curse of complexity and struggle as problem difficulty increases with the number of constraint interactions and the size of the search space. In contrast, satisfiability solvers such as Z3 provide scalable and verifiable reasoning through constraint solving under formal theories, but lack the flexibility to interpret natural-language problem descriptions. In this work, we propose SAT-RL, a reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that trains LLMs to interact with symbolic solvers through multi-turn tool execution. SAT-RL leverages synthetic data generation with verifiable solutions, supervised warm-up on solver-augmented traces, and solver-grounded reinforcement learning with tool-aware rewards. Abstract: Benchmark scores tell us what an LLM can do, but not how much energy is required to deliver that capability. We find large differences in energy efficiency even among models with similar capability. Most configurations lie away from the score--energy Pareto frontier: they use a median of 2.6--4.8$\times$ more energy than another configuration that scores at least as well, with differences reaching 27$\times$. Abstract: Enterprise workflow automation typically requires retrieving a complete and accurate set of relevant information from large operational document corpora (SOPs, policy documents) given a specific scenario or request. In customer support (CS), for example, human specialists must determine the correct sequence of resolution steps for each case, a task that demands precise grounding in policy documentation. Meeting this bar in production typically requires complex document chunking, indexing, and retrieval pipelines, often layered with learned re-rankers, query rewriters, and bespoke agentic RAG infrastructure.
  We report a deployment case study of a simpler alternative: a portable skill consisting of a natural-language instruction, lightweight tools (a retrieval API, format-checking scripts), and a corpus enriched with an LLM-generated navigation layer, which is a structured "Wikipedia-style" index over the underlying documents. This agentic RAG approach is straightforward to implement (1-2 engineer days), portable across capable agentic harnesses (e.g., Claude Code), and performs strongly on the challenging task of CS resolution workflow generation, achieving 99.2% procedural equivalence to human-approved ground truth and 83.3% evidence sufficiency. It is also roughly an order of magnitude slower per case than our deployed production assistant (~90 s vs. ~8-9 s), so we claim no latency advantage. Our claim is scoped to that setting: a mature, well-curated corpus, a latency-tolerant workflow, and human review of every case. </details>

Abstract: Generative recommendation models based on autoregressive decoding have been adopted as alternatives to classical ranking-based systems. Under a realistic setting where an adversary can inject limited malicious interactions and query a recommendation API as a black box, our empirical study shows that generative recommenders are vulnerable: injecting fewer than 1% synthetic interactions significantly increases the likelihood of promoting malicious targets under the trigger. To characterize this vulnerability, we analyze the synthesis of malicious interactions from two perspectives: (i) decoding alignment and (ii) prefix popularity. We observe that short, context-aligned prefixes that are both common under the model's induced transition dynamics and strongly linked to a frequent trigger consistently amplify targeted promotion. Motivated by this analysis, we develop AlignPoison, a black-box framework that discovers and samples context-aligned prefixes from API outputs. We conduct experiments on benchmarks in unimodal and multimodal generative recommendation settings. Method: 作者构建了一个包含超过400万个腕戴式PPG录音及其对应的波形形态和元数据文本描述的PPG-文本语料库。HiPPT框架结合了三个预训练目标：1. 录音级别形态对齐（record-level morphology alignment），将单个录音与脉冲特征关联；2. 跨录音上下文对齐（cross-recording context alignment），聚合共享相同元数据元组的录音以捕获上下文一致的规律；3. 波形引导文本建模（waveform-guided text modeling），从PPG片段表示中恢复被掩码的上下文概念。

Result: 在血压、血管僵硬度、生理属性和跨数据集心率估计等六个下游任务上，HiPPT在主要的线性探测指标上取得了最佳结果。HiPPT学习到的对齐空间支持年龄组、性别和BMI类别的零样本分析，且随着聚合录音数量的增加，性能有所提升。

Conclusion: 证据范围匹配能够生成可迁移且语义可访问的可穿戴PPG表示。HiPPT框架通过精细匹配监督信号和证据范围，有效提升了PPG表示的性能和可解释性。

Abstract: Reusable wearable PPG representations should capture local pulse morphology and broader physiological regularities. Existing pretraining objectives, however, usually apply supervision at the recording or pair level, overlooking that different concepts become reliable over different scopes of waveform evidence. We propose HiPPT, a physiology-grounded framework that matches each supervision source to its appropriate evidence scope. We construct a PPG-Text corpus of over 4 million wrist-worn recordings from 202K users, pairing recordings with waveform-derived morphology and metadata-derived context descriptions. HiPPT combines record-level morphology alignment, which grounds individual recordings in pulse characteristics, with cross-recording context alignment, which aggregates recordings sharing the same metadata tuple to capture context-consistent regularities. Waveform-guided text modeling further recovers masked contextual concepts from PPG patch representations, providing fine-grained waveform-text supervision. Across six downstream tasks spanning blood pressure, vascular stiffness, physiological attributes, and cross-dataset heart-rate estimation, HiPPT achieves the best result on the primary linear-probing metrics. The aligned space also supports zero-shot profiling of age group, sex, and BMI category, individually and jointly, with performance improving as more recordings are aggregated. These results show that evidence-scope matching yields transferable and semantically accessible wearable PPG representations. Code and pretrained weights will be released.

</details>


### [25] [Reels-RSI: Program-Level Self-Improvement for Code-Rendered Explainer Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14495)
*Wei Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一种名为 Reels-RSI 的新型视频生成系统，它将视频生成视为一种程序生成任务，而非像素生成。通过代码级别的自我改进和基于规则的审计，Reels-RSI 能够提高视频的质量和可维护性，并揭示了视频生成中的潜在问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的视频生成方法侧重于像素级别的生成，导致难以审计和修复。研究者认为，解释性视频（如科学解释、历史事件讲解）本质上是程序（包括脚本、故事板和动画代码），可以通过确定性渲染器生成。因此，研究的动机在于开发一种能够进行代码级别自我改进和审计的视频生成系统，以提高视频的质量和可维护性。

Method: Reels-RSI 系统通过以下方法实现自我改进：1. 程序级自我改进：不直接修改模型权重或提示，而是在程序（代码）层面进行修订。2. 版本控制：每次修订都记录代码快照。3. 回顾与审计：将发现的缺陷与修复该缺陷的 diff 配对，并总结经验教训。4. 规则化经验教训：将静态检查可以捕获的经验教训转化为规则，并附带必须通过和必须失败的示例，以便进行单元测试。5. 规则的累积应用：新学习的规则会应用于之前生成的所有视频。6. 改进决策：代理可以根据人类的盲审偏好来重写导演的规则手册，只有在人类判断偏好时才会被采纳。

Result: 研究发现：1. 新学习的规则能够发现早期版本生成的潜在缺陷。2. 规则对强大的导演来说是一种审计机制（可发现 unguarded reels 的违规），对较弱的导演来说是一种保障机制（减少 unguarded reels 的违规）。3. 经验教训可以缩短修订周期，但不会影响裁判的判断。4. 投票设计的偏见（受试者倾向于选择第二个展示的视频）会掩盖脚本的优劣。5. 偏好信号存在四种失效模式，均被检查机制所发现并得到修复。

Conclusion: 将视频生成视为程序生成而非像素生成，并通过代码级别的自我改进、规则化审计和累积学习，可以显著提高视频生成系统的质量、可审计性和可维护性。本研究提出的 Reels-RSI 系统证明了这一方法的有效性，并揭示了视频生成过程中的一些关键挑战和改进方向。

Abstract: Explainer videos -- a worked geometry problem, why the sky is blue, how a dynasty fell -- are usually one more target for pixel video generation. We argue they are a different kind of artifact: a program (script, storyboard and per-frame animation code) that a deterministic renderer turns into frames. A program can be read, diffed, tested and audited; pixels can only be watched. Reels-RSI is an open-source reel director for any agent harness; its self-improvement happens at the program level rather than in weights or prompts. Every revision pass is logged with a code snapshot; a retrospective pairs each check finding with the diff that fixed it and proposes lessons; a lesson that a static check can catch is compiled into a rule with a must-fail and a must-pass example, so the memory is unit-tested; and a rule learned today runs over everything made before it. A bounded, benchmark-gated step lets an agent rewrite the director's playbook, kept only when blind pairwise judgments on held-out topics prefer it; nothing enters memory without a human decision. Across 111 reels -- a field study, two playbook evolutions, a 2x2 memory ablation, a weaker director, a 48-reel learning curve and a judge-reliability study -- we find that the rule learned in the field caught four latent defects in frames authored before it existed and none after; that rules are an audit for a strong director (eight unguarded reels, no violation) and a guard for a weaker one (thirty violations unguarded versus five); that lessons shorten revision loops but do not compound or move the judge; and that the first rewrite's 11--1 verdict was a position bias in our vote design (judges pick the second-shown reel 62--81% of the time), masking scripts that traded thirteen facts for craft. We document four failure modes of the preference signal, which check caught each, and the fixes. Code, rules, lessons and data are public.

</details>


### [26] [MontageFlow: Physically Valid High Fidelity EEG Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14507)
*Sudarshan Regmi,Nabaraj Subedi,Arvind Pillai,Yu Yvonne Wu,Yuliang Chen,Michael V. Heinz,Lisa Marsch,Nicholas C. Jacobson,Andrew Campbell*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为 MontageFlow 的新生成模型，通过强制执行 EEG 信号的线性身份约束来生成更真实、保真度更高的 EEG 数据，并取得了显著的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成模型在生成高保真度 EEG 数据方面存在潜在的、未被注意到的分类失败，即无法满足 EEG 信号固有的线性身份约束，尽管它们在保真度指标上有所改善。

Method: 提出 MontageFlow，一个基于流匹配（flow-matching）的模型。该模型通过限制其输出信号满足 EEG 信号的线性身份约束来强制执行这些约束。此外，模型还基于从整个 EEG 窗口编码的生理状态向量进行条件化，以保留 EEG 的生理特征。

Result: MontageFlow 在三个大规模基准测试中，相比于最接近的竞争对手，TS-FID 指标提高了 1.6-3.6 倍，同时确保了生成信号的有效性。

Conclusion: 强制执行 EEG 信号的线性身份约束不仅能确保生成数据的有效性，还能显著提高其保真度。MontageFlow 模型通过结合身份约束和生理状态条件化，在生成真实且富有生理信息的 EEG 数据方面取得了显著进展。

Abstract: Generative modeling offers a promising solution to the scarcity of labeled clinical electroencephalography (EEG) data under strict privacy constraints. Although recent generative models report substantial improvements in generation fidelity, we show that these gains conceal a categorical failure. EEG is not an arbitrary multichannel signal: each channel records the voltage difference between two scalp electrodes. So, real recordings satisfy exact linear identities among their channels. Current generators invariably violate these identities, yet this has gone unnoticed. We therefore propose MontageFlow, a flow-matching model that enforces these identities by restricting its output to signals that satisfy them. We find that ensuring validity improves fidelity too. Furthermore, to retain the EEG characteristics that oversmoothing washes out, we also condition the model on a physiological state vector encoded from the whole EEG window. For generation, this vector is drawn from a prior fitted in latent space. Across 3 large-scale benchmarks, our model improves TS-FID by 1.6-3.6$\times$ over the closest rival while ensuring validity.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: ScienceBuddy-PV adapts the ScienceBuddy recursive-in-recursive design to panvascular intervention research through a structured evidence ledger, device-vessel ontology, abstention contract and retained failure bank. Recursive harness optimization and outer-loop model learning, including reinforcement learning, are specified but not executed. We audit a fixed component, rather than the complete agent system, using separate ARCADE syntax and stenosis tasks (1,000 training, 200 validation and 300 test images per task). A shared task-masked convolutional model was trained once per representation setting; its parameters and the heuristic support gate were then held fixed, with the stenosis threshold selected on validation data. On the locked test sets, syntax Dice was 0.475 (95% CI 0.459-0.490) and stenosis Dice was 0.231 (95% CI 0.214-0.249). Stenosis pixel AUROC was 0.957 and AUPRC was 0.180 at prevalence 0.00975. The gate accepted 76.7% of stenosis-frame outputs versus 100% for a score-only comparator. In a constructed mask audit, it accepted 44.3% of reference candidates and rejected 55.7%, exposing the cost of abstention. Acceptance does not establish correctness or clinical safety. This public-data component audit makes support and abstention measurable and provides a reproducible protocol for future collaborative agent studies. It does not demonstrate recursive improvement, patient-level validity or clinical device recommendations.

</details>

*Huaiming Li,Can Huang,Chufan Wu,Danyu Liu,Xiaomin Yuan,Qinze Li,Yui Lo,Wenhui Bai,Qianlong Wang,Zengle Ge,Xiyu Yan,Yuheng Cheng,Jinhui Ren,Guokai Chen,Jiaqun Liu,Haoran Li,Qianhui Liu,Annan Li,Jianmin Wu,Dawei Yin,Dou Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了FDE-Bench，一个基于真实客户项目的数据集，用于评估能够通过交互式需求澄清和迭代优化来完成端到端交付任务的AI代理。现有方法在处理模糊的真实世界业务需求方面表现不佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实世界的商业需求常常因为一线从业者难以明确表达经验性规则而导致关键需求未被说明。前线工程师（FDE）需要通过对话来获取这些需求，并迭代优化解决方案直至满足客户验收标准。现有的优化基准通常从明确的目标开始，而澄清基准则常常在现有任务中引入信息缺口。因此，需要一个能够评估AI代理在不明确需求下的端到端交付能力的基准。

Method: 构建了FDE-Bench基准，其中包含49个案例，涵盖组合优化和机器学习任务。案例中的澄清目标来源于一线从业者与FDE之间的讨论。AI代理需要与模拟客户进行交互以获取缺失的需求，然后根据客户接受的FDE解决方案作为质量参考，通过特定案例的评估器来评估最终产物是否符合验收标准。

Result: 在18种不同的AI代理配置下进行评估，最高平均交付得分仅为0.5510，而FDE参考的得分为1.0。最高交付成功率（DSR），即完成率，仅为6.12%。

Conclusion: 当前的AI代理在处理模糊的真实世界业务任务时，距离可靠的前线工程师（FDE）级别的端到端交付能力还有很大差距。

Abstract: Real-world business requests often leave key requirements unstated because frontline practitioners struggle to articulate rules they know from experience. Forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must elicit these requirements through dialogue and iteratively optimize solutions until they meet customer acceptance criteria. Existing optimization benchmarks typically start from explicit objectives, while clarification benchmarks often introduce information gaps into existing tasks. We introduce FDE-Bench, the first benchmark built from real customer projects to evaluate agents on end-to-end delivery tasks that require interactive requirement clarification and iterative optimization. Its 49 cases span combinatorial optimization and machine learning. Clarification targets are distilled from discussions between frontline practitioners and FDEs. Agents elicit missing requirements from a simulated customer, and case-specific evaluators assess final artifacts against acceptance criteria using customer-accepted FDE solutions as quality references. Across 18 agent configurations, the highest mean delivery score is only 0.5510, compared with an FDE reference of 1.0. The highest delivery success rate (DSR), defined as the fraction of planned runs reaching this reference, is only 6.12%. These results show that reliable FDE-level end-to-end delivery remains out of reach for the evaluated agents on underspecified real-world business tasks. The benchmark project page is available at https://baidubce.github.io/FM-Agent/FDE-Bench/.

</details>


### [29] [Energy Ring: Stabilizing Feature Energy for Reliable Test-Time Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14525)
*Tianle Liu,Fan Lyu,Tingliang Feng,Chenggong Ni,Tianqi Wang,Zhang Zhang,Fuyuan Hu,Rui Yao,Tao Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为Energy Ring的新方法，用于在测试时发现（TTD）场景下稳定已知和未知类别的能量差距，通过将它们锚定在不同的能量环上来实现，并结合轻量级适配器和扰动一致性模块来增强性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的TTD方法过于保守，导致已知和未知类别的特征在测试时适应过程中容易混淆，难以分离。这促使研究者从能量角度重新审视TTD，并发现自然能量差距不稳定且易于崩溃。

Method: 提出Energy Ring来稳定能量差距。具体方法包括：1. 使用轻量级适配器扩大基于范数的差距并保持已知类别的方向。2. 利用扰动一致性模块形成未知类别的紧凑聚类。3. 在测试时，使用能量引导的置信度加权来改进预测。4. 引入基于稳定性的纠正机制来修正不可靠的更新。

Result: 实验结果表明，Energy Ring在TTD性能上显著优于现有的TTD方法。

Conclusion: Energy Ring通过稳定已知和未知类别之间的能量差距，并结合多种机制来增强TTD的有效性，克服了现有方法的局限性，并在实验中取得了显著的性能提升。

Abstract: Test-Time Discovery (TTD) aims to recognize known classes and detect novel ones while the model is already deployed, operating directly on a continual unlabeled test-time stream. Existing TTD methods are overly conservative, making known and unknown features collapse together and difficult to separate during test-time adaptation. In this paper, we revisit TTD from an energy perspective and find that the natural energy gap between known and unknown classes is unstable and easily collapses. We therefore propose Energy Ring to stabilize this gap by anchoring the two types of classes on separate energy rings. A lightweight adapter enlarges the norm-based gap while preserving known-class directions, and a perturbation consistency module forms compact clusters for unknown classes. During testing, energy-guided confidence weighting improves prediction, and a stability-based rectification mechanism corrects unreliable updates. Experimental results show that Energy Ring significantly improves TTD performance against existing TTD methods.

</details>


### [30] [Are Multimodal Benchmarks Really Useful? Item-Level Multimodal Benchmark Diagnosis via Structure-Response Co-Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14542)
*Shiqi Zhang,Weixin Zeng,Ziheng Zhang,Jiuyang Tang,Xiang Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为 SRCoD 的框架，用于诊断多模态基准测试中的捷径问题，该问题可以根据单一模态或答案选项本身来回答，从而无法准确反映模型的跨模态推理能力。SRCoD 通过分析基准内容和目标答案来估计样本的多模态信息结构，并将其用作条件响应建模的软结构锚点，从而生成反映项目对不同模态证据依赖程度的项目诊断概况。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态基准测试可能包含捷径问题，这些问题可以通过单一模态或答案选项本身来解决，这会影响模型跨模态推理能力的真实评估。现有的诊断方法不足以进行全面的诊断。

Method: 提出 SRCoD（结构-响应共校准诊断）框架，该框架通过估计样本的多模态信息结构（基于基准内容和目标答案）并将其用作模态条件项响应建模的软结构锚点，来进行项目级别的模态依赖诊断。SRCoD 生成项目级别的诊断概况，并提供可解释的归因。

Result: SRCoD 能够进行细粒度的基准分析，超出聚合准确性。通过在基准精炼导向验证和人工标记项验证两种互补协议下的广泛实验，证明 SRCoD 的性能优于最先进的基准诊断方法。

Conclusion: SRCoD 是一个有效的框架，可以对多模态基准中的模态依赖性进行项目级别的诊断，从而克服现有方法的局限性，并为多模态基准的评估和改进提供更深入的见解。

Abstract: Multimodal benchmarks are central to evaluating whether models can reason over information from multiple modalities. However, existing literature has revealed that some benchmarks may contain shortcut items that can be answered from a single modality or from answer-option regularities alone, thus failing to reflect models' true cross-modal inference ability. Existing methods for assessing benchmarks typically rely either on intrinsic item structure or extrinsic model response behavior, which are not adequate for a comprehensive diagnosis. To fill in this gap, we propose SRCoD, a structure-response co-calibrated diagnosis framework for item-level diagnosis of modality dependence in multimodal benchmarks. SRCoD estimates sample-wise multimodal information structure from benchmark content and target answers, and uses this signal as a soft structural anchor for modality-conditioned item response modeling. The learned model produces a calibrated item-level diagnostic profile that reflects how strongly an item depends on different forms of modality evidence, enabling fine-grained benchmark analysis beyond aggregate accuracy. SRCoD also provides interpretable attribution of the diagnosis results. Extensive experiments under two complementary protocols, i.e., benchmark-refinement oriented validation and human-labeled item validation, demonstrate that SRCoD outperforms state-of-the-art benchmark diagnosis methods.

</details>


### [31] [PsyMemBehav: Psychology-Informed and Memory-Grounded Two-Level Identity-to-Action Reasoning for Social-Media Behavior Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14570)
*Wenji Zhang,Xilong Cheng,Yunxiao Qin,Mai Tu,Tongye Zhu,Yuhao Zhou,JingBo Ji,Yuting Tan,Duoyin Li,Hongjiang Xiao,Yuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PsyMemBehav模型，能够通过心理学画像和检索到的记忆，模拟用户在社交平台的行为，并在Reddit、Bluesky和Twitter的真实用户行为数据集PsyMemBehav-bench上取得了优于GPT-5.4的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了让大型语言模型（LLM）能够忠实地重现真实用户在社交平台上的行为，需要将结构化的平台决策和语言模型与稀疏、嘈杂的行为证据相结合。

Method: PsyMemBehav模型通过两层身份到行为的推理，将心理学画像和检索到的记忆映射到目标优先的平台行为。构建了包含5.57M真实用户行为的PsyMemBehav-bench数据集，并利用用户描述符、检索到的记忆、反向CoT监督和基于规则的DPO来训练模型。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) support social simulation, but faithfully reproducing real users requires grounding both structured platform decisions and language in sparse, noisy behavioral evidence. Abstract: Current evaluations of multimodal unlearning typically focus on whether a model stops outputting target information. This surface-level criterion, however, masks two critical failure modes. First, knowledge suppression techniques often induce confabulation, leading the model to hallucinate facts about the unlearned subject. Second, refusal training merely alters observable behavior without erasing the underlying knowledge; such models might decline open queries but still identify correct answers under multiple-choice probing. To overcome these limitations, we propose Forget-Aware Self-Distillation (FASD). This method is designed to achieve honest ignorance, a state where the model genuinely loses the target knowledge and learns to acknowledge its absence. FASD separates these goals into two complementary channels. The behavior channel distills appropriate refusals from an ignorance-prompted copy of the model itself. First, we introduce a unified taxonomy with nine design dimensions organized into four groups: update targets, update organization, update schedule and scope, feedback and selection. Second, we examine how existing RSI methods draw on traditional deep learning, for example through optimization, regularization, data augmentation, continual learning, and adversarial learning. We develop further ideas by examining more specific learning mechanisms and drawing on evolutionary computation. We also review how existing benchmarks assess self-improvement under online, offline, and offline-to-online settings. Together, these perspectives help researchers develop new RSI research ideas from existing designs and learning mechanisms. On ReCAST's prospective-repair subset, RASSG reduces the stale execution rate from LocalAgreement-2's 50.00% to 3.15%, with a mean delay of 3.676s across successful trajectories. We further curate PIBench, a protein-protein complex dataset with diverse target scaffolds derived from the Protein Data Bank (PDB). We first pretrain PIDiff on PIBench and subsequently fine-tune it for two therapeutically relevant applications: minibinder design and antibody design. PPFrame consistently outperforms baseline methods across sequence design success rate, structure binding energy, and sequence-structure co-designability on all tasks.

Its 815 human-reviewed tasks draw on Spider, BIRD, and LiveSQLBench; 618 require several databases to contribute, and 105 allow more than one interpretation of the required sources. Executable contracts define source participation, cross-source dependencies, and source-local execution, while RouteEnv lets agents inspect public catalog evidence without revealing the gold annotations. In our routing-only study across seven model backends, the highest RA-Set score is 60.55%, compared with a highest RA-Graph score of 34.66% when coordination requirements are included. The gap becomes more pronounced when execution is required. Across four backends, median non-privileged Route+Exec-Graph success ranges from 6.69% to 7.98% without clarification and from 11.44% to 13.25% with one clarification; the best observed clarified configuration reaches 16.99%. On ambiguous tasks, clarification improves exact branch-source recovery by 39.8-43.2 percentage points. These findings illustrate why retrieving plausible databases or producing correct local SQL is not enough: an agent must carry the right information through the entire multi-database workflow.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的“品味”基准测试可能会奖励测试技巧而不是真正的鉴赏能力。研究人员希望创建一个能够真正衡量鉴赏力的基准测试，并识别和解决现有基准测试中的有效性威胁。

Method: 研究人员提出了TasteBench，一个包含视觉、品牌、图书和科技物品的成对“好”与“坏”的基准测试。他们还设计了一个控制协议，用于区分鉴赏力和测试技巧。该协议包括专家级黄金标准、弱标签防火墙、构建时的随机分配、文件名清理和硬过滤。通过试点测试，研究人员量化了位置偏见、词汇泄露和难度上限这三种有效性威胁。

Result: 试点测试揭示了三种主要的有效性威胁：1) 位置偏见，优先选择A组的物品（0.956的概率）；2) 词汇泄露，通过文件名中的标记线索（0.912）；3) 难度上限，在图书、品牌和科技领域，人类专家的一致性接近完美（1.0），即使在随机分组下也是如此。研究人员开发了评估工具和随机分配工具，并证明了随机分配工具可以消除位置偏见（从0.916降至0.495/0.505）。

Abstract: Expert-aligned "taste" benchmarks should reward craft judgment, not the ability to game the test. We introduce TasteBench, a pairwise good-vs-bad benchmark across visual, brand, book, and tech items under a frozen rubric with expert-only gold (panel n>=3; percent agreement >=0.60 primary gate; weak engagement labels train/analysis-only), together with a control protocol that separates craft judgment from test-gaming. Applying the protocol to a Round-1 pilot (primary_human_expert; three biological human experts; n=250 pairs) surfaces and quantifies three validity threats: two construction artifacts that inflate the trivial-baseline layer, and a difficulty ceiling that inflates every score. (1) Position: the preferred item is slot A with probability 0.956, so an always_item_a policy scores 0.956 (fair chance 0.5). (2) Lexical leakage: a filename token cue scores 0.912. (3) Difficulty ceiling: craft domains show near-ceiling human agreement (book/brand/tech 1.0), and even under A/B randomization (eval_assignment_seed7; gold_side_A ~0.47) all five VLM cards reach 1.0 on craft, with only visual separating (~0.84-0.91; a post-hoc hard subset, n=107, leaves craft at 1.0). The protocol (expert-only gold, a weak-label firewall, side randomization at construction, filename scrubbing, and hard filters) makes each artifact measurable and, for the two construction artifacts, correctable; we release a reference eval harness and a side-randomization tool, and show the tool removes the position skew (0.916 to 0.495/0.505). The result is a calibrated view of what the benchmark does and does not yet measure: position and leakage are fixable, whereas the craft-domain ceiling is a pair-difficulty limit that Round-2 must address. We do not evaluate engagement, era/circle conditioning, or calibration here, and we claim no general taste SOTA.

</details>


### [46] [Relational Semantic Grounding for Test-Time Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14721)
*Tianle Liu,Gongbo Cheng,Chenggong Ni,Minming Gu,Tao Zhou,Fuyuan Hu,Fan Lyu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为SEGA的框架，用于在测试时发现（TTD）任务中实现语义接地，克服了现有方法只能分配匿名标签的问题。SEGA利用大型语言模型（LLM）生成属性丰富的类描述，并在训练时构建一个视觉-语义空间。在测试时，通过关系语义接地（RSG）将未知样本与已知类锚点关联，并利用LLM生成候选概念，最终在学习到的语义空间中进行重新排序，从而将匿名聚类转化为可解释的语义概念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TTD方法在发现新类别时只能分配匿名标签，难以在实际开放世界应用中进行解释和使用。作者希望能够为新发现的类别提供可解释的语义标签。

Method: SEGA框架包括训练阶段和测试阶段。训练阶段：利用LLM为已知类别生成属性丰富的描述，并构建一个属性锚定的视觉-语义空间。测试阶段（RSG）：将未知样本与相似和不相似的已知类锚点进行关联，利用LLM生成候选概念，并在学习到的语义空间中对这些概念进行重新排序。最后，通过置信度引导的测试时间语义稳定化来确认最终的语义概念。

Result: SEGA能够将匿名测试时间聚类转化为可解释的语义概念。实验表明，SEGA在TTD基线方法上有所提升，并展示了语义接地在开放世界TTD中的潜力。

Conclusion: SEGA通过结合属性级别的语义对齐和关系概念接地，成功地解决了TTD任务中类别的可解释性问题，使得测试时发现的未知类别能够被赋予有意义的语义标签，为开放世界场景下的模型部署提供了更有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Test-Time Discovery (TTD) aims to recognize known classes and detect novel ones from a continuous unlabeled test stream after deployment. Existing TTD methods mainly rely on visual clustering or prototype comparison, and can only assign anonymous labels to discovered classes, leaving them difficult to interpret in open-world applications. In this paper, we propose SEGA, a Semantic Grounding with Attributes framework for TTD. SEGA leverages large language models to generate attribute-rich descriptions for known classes and constructs an attribute-anchored visual-semantic space during training. At test time, we introduce Relational Semantic Grounding (RSG), which grounds unknown samples with similar and dissimilar known-class anchors, prompts the LLM to generate candidate concepts, and reranks them in the learned semantic space. The selected concept is further used for confidence-guided test-time semantic stabilization. By coupling attribute-level semantic alignment with relational concept grounding, SEGA transforms anonymous test-time clusters into interpretable semantic concepts. Experiments show that SEGA improves TTD baselines with the promise of semantic grounding for open-world.

</details>


### [47] [MHWA: Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14727)
*Pengcheng Pan,Guoqing Ma,Yuhan Zhang,Yang Chen,Yichen Liu,Ziheng Li,Shan Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为MHWA的多时间尺度分层世界-动作模型，通过一个分层上下文通道和动态路由的专家混合网络，有效减少了世界模型预测中的漂移和误差累积，并在Atari游戏基准测试中取得了优于基线模型的性能，同时参数量和训练成本更低。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Autoregressive world models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for sample efficient decision making, yet their open loop rollouts often exhibit increasing drift that leads to error accumulation even within a relatively small planning horizon. Hierarchical temporal abstraction is a natural candidate to mitigate such drift by reducing the effective prediction horizon; however, existing hierarchical designs can introduce added structural and conceptual complexity, sometimes making them difficult to control and limiting gains over flat baselines. To this end, we introduce MHWA (Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action model), which employs a strided high level context channel to reduce global context update frequency, effectively curbing the propagation of compounding drift. Crucially, via context aware routing, the gating network dynamically reconfigures a low level mixture of experts by using both global context and current observations, thereby enabling flexible high-low coordination, helping alleviate interference commonly observed in static hierarchies. Empirically, using RLiable's seed-by-game aggregation, MHWA (77M parameters) achieves an IQM human normalized score (HNS) of 0.884 across three training seeds on a 14-game Atari subset using 10% subsampled offline data, outperforming a matched JOWA-70M baseline (0.529) and achieving numerically comparable performance to JOWA-150M while using nearly half the parameters and 70.88% fewer training FLOPs per sequence.

</details>

*Zhongnian Li,Shi Xu,Peng Ying,Weikang Gong,Zhixiao Wang,Xinzheng Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究提出了工具增强型策略代理 (TASA)，一种利用 LLM 生成候选方案并追踪优化过程的方法，通过总结和利用优化轨迹来提高解决方案质量，并引入了自适应工具规划器来高效更新解决方案。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: TASA 提出了一种基于优化轨迹的策略规划方法，将优化过程分解为可追踪的策略选择。此外，研究者利用 LLM 构建问题特定的工具，并引入了策略引导的自适应工具规划器，以有效利用轨迹信息更新解决方案。该方法在持续探索下建立了局部收敛性，并在共享的候选评估预算下进行了评估。

Conclusion: TASA 通过策略规划和自适应工具规划器，有效地克服了 OPRO 在优化过程追踪方面的局限性，显著提升了解决方案的质量和可解释性。

Abstract: Optimization by PROmpting (OPRO) directly leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate candidate solutions through natural-language prompting. However, OPRO's optimization process is difficult to track, which prevents LLMs from capturing useful information accumulated over previous iterations, thereby limiting solution quality. To address this limitation, we propose a Tool-Augmented Strategic Agent (TASA) which summarizes and exploits trajectory to improve solution quality. Specifically, TASA plans the strategy for each step based on the optimization trajectory, which decomposes the optimization process into traceable strategy selections. Moreover, we leverage LLM to construct problem-specific tools and introduce a strategy-guided adaptive tool planner, which efficiently utilizes the information of trajectory to update solutions. We establish local convergence under persistent exploration and evaluate the complete framework under a shared candidate-evaluation budget. The results support its solution quality and the traceability of strategy-guided search.

</details>


### [49] [SAGE: Pushing 2-Bit Vector-Quantized LLMs toward Real-World Usability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14745)
*Xianglong Yan,Zenan Wu,Kewei Zhang,Kaicheng Yang,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为 SAGE 的新型权重仅量化方法，通过能量分层分组 (ESG) 和自适应比特分配 (ABS) 来解决低比特（2 位）向量量化中的敏感通道保护和比特预算分配问题，在多项基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，并提供了显著的推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低比特（低于 3 位）权重仅量化方法，特别是标量量化，在部署大型语言模型时会遭受严重的精度损失。虽然向量量化 (VQ) 能更好地保持精度，但现有 VQ 方法在实际任务中仍存在显著性能下降。文章指出了两个未充分探索的设计挑战：1. 如何保护联合编码向量中敏感的权重通道；2. 如何在固定比特预算下，为表示的组成部分（如方向和半径）进行最优分配，以适应不同的权重矩阵。

Method: SAGE 方法包含两个核心组件：1. 能量分层分组 (ESG)：将通道分组与激活加权拟合相结合，将不同能量层级的通道分组到每个子向量中，优先考虑敏感通道。2. 自适应比特分配 (ABS)：针对每个矩阵，在固定比特预算下，通过选择能带来最低激活加权重构误差的比特分配方案，来平衡方向码本容量和半径精度。

Result: 在涵盖知识、数学、代码生成、指令遵循和工具使用等基准测试中，SAGE 在 2 位量化设置下取得了最先进的性能。在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 模型上，SAGE 保留了 BF16 模型 95.3% 的平均基准分数。结合定制的 CUDA 内核，SAGE 实现了高达 2.55 倍于 FP16 的非流式端到端加速。

Conclusion: SAGE 成功地解决了低比特权重仅量化中的关键挑战，通过其创新的分组和比特分配策略，在保持模型性能的同时实现了显著的压缩和加速，为在资源受限环境下部署大型语言模型提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Extreme low-bit weight-only quantization is an effective approach to reducing the deployment costs of large language models. Below 3 bits, scalar quantization often suffers severe accuracy loss, while vector quantization (VQ) better preserves accuracy through more expressive joint encoding. However, existing VQ methods still exhibit substantial degradation on real-world tasks, and two design challenges remain underexplored: (1) protecting sensitive weight channels within jointly encoded vectors; and (2) allocating a fixed bit budget among representation components, such as direction and radius, to suit different weight matrices. To address these challenges, we propose SAGE: Split Adaptation and Grouping by Energy for weight-only vector quantization. First, Energy-Stratified Grouping (ESG) couples channel grouping with activation-weighted fitting, grouping channels from different energy tiers within each subvector to prioritize sensitive channels. Second, Adaptive Bit Split (ABS) balances direction-codebook capacity and radius precision per matrix, selecting the split with the lowest activation-weighted reconstruction error under a fixed budget. Across benchmarks covering knowledge, mathematics, code generation, instruction following, and tool use, SAGE achieves state-of-the-art performance in the 2-bit quantization setting. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, it retains 95.3% of the BF16 model's average benchmark score. With our custom-designed CUDA kernel, SAGE delivers up to a 2.55-fold non-streaming end-to-end speedup over FP16. The code is available at https://github.com/Zincwolf/sage.

</details>


### [50] [Equal-information evaluation of credit assignment in modular financial reinforcement learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14750)
*Gennadiy Chistiakov,Yury Yanovich*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一个用于评估模块化金融强化学习中信用分配的框架，该框架结合了均衡信息重建控制、固定效用比较和预定下游护栏。在三个受控研究中，该框架在交易架构中得到实现，并发现了一些信用分配的评估失败案例，包括冗余归因信号、表示引起的预测权衡以及组件监督与下游风险结果之间的不匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在模块化金融强化学习中，信用分配的评估存在困难，因为一个归因信号可能只改善组件损失而不增加决策相关信息或经济结果。因此，需要一个更可靠的评估框架。

Method: 提出一个评估框架，结合了均衡信息重建控制、固定效用比较和预定下游护栏。该框架被实例化在一个归因引导的模块化交易架构中，并在三个受控研究中进行了测试，涵盖了更新分配、监督目标表示和投资组合风险控制。

Result: 研究发现：1. 基于残差的分配在普通损失预算控制下被精确复现；2. 直接的亏空监督改善了组件预测，但未能保持解码结果；3. 在固定效用下，组件式批评监督相比标量监督，降低了风险条件下的确定性当量和回撤。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了三种不同的评估失败：冗余的归因信号、表示引起的预测权衡，以及组件监督与下游风险结果之间的不一致。研究表明，模块级学习的声明需要运行级的出处（provenance）。该研究的贡献在于提供了一种可重复使用的方法，用于评估在部分可观测性、延迟反馈和经济风险约束下运行的专家系统中的信用分配。

Abstract: Credit assignment in modular financial reinforcement learning is difficult to evaluate because an attributed signal may improve a component loss without adding decision-relevant information or improving economic outcomes. We propose an evaluation framework combining equal-information reconstruction controls, fixed-utility comparisons and prespecified downstream guardrails. The framework is instantiated in an attribution-guided modular trading architecture and tested in three controlled studies covering update allocation, supervision-target representation and portfolio risk control. We find that residual-based allocation is exactly reproduced by an ordinary loss-budget control under the disclosed interface; direct shortfall supervision improves component prediction but fails decoded-outcome preservation; and component-wise critic supervision worsens risk-condition certainty equivalent and drawdown relative to scalar supervision under fixed utility. These results identify three distinct evaluation failures: redundant attribution signals, representation-induced prediction trade-offs, and misalignment between component supervision and downstream risk outcomes. A preserved historical engineering case further shows why module-level learning claims require run-level provenance. The contribution is a reusable methodology for evaluating credit assignment in expert systems operating under partial observability, delayed feedback and economic risk constraints.

</details>


### [51] [GateSight: Recurrent Memory Anticipates Attention Memory for Query-Agnostic KV Eviction in Hybrid LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14754)
*Junjie Li,Jiong Lou,Jie Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GateSight 提出了一种新方法，通过利用混合语言模型（如 GDN）的循环记忆信号来预测注意力机制（KV cache）的关键信息，从而显著减少 KV cache 的内存占用，同时保持高精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合语言模型中的 KV cache 内存占用随着上下文增长而显著增加，成为服务时的瓶颈。研究人员希望找到一种方法，利用模型已有的信息（GDN 层的循环记忆）来预测哪些 KV 缓存条目是真正重要的，从而减少内存占用。

Method: GateSight 通过学习 GDN 层的写入门控、衰减和写入幅度信号来预测 KV 条目的未来效用。具体来说，它使用轻量级的多层感知器（MLP）来读取这些信号，并预测 KV 条目对模型自身续写的影响程度。预测的效用用于决定每个注意力层保留哪些 KV 条目，以及保留多少。最终，在服务时，GateSight 在预填充后对 KV cache 进行评分，并物理释放被丢弃的 KV 条目。

Result: 在 Qwen3.8-27B 和 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 模型上，使用 GateSight 时，KV cache 的占用量减少到原来的十分之一。在 SCBench 和 RULER-4096 基准测试中，GateSight 在四对模型-基准测试中有三对表现最优，并且在所有四对测试中均优于 KVzip。

Conclusion: GateSight 是一种有效的注意力 KV cache 压缩方法，它能利用模型自身的循环记忆信号来预测 KV 条目的效用，从而在大幅减少内存占用的同时，保持甚至提升了模型的性能。该方法具有轻量级、准确性高、开销低的优点。

Abstract: Hybrid language models interleave Gated DeltaNet (GDN) layers, whose recurrent memory has a fixed size, with full-attention layers, whose key-value (KV) cache grows with the context and dominates serving memory. In this paper, we ask whether the recurrent memory already knows what the attention memory will need. We first show that which GDN heads of Qwen3.8-27B keep long memories is fixed by the weights rather than by the document. Next, we define the future utility of a KV entry by how much removing it changes the attention output over the model's own continuations, and find that the write gate, decay and write magnitude that GDN layers emit during prefill anticipate this utility before any query is seen. Because the relation is spread across many GDN heads and layers, and a linear map recovers its trend but less of its high-utility tail than a nonlinear one, we propose GateSight, which learns it with lightweight per-head multilayer perceptrons that read these signals and no attention score. Their predicted utility decides which entries each attention layer keeps, and how much each layer keeps is set by the model's native attention output gate, whose mean differs by more than an order of magnitude across layers. Finally, at serving time, GateSight scores the cache once after prefill and physically releases discarded KV entries. Experimental results on SCBench and RULER-4096 with Qwen3.8-27B and, with the same recipe, the sparse-attention model Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, up to the 262K-token limit of the models, show that with a tenth of the attention KV cache, GateSight is the most accurate of five query-agnostic methods on three of the four model-benchmark pairs and leads KVzip on all four, by 9.5 to 47.2 points. Notably, it scores a full-length context with negligible overhead relative to prefill.

</details>


### [52] [CUSE: Fine-Grained Multimodal Unlearning with Counterfactual Guidance and On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14763)
*Chenlu Ding,Jiancan Wu,Yanchen Luo,Tianyu Zhang,Yancheng Yuan,Xiang Wang,Xiangnan He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为CUSE的框架，用于多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的有效信息遗忘，能够在保留非目标内容的同时移除敏感信息，并且遗忘和保留是联合进行的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型遗忘方法在移除目标信息的同时，往往会损害非目标内容的保留，并且遗忘的控制粒度粗糙，与模型当前行为不一致。

Method: CUSE框架首先通过移除目标信息相关的证据来构建反事实输入，利用由此产生的token概率变化来识别需要强力遗忘的token。然后，通过对当前模型采样生成的响应进行自蒸馏，结合冻结的原模型作为教师模型，并注入遗忘和保留导向的特权上下文，从而实现token级别的遗忘和保留目标。

Result: 在MLLMU-Bench基准测试中，CUSE将遗忘集合的ROUGE-L降低了33.6%，同时将保留集合的ROUGE-L提高了1.2%，优于现有最强的基线方法。

Conclusion: CUSE通过其反事实引导和on-policy自蒸馏机制，能够有效地实现多模态大语言模型的信息遗忘，同时保持对非目标信息的保留，并在遗忘和保留之间取得了良好的权衡。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can reproduce sensitive, copyrighted, or unsafe information from their training data. Effective unlearning must remove target information while preserving non-target content, even within the same response. Existing methods typically apply uniform forgetting objectives to complete responses and rely on fixed, off-policy supervision, resulting in coarse token control and misalignment with the model's current behavior. We propose CUSE, a Counterfactual-guided Unlearning framework via on-policy Self-distillation for multimodal large language models. It first constructs counterfactual inputs by removing target-related evidence and uses the resulting changes in token probabilities to identify which tokens require stronger forgetting. It then distills token-level forgetting and retention targets on responses sampled from the current policy, with a frozen copy of the original model serving as the teacher model augmented with the corresponding forgetting- and retention-oriented privileged contexts. This design jointly determines what to forget and what to preserve. On MLLMU-Bench, CUSE reduces forget-set ROUGE-L by 33.6% while achieving 1.2% higher retain-set ROUGE-L than the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [53] [How Should a Camera-First AI Agent Work?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14772)
*Xiaofan Wu,Xi Zeng,Miaoxia Chen,Peishan Chen,Shuyan Li,Chen Wang,Jiyun Yao,Hanyong Zhong,Jiahao Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种名为“短暂目标交互”（ETI）的新范式，旨在解决视觉智能体在处理转瞬即逝的目标时面临的时间限制问题。研究者设计了一种包含两个截止时间的架构，以适应视觉信息和推理过程的时间约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视觉智能体在处理短暂、转瞬即逝的目标时存在困难，因为它们的感知和推理过程需要花费时间，而目标在此期间可能已经消失。这阻碍了智能体在动态视觉世界中的有效交互。

Method: 提出“短暂目标交互”（ETI）概念，并引入“感知截止协议”（Perceptual Deadline Contract），区分了硬性的记忆截止时间和软性的推理截止时间。设计了一个双截止时间架构：一个始终开启的、有界的、非语义的快速路径；一个在信息被覆盖前将其提交给持久化内存的“主动记忆”机制；以及一个包含多模态模型和工具的延迟审议层。

Result: 在MOT17跟踪窗口上的实验表明，即使是简单的回答也需要1.2-9.3秒，而更复杂的搜索任务则需要更长时间。这验证了单一路径处理的延迟问题，并强调了在截止时间前获取证据的重要性。

Conclusion: 为了构建能够有效处理短暂目标的未来视觉智能体，必须解决时间限制问题。通过引入ETI和双截止时间架构，可以更有效地平衡感知、记忆和推理，从而提升智能体在动态视觉环境中的表现。

Abstract: Camera-first agents must act on the visual world as it unfolds. We argue that the central obstacle for future camera-first agents is not recognition ability - multimodal models (vision-language and live/streaming alike) generalize well through language and remain the right tool for semantic reasoning - but time. Many visual targets are ephemeral: they appear, are query-relevant, and leave within a short window. Binding memory to the same end-to-end path as reasoning means that by the time a monolithic pipeline completes, the evidence is gone. We formalize this as Ephemeral-Target Interaction (ETI) and a Perceptual Deadline Contract separating a hard memory deadline from a soft reasoning deadline, grounded in the bounded, passive nature of sensory and working memory. We propose a two-deadline architecture: an always-on, bounded, non-semantic fast path; an active remembering mechanism that commits a moment to durable memory before it is overwritten (event-driven in v1); and a deferred deliberation layer (multimodal model + tools). We instantiate the contract on real MOT17 track windows, a consistency check, and calibrate the single-path baseline from measured frontier-model latency: even a short answer takes 1.2-9.3 s, and an agentic identify-and-search longer. Answers can be late; evidence cannot be missed.

</details>


### [54] [ProgAgent: Learning Tool Orchestration through Programmatic Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14774)
*Hao Li,Keqing He,Longtao Zheng,Junlong Li,Weihao Zeng,Qian Liu,Yuzhen Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为ProgAgent的工具调用训练方法，通过程序化方式调用工具并管理中间结果，解决了现有方法中上下文过载和任务失败的问题，并在多项基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型（LLM）智能体在执行长周期任务时，通常采用直接工具调用（DTC）的方式，这会导致上下文信息过载（context rot）和任务执行失败。作者希望探索程序化工具调用（PTC）在智能体训练中的优势，并为此类训练提供必要的基础设施。

Method: 开发了一个名为ProgAgent的完整PTC训练框架，包括：1.一个用于生成可验证长周期任务的流水线；2.一个轻量级的PTC运行时；3.一个两阶段的训练策略。该框架使用215个在四个不同环境尺度下生成的任务进行训练。

Conclusion: 程序化工具调用（PTC）是一种比直接工具调用（DTC）更有效的工具调用和中间结果管理方式，尤其在处理长周期任务时。ProgAgent证明了PTC在智能体训练中的有效性，并提供了一个可扩展的框架，为未来基于PTC的智能体研究奠定了基础。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly expected to orchestrate diverse tools over long-horizon tasks. Existing agents typically use Direct Tool Calling (DTC), where the model invokes tools sequentially, and tool responses accumulate in the model context, which can lead to context rot and orchestration breakdown. In contrast, Programmatic Tool Calling (PTC) invokes tools through executable code and stores intermediate results in runtime variables rather than appending them to the context. In this work, we introduce ProgAgent, a full PTC training stack, comprising a pipeline for synthesizing verifiable long-horizon tasks, a lightweight PTC runtime, and a two-stage training recipe. On LOCA-bench, ProgAgent-14B achieves a 30.7% pass rate at a 64k-token environment state, where these baselines score zero. </details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型（LLM）驱动的数据分析方法在将自然语言指令转化为可执行分析程序时，难以可靠地对齐领域语义与复杂模式及异构元数据，导致在真实世界的工作负载中执行不稳定，分析输出语义不一致。

Result: LYNX 在 BIRD-SQL Mini-Dev 和 Spider 2.0-Lite 两个 NL-to-SQL 基准测试上表现出强大的性能和效率。在轻量级和商业模型上，执行准确率提高了 10.66% 到 59.54%，同时与之前最高效的方法相比，令牌消耗减少了 70.53%。该框架对不同模型（从开源轻量级模型到最新的商业模型）具有高泛化能力。在量化金融分析和复杂多关系 SQL 工作负载的附加案例研究中，也证明了其鲁棒性、可扩展性和在实际分析场景中的应用潜力。

Conclusion: LYNX 通过其创新的多智能体协作和迭代修订机制，显著提高了 LLM 在复杂模式和领域语义下的数据分析能力，解决了现有方法的局限性，并在效率和准确性方面取得了优异的成果，展示了其在实际应用中的巨大潜力。

Abstract: LLM-powered data analytics aims to translate natural language instructions into executable analytical programs over underlying data. However, existing approaches, whether treating LLMs as intent-to-code translators or as standalone analytical engines, often fail to reliably align domain semantics with complex schemas and heterogeneous metadata, resulting in brittle execution and semantically inconsistent analytical outputs in real-world workloads. We present LYNX, a multi-agent framework that formulates LLM-driven analytics as a schema- and knowledge-constrained analysis problem rather than a single-pass generation task. LYNX organizes analytical synthesis into a closed-loop workflow of planning, generation, verification, and refinement through three role-specialized agents that collaboratively enforce schema grounding, semantic consistency, and execution correctness. To address domain ambiguity and schema misalignment, LYNX integrates Semantic-Structural Distillation and Stage-Aware Allocation (SSD-SAA). A delta-guided iterative revision continuously diagnoses and repairs semantic and execution-level failures, substantially improving synthesis robustness. We evaluate LYNX on two NL-to-SQL benchmarks, BIRD-SQL Mini-Dev and the more challenging Spider 2.0-Lite. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance and efficiency, achieving 10.66% to 59.54% execution accuracy across lightweight and commercial models, while reducing token consumption by 70.53% compared with the prior most efficient method. Our framework displays high generalization over different backbones, from open-source, lightweight models to the latest commercial models. Additional case studies on quantitative finance analytics and complex multi-relational SQL workloads further demonstrate the framework's robustness, scalability, and practical applicability in real-world analytical scenarios.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 研究推导出了亚线性反事实遗憾的充分条件，并建立了本地生成可靠性与长期性能之间的联系。具体来说，确定了质量、覆盖范围和硬预算之间的权衡关系，并为包含重复策略增长和不完美验证的原生实例提供了理论保证。

Conclusion: 本研究为反思性语言代理在资源受限的场景下，通过本地反思实现长期性能提升提供了坚实的理论基础。研究结果表明，通过满足特定的条件，本地的反思机制可以有效转化为全局代理的长期性能保证，并明确了实现这一目标的权衡因素。

Abstract: Reflective language agents reuse feedback and memory to adapt across tasks without updating model weights. Besides, local generation reliability yields a cumulative generation opportunity bound, linking policy acquisition to long-term performance through an explicit quality, coverage, and hard-budget tradeoff. </details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 与传统的路线规划求解器相比，GREAT-ESDD在相似的定价决策时间预算下，利润增加了约11%。该框架能够成功估计客户偏好，在仅5天的模拟运营后，其表现优于静态定价策略。

Abstract: Online, same-day delivery requires operators to constantly update their routes, and the routing cost for deliveries increases with the number of customers. Out-of-home (OOH) delivery options can help companies handle increasing customer numbers while keeping delivery costs low. We develop a dynamic pricing-and-routing framework for this online ordering scenario with home and OOH delivery options. First, we develop a neural solver for the capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) based on the Graph-Edge-Attention-Network (GREAT). We train it to solve CVRP with varying instance sizes and starting conditions, allowing it to reoptimize partially executed routes under changing conditions. It is fast while achieving solution quality competitive with traditional baselines. Our solver processes several CVRP instances in parallel in batches and we use it to solve the candidate routing problems that arise from an incoming customer's choice of home or OOH delivery. This provides an estimate of the delivery cost increase per option, which we use to set dynamic prices. Further, it directly provides the updated route once the customer decides. We trade off delivery fees against routing costs and steer customers toward OOH delivery when home delivery would be costly. However, effective steering requires us to know the customer preferences. To learn those online, we use Thompson sampling with a Laplace-approximated posterior. We call the resulting framework GREAT-ESDD (GREAT for Effectively Steered Delivery Decisions). Compared to a traditional routing solver, it increases profit by around 11% under a similar pricing decision time budget. Moreover, we show that we can estimate customer preferences successfully, outperforming a static pricing strategy after only 5 days of simulated operations.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公开网络流量数据集太短，无法对预测模型进行长期的、考虑年周期性和行为漂移的评估，而这对于网络流量管理和异常检测至关重要。

Abstract: Forecast-based models are fundamental to network traffic management and anomaly detection. However, it is essential to evaluate these forecasting models over extended periods of time in order to assess their adaptability to unexpected phenomena and shifts in underlying patterns. This kind of long-term evaluation requires multi-year data to account for yearly seasonality and behavioral drift. Existing public datasets are too short to support such long-horizon forecasting tasks. We introduce CESNET-TimeSeries26, comprising 995 days of continuous traffic time series from the CESNET3 network, together with a single subnet spanning approximately 4.5 years. The dataset captures 278,466 IP addresses, 285 institutions, and 566 institutional subnets at three aggregation intervals. The dataset provides a definitive longitudinal benchmark for evaluating forecasting models in both operational management and security monitoring. We demonstrate that annual seasonality is the dominant periodic component. Moreover, we show that a forecasting model can exploit the annual component only when its training window covers at least one complete annual cycle, which no sub-year dataset provides.

</details>

*Jianfeng Lin,Runze Wang,Haorong Hong,Yuxuan Xie,Zeno Zeng,Zhongyuan Liu*

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: ASIWorld是一个评估自主代理在持久化环境中长期目标执行能力的有效工具。通过任务结果、执行行为和相关成本的综合评估，可以更深入地理解代理的性能和决策过程。

Abstract: Evaluating autonomous agents requires examining whether they can translate goals into coherent action across extended interactions. In persistent environments, this requires coordinating interdependent actions under incomplete observations, accounting for delayed effects, and adapting as earlier decisions shape subsequent opportunities. We introduce ASIWorld, a survival sandbox that combines persistent world and character state with character-scoped observations and a programmable asynchronous interface to study sustained goal execution. Agents pursue interdependent production and exploration tasks through direct actions or agent-authored programs that continue running between model calls. The evaluation assesses task success, the attainment of development achievements, and survival costs, complemented by an analysis of execution behavior. In an exploratory study of nine agent configurations using a common harness, eight complete the production task and six complete both tasks. Analyses of execution trajectories and performance across difficulty levels reveal different preparation, combat, and recovery behaviors among configurations with similar task outcomes. Incomplete preparation is associated with stalled progression, while configurations that complete the tasks differ in survival costs and the fulfillment of additional achievement criteria. These findings illustrate the value of assessing sustained goal execution through both task outcomes and the behaviors and costs associated with achieving them.

</details>

*Mingqin Yu,Fethi Rabhi,Liming Zhu,Qinghua Lu*
