Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have shown strong potential for embodied vision-language navigation (VLN), yet their performance degrades on long-horizon trajectories due to context-length limits, redundant historical observations, and unstable spatial alignment across time. These issues make it difficult to both compress long navigation histories and reliably reuse past spatial experience. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{MemoryVLN}, a unified memory-driven navigation system built around memory construction and management. During memory construction, \emph{Long Sequence Compression} employs forgetting-curve-inspired temporal sampling to preserve dense recent evidence and sparse yet representative distant observations under a limited token budget. \emph{Ego-Aware Memory Representation} further integrates 2D semantic tokens, 3D geometric tokens, and 6D agent poses, allowing each memory to encode both what was observed and where it was observed. During memory management, \emph{Hierarchical Memory Bank} maintains in-episode and context-level memories through cross-context warm-start and confidence-controlled write-back. \emph{Memory Enhancement} then retrieves the Top-$K$ relevant memories according to the current navigation state and fuses them with the current visual tokens. Together, these mechanisms transform raw navigation history into compact, spatially grounded, selectively retrievable, and reusable navigation experience. Extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE demonstrate consistent improvements over the state-of-the-art baselines by a substantial margin (i.e., 2\% and 6.5\% in successful rate).

Abstract: Task planning for robots in off-site construction prefabrication is primarily manual, leading to planning inefficiencies and reluctance to adopt robotic solutions. Existing approaches provide limited support for scalable, modular automated task planning and localized runtime replanning. This paper proposes APTree, a model-driven framework that integrates automated task planning with modular task execution using behavior trees as the execution model. We evaluate APTree on the real-world livMatS Biomimetic Shell pavilion, where it models the construction robotic fabrication domain, detects injected specification and planning errors at design time and runtime, and automatically generates large-scale task plans by coordinating three symbolic planners across numerous planning modules. A machine-checked formal analysis further shows that composed execution and local replanning are safe under explicitly stated assumptions, including planner soundness and non-interference of generated plans, providing practitioners with explicit conditions for dependable plan composition. APTree thus enables construction practitioners to leverage automated task planning without requiring detailed knowledge of symbolic planning techniques or APTree's internal implementation.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves robot foundation models (RFMs) beyond their demonstrations, but real-world deployment demands more: learning new tasks efficiently while retaining previously acquired behaviors. Existing continual RL methods on top of VLAs mitigate forgetting but rely on on-policy updates with limited forward transfer, whereas off-policy methods improve single-task sample efficiency without addressing learner persistence across tasks. We propose ACCRUE, a continual off-policy RL framework that carries lightweight actor and critic networks across tasks, allowing each stage to reuse behavioral and value knowledge acquired through prior RL. The inherited critic adapts only on current-task transitions and guides current-task actor learning, while prior behavior is preserved by distilling the actor toward cached targets on a small number of retained episodes. Fixed visual features keep the inherited learner and its replay compatible with base-policy updates. Across contact-rich assembly sequences in simulation and on real-robot hardware, ACCRUE accelerates subsequent-task learning with near-zero forgetting and significantly reduces real-robot training time by 31.0\% to 68.5\%.

</details>

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies perform manipulation tasks using camera images and language instructions, but object slip or visual occlusion can disrupt execution. Recovery is typically learned during policy training or delegated to a monitor that triggers a scripted repair after detecting a failure. We introduce ForkCast, a predictive recovery framework that compares counterfactual futures to determine whether and how to intervene in a frozen VLA policy. At each decision point, ForkCast evaluates three candidates: executing the policy's nominal action chunk (Commit), adjusting the camera viewpoint (Reobserve), and replanning the arm trajectory (Replan). A candidate-conditioned world model forecasts the latent outcome of each candidate at a common future horizon, and a shared task-progress head scores the predicted outcomes. By evaluating the policy's own continuation alongside the repair candidates, a single comparison based on task progress determines both whether and how to intervene, without a failure detector, an intervention threshold, or updates to the VLA backbone. On five simulated RoboTwin 2.0 tasks with injected occlusion and object slip, ForkCast increases pooled success from 13.3% for the frozen $π_{0.5}$ policy to 30.0% and transfers to two additional VLA backbones without updating ForkCast. After adaptation on real-robot candidate rollouts, ForkCast also improves success over the base policy under both clean and visibility-limited conditions. Code will be released to benefit the research community.

Abstract: Reliable robot autonomy requires reasoning about the world from partial and noisy observations. However, many perception systems model only visible scene regions, rely on fixed semantic categories, and assume reliable sensor measurements. These assumptions break under occlusion, novel object encounters, and sensor degradation. In this paper, I present a research vision for incompleteness-aware scene understanding. I organize this vision around three fundamental challenges: incomplete evidence, incomplete knowledge, and incomplete sensor reliability. I discuss my research contributions toward addressing these challenges through amodal perception, semantic occupancy forecasting, open-world scene understanding, label-efficient learning, and uncertainty-guided multi-modal fusion. Building on these contributions, I outline future research directions toward belief-centric 4D scene representations. These representations aim to jointly model geometry, semantics, motion, and uncertainty. I also discuss active sensing and safe adaptation strategies that allow robots to reduce uncertainty through interaction. The goal is to develop calibrated and actionable scene representations that support reliable autonomy in dynamic, open-world environments.

Abstract: World models (WMs) and world-action models (WAMs) focus on future world prediction and executable action generation, respectively. Although these models learn shared physical dynamics and interaction semantics from embodied trajectories, they are typically trained in isolation, which restricts knowledge reuse between prediction and control. At deployment, a plug-in adaptive interface router (PAIR) learns from a small subset of target-task chunk scenarios to select a suitable WAM interface for each execution chunk, balancing task success and execution efficiency while keeping the backbone frozen.

Abstract: Current recipes for robot learning require massive amounts of robot demonstrations to obtain robust and adaptive policies. In this work, we introduce Steertuning, a system that enables robots to learn new tasks in new environments from 5 human demonstrations in under 5
  Steertuning consists of two parts. (1) We pretrain a 400M-parameter diffusion policy on our egocentric human dataset, which consists of 100 hours of densely annotated random interactions. Abstract: A robot needs a world model that predicts how its actions will change the scene and a policy that chooses those actions. Models are usually built and evaluated for only one of these roles, and every robot records its actions in its own format. We ask whether one robot world model can serve both roles across different bodies, and what makes this work. We present GreenWAM, a world foundation model for robotics, together with the recipe that produces it: (1) a shared anatomical action space that describes 20 robot families, from bimanual arms to dexterous humanoids, in common joint coordinates; (2) joint training on these families in visual, action-conditioned and world-action modes; and (3) policies that split an action expert off the generator. As a world model, GreenWAM attains top-tier trajectory, depth and 3D accuracy on WorldArena 1.0, ahead of every world-action model and video generator in our comparison. We further adapt GreenWAM to a real humanoid, where it succeeds more often than policies adapted from $π_{0.5}$ and from Cosmos 3 Edge, and distill it into a single-step policy for real-time control. Controlled experiments yield three findings: robot specialization improves world prediction and control together; an action expert helps when split off at the start of adaptation; and keeping world-model modes during policy adaptation preserves robustness to scene changes.

Abstract: Long-term robot autonomy depends on more than effective action generation: a policy must recognize when its behavior is no longer sufficiently supported and use assistance to improve. We introduce Equilibrium Energy Control (EqC), a framework for introspective lifelong robot learning built around an explicit conditional energy landscape. EqC casts generative action refinement as equilibrium-seeking optimization, while the geometry of the refinement process reveals whether the generated behavior remains consistent with the learned landscape. This competence signal enables Energy-Gated DAgger, where persistent energy-consistency violations trigger expert takeover and the resulting recovery trajectories are aggregated for subsequent policy updates. EqC integrates naturally into both Diffusion Transformer policies and flow-matching-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies. Across simulation and real-world bimanual manipulation, EqC matches or improves control performance and robustness while enabling timely intervention near the policy's competence boundary. A real-world study further shows how these interventions progressively expand the range of situations handled autonomously, providing a practical path from static generative controllers toward self-improving robot systems.

</details>

Abstract: Frontier language-model agents can now improve robots on their own: they write control code, test it, and keep what works as skills and memories for the next task. We introduce SEAR (Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics), a framework and benchmark built around two questions. Is the agent really learning, or just trying more often? And does what it learns still help on new tasks, in a new simulator, and on a real robot? The framework runs an agent in three modes: it writes code that becomes the policy (code-as-policy), acts live in the control loop (agent-as-policy), or works as a researcher that fine-tunes a vision-language-action model (auto-research). The benchmark adds controls that separate retained experience from repeated attempts, familiar tasks, privileged simulator state, larger budgets, and luck. Across seven frontier language models, 330 simulated and five physical tasks, and over four years of agent runtime, we highlight three findings. First, the learning curve of a robotic agent depends both on the overall time budget and the task difficulty relative to model capability. Harder tasks make longer sessions worthwhile; on easier tasks, re-rolling short attempts does just as well. Second, control code and shared routines transfer across tasks and simulators, while task-specific solutions do not. On a real robot, we observe a performance gap between agent-designed practice and novel human-designed scenes. Third, different models evolve more effectively in different ways. Some do best acting live, others writing code first. And a text-only model keeps pace with a comparable multimodal one: perception helps with error assessment, but agentic reasoning and tool use can matter more. We release the benchmark and codebase to support future research.

Abstract: Egocentric human videos offer a scalable alternative to robot teleoperation for collecting dexterous manipulation data. However, two challenges limit their use as reliable training data: accurate hand-object interaction (HOI) reconstruction from monocular RGB and high-quality robot demonstrations, especially visual observations. We present EgoMatrix, an end-to-end data engine that converts monocular egocentric human videos into bimanual dexterous trajectories and paired robot observation videos, with the trajectories directly replayable on real robots. It reconstructs HOI with emphasis on relative geometry and contact rather than exact metric scene recovery, then uses retargeting and reinforcement learning (RL) to reproduce the demonstrated tasks in simulation. We jointly render robot hands and objects from these simulated trajectories to produce physically faithful observations synchronized with state and control records. Rendering the same trajectories in diverse, task-compatible backgrounds expands paired training data while preserving robot-object motion and contact. Across TACO, OakInk2, and self-collected data, EgoMatrix achieves 54.84% end-to-end success in simulation versus 14.52% for the strongest baseline. Reconstruction reaches state-of-the-art performance on most metrics of the two public benchmarks. Qualitative results show more faithful hand-object interactions than prior methods, while feature-space analysis shows closer alignment with real-robot observations than GPT-6 Astra. Our project page is available at https://spikew726.github.io/EgoMatrix/.

Abstract: We introduce WorldOracle, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) against paired real-world executions. Given the same initial observation and low-level action sequence, WorldOracle asks whether a predicted rollout reproduces what happens in the real world, including physical consequences and task-state transitions. We evaluate models along four complementary dimensions: physical state correctness, interaction spatial alignment, key interaction area fidelity, and multi-view action coherence. To support this evaluation, we curate real-world training and evaluation suites that cover different interaction dynamics and embodiments. The evaluation suite contains long, multi-segment episodes with both successful and failed executions, enabling evaluation across varied action outcomes and behavior distributions. Experiments on seven representative ACWMs reveal distinct model strengths and failure modes. WorldOracle provides a systematic foundation for measuring and advancing action-conditioned world modeling for manipulation. We will release the datasets, evaluation code, and leaderboard.

Each axis has five severity levels, yielding 210 conditions across the four LIBERO suites. We evaluate nine recent vision-language-action models using 500 episodes per condition and substantiate each finding with rigorous statistical tests. Pooled success falls from 0.932 to 0.767 at the middle severity and 0.509 at the highest severity. Abstract: In-context robot learning enables robots to acquire new behaviors from demonstrations without test-time parameter updates. However, visual and kinematic specifications alone may not distinguish contact-rich behaviors that share similar motions but require different interaction intensities or patterns. We propose Contact Trajectory Prompting (CTP), a framework for one-shot transfer of contact-rich manipulation behaviors. CTP encodes motion and contact information from a single demonstration into an ordered contact trajectory prompt that captures their temporal evolution and specifies the desired physical interaction behavior. During execution, the policy uses online sensory feedback to retrieve interaction-relevant information from the prompt, conditioning closed-loop action generation on the demonstrated contact behavior. Across real-world wiping, rotation, and insertion tasks on objects excluded from training, CTP achieves 78.7% overall success, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline by 13.0 percentage points. Changing only the reference demonstration enables CTP to follow contact specifications for both intensity and direction, including an intermediate wiping force level and clockwise or counterclockwise cap rotation. These results demonstrate that contact trajectories serve as effective behavioral specifications, extending in-context robot learning beyond motion imitation to physical interaction transfer. Abstract: Collaborative planning under operational constraints is essential for heterogeneous robot teams in large-scale missions. Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) provide rapid area coverage but are limited by onboard energy, while Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGVs) can serve as mobile recharging stations yet are constrained by road-network traversability. Effective collaboration must enforce operational constraints during execution while enabling parallel, coordinated actions. Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) have shown promise through token unmasking but have two key limitations: entropy-guided scheduling assumes distributional alignment and reliance on differentiable constraints for diffusion-time optimization. We propose Masked Error-bounded Neuro-Symbolic Diffusion (MEND), which formulates collaborative planning as a conditional masked generative process to generate context-aware action sequences for UAV-UGV teams. MEND introduces a neuro-symbolic diffusion paradigm that constrains conditional masked diffusion policies at execution by reweighting the learned action distribution with a logic-induced admissibility indicator, thereby enforcing compliance with operational constraints. MEND introduces an error-bounded inference scheduling at execution that constructs the unmasking schedule by selecting positions with minimal predictive entropy over the constraint-aware action distribution, enhancing collaborative planning optimality under operational constraints. Extensive experimental results in simulation, on real-world maps, and with physical robot teams demonstrate that MEND advances UAV-UGV collaborative planning under operational constraints.

</details>

Abstract: Expert demonstrations show how to complete contact-rich tasks, but provide limited coverage of how interaction forces respond to different actions. Task-agnostic play provides broader experience of contact dynamics without specifying task goals. To fully leverage these two types of data, we introduce ForceWAM, a force world action model that decouples knowledge of task-compatible interaction outcomes from knowledge of how local actions change contact. A world model learns from successful demonstrations to jointly predict future video and six-axis force/torque trajectories. Together, these futures describe the expected evolution of motion and contact during the task. A separate inverse dynamics model (IDM) learns from both task and play, mapping current observations and recorded visual-wrench futures to their associated robot actions. Play data thus provide knowledge of force responses for goal-directed execution. At deployment, the IDM reactively translates generated futures into actions, reusing them with fresh wrench feedback between world-model updates. Across real-robot force-regulated sliding, box flipping with and without disturbances, and ring placement, ForceWAM achieves $85$-$95\%$ mean success, surpassing world-modeling and reactive baselines. Our experiments further show that adding task-agnostic play data improves success by $15$-$45$ percentage points, demonstrating its value for learning contact-rich execution. Project page and code are available at https://force-wam.github.io/.

Abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires robots to coordinate not only where to move, but also how contact and force should evolve throughout an interaction. Yet most robot policies represent actions primarily as motion trajectories, using tactile signals as inputs or auxiliary prediction targets without explicitly encoding contact dynamics in the action representation. We propose ILA (Interaction Latents as Actions), which uses decodable interaction latents that jointly capture the evolution of motion, contact, and force application as policy action units, providing a shared representation for action generation, evaluation, and offline improvement. We learn these latents through visually conditioned joint action-tactile reconstruction with a time-conditioned implicit decoder. Using them as flow-matching generation targets supports post-training of pretrained vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world action models (WAMs), as well as training flow-matching policies from scratch. A shared decoder maps generated latents to executable actions. For offline improvement, we learn a tactile-conditioned expert reference model from interaction latents encoded from expert demonstrations. The resulting expert-consistency rewards guide weighted learning from successful rollouts, while observation-compatible expert references guide correction of low-reward predictions from failed rollouts. Across three policy families, ILA improves success rates averaged over four real-world tasks by 21.0-36.5 percentage points relative to tactile-conditioned direct-action baselines. Ablations highlight the benefit of encoding contact evolution in action targets beyond tactile conditioning, while the same latent space supports expert-guided offline improvement. Project website: https://mrsecant.github.io/ILA/.

</details>

Abstract: Safe autonomous driving requires more than accurate planning at a single frame: it demands reliable closed-loop execution in dynamic environments. Although end-to-end driving policies have advanced rapidly, the accumulated closed-loop errors, especially in unseen scenarios, can push vehicles into states from which the same policy struggles to recover. We address the challenge by treating closed-loop driving safety as a test-time execution problem. We introduce AutoAgent0, an agentic runtime and harness framework that augments existing driving experts with complementary detection skills, rule-based action verification, and feedback-driven recovery. To address inaccurate scene perception, an independent detection module constructs scene context using complementary perception skills, and a rule-based verifier checks proposed trajectories against this context before execution. When the nominal trajectories are unreliable, the orchestrator of the runtime activates Recovery Planning, where an agentic loop constructs alternative action proposals from action primitives and iteratively refines them using verification feedback. This design combines independent scene assessment with feasibility checks and online recovery, addressing both perception errors and the limited recovery capabilities of individual experts. Evaluations on Fail2Drive and NavSafe-$\infty$ demonstrate improved closed-loop robustness over single-expert execution in long-tail and safety-critical scenarios. These results demonstrate that runtime supervision can improve closed-loop robustness across multiple driving experts without retraining the underlying policies.

</details>

Concretely, reusable calibration fixes participant geometry and sensor attachments before motion inference to disentangle mounting offsets from articulation. A temporal prior then completes unobserved joint motion, while layered constraints promote measurement agreement, temporal continuity, and geometric consistency, properties that motion plausibility alone does not guarantee. Against tracker-fitted references, the method reduces body-point error by 71.9% relative to the strongest baseline; matched evaluations also show gains in hand stability and contact estimation. Abstract: Agentic robotics places a large language model (LLM) agent in the robot control loop, where it composes perception, motion, and vision-language-action (VLA) tools under the guidance of a memory and thereby generalizes to new tasks without retraining. This generality comes at a steep price in efficiency. Every primitive requires a round of LLM reasoning over the full interaction history, so the cost of an episode grows with the number of primitives. We find this reasoning largely redundant: once a sub-goal is chosen, its primitives follow a routine already prescribed by memory. We present ChunkAct, which introduces action chunking to agentic robotics. Online, a single call launches a chunk of chained primitives, which executes autonomously and returns control only upon failure. Offline, ChunkAct compiles the memory into these chunks, so execution is memory-free at test time and the planner is reserved for decisions that require reasoning. LLM computation therefore scales with the number of decisions rather than the number of primitives. On LIBERO-Pro, ChunkAct improves task success by 5.0 points over the state of the art in agentic robotics while requiring 2.9x fewer LLM calls, 4.4x fewer input tokens, and 2.3x fewer output tokens.

</details>

Abstract: Orchard robots need maps that preserve small but semantically important structures such as trunks, trellises, and fruit. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) SLAM achieves high photometric fidelity. However, its optimization remains appearance-driven, and transferring image semantics to 3D points is unreliable for thin structures, whose pixels may receive depth from background surfaces. We present ArborSplat, an online semantic 3DGS SLAM system that tracks with LiDAR odometry and optimizes semantics directly on the Gaussian map, constrained by class-specific height bands above a ground plane fitted to each keyframe's stereo point cloud, and fuses multi-view evidence into a semantic point cloud online while rejecting labels inconsistent with the local ground surface or with monocular depth. Class-constrained refinement reserves Gaussian capacity for underrepresented structures and, under reduced budgets, increases training-view accuracy on tree classes. We evaluate the approach on apple and pear orchards during dormancy, flowering, and harvesting. On full routes, it keeps ATE below 0.5 m on all 12 traversals. On shared 301-frame segments, it exceeds SGS-SLAM and GS3LAM by 0.23 to 0.50 training-view and 0.15 to 0.36 held-out mIoU while running 1.7 to 7.5 times faster, whereas SemGauss-SLAM runs out of GPU memory on all six.

### [1244] [Zero-Crossing Time Lower Bounds for the Homogeneous Super-Twisting Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14285)
*Diego Gutiérrez-Oribio,Ioannis Stefanou*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文研究了标量齐次滑模控制中超扭曲算法的零交叉行为，证明了虽然零交叉可能在有限时间内累积，但具有非零幅度的完整轨迹的零交叉无法在有限时间内累积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决高频切换和抖振问题，尽管超扭曲算法（STA）能产生连续控制输入，但滑模变量仍可能在零点附近反复穿越零点。

Method: 推导了返回零点所需时间和完成一次完整穿越所需时间的下界，并分析了零交叉的累积情况。

Result: 提出了返回零点时间的下界和完整穿越时间的界限，表明具有非零幅度的完整轨迹的零交叉无法在有限时间内累积，但幅度必须消失并满足可和性条件。

Conclusion: 零交叉可能在有限时间内累积，但其关联的、幅度大于任意非零值的完整轨迹的零交叉无法在有限时间内累积。当扰动率界限为零时，估计恢复了齐次性带来的尺度；对于经典的超扭曲算法，即使扰动率界限非零，平方根尺度也成立。

Abstract: High-frequency switching and chattering are well-known problems in sliding-mode control. Although the super-twisting algorithm produces a continuous control input, the sliding variable may still cross zero repeatedly near the sliding manifold. This paper studies how fast these crossings can occur and whether they can accumulate in finite time for the scalar homogeneous super-twisting algorithm. Two lower bounds on the time required to return to zero are derived, together with a bound on the time needed to complete a full excursion. These results give minimum separation times and upper bounds on the number of crossings associated with excursions above a prescribed amplitude. Although zero crossings may accumulate in finite time, the amplitudes of the complete excursions considered here must vanish and satisfy a summability condition. Thus, crossings associated with excursions above any prescribed nonzero amplitude cannot accumulate in finite time. When the perturbation-rate bound is zero, the estimates recover the scaling imposed by homogeneity. For the classical super-twisting algorithm, the square-root scaling also holds for nonzero perturbation-rate bounds. Numerical simulations illustrate the results.

</details>


### [1245] [Large-Scale Data Center Integration in Power Systems: Uncertainty and Multi-Scale Variation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14264)
*Le Xie,Dongjoo Kim,Qian Zhang,Grant Ruan,Paul L. Joskow*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一的框架，用于分析超大规模AI数据中心并网对电网可靠性和成本的影响，该框架考虑了AI工作负载的预测不确定性和多尺度时间变化特性，并结合了实测数据分析了GPU功耗的频谱特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI数据中心作为一种新型的、集中的、快速部署的电力负荷，其并网给现有电网带来了新的挑战，包括预测不确定性和多尺度时间变化。需要一个系统性的方法来评估其对电网可靠性和经济性的影响。

Method: 提出一个包含四个象限（可靠性、经济性、不确定性、变化性）的统一分析框架，该框架整合了概率性资源充足性、发电和输电扩展、运行安全性及市场设计。利用公开的生成式AI工作负载数据集，通过测量GPU功耗的频谱来表征其时间变化特性。

Result: AI数据中心的GPU功耗呈现出与传统负荷不同的“强谐波”频谱特征，而非平滑的宽带行为，且存在秒级甚至亚秒级的周期性。不同工作负载类型（训练、离线推理、在线推理）的主导方差频带不同。这些频谱特征直接影响电网的备用需求、爬坡能力、电压稳定性、穿越性能和换流器密集型电网的谐波交互。

Conclusion: 分析框架和实测结果共同为评估大规模AI数据中心并网在规划和运行层面的可靠性和成本影响奠定了系统级的基础，强调了对AI负荷应采用频谱描述而非峰值需求描述。

Abstract: Hyperscale artificial intelligence (AI) data centers are emerging as a structurally new class of electricity demand. Unlike conventional loads, they materialize as spatially concentrated, transmission-level point loads with rapid deployment timelines and converter-dominated dynamics. Their integration is governed by two defining properties: forecast uncertainty in load realization and multi-scale temporal variation spanning sub-seconds to planning horizons.
  We develop a unified framework that links reliability and affordability to these dimensions through a four-quadrant structure: (reliability, affordability) $\times$ (uncertainty, variation), which integrates probabilistic resource adequacy, generation and transmission expansion, operational security, and market design.
  Measured traces from a public generative-AI workload dataset show strongly tonal GPU power spectra rather than smooth broadband behavior: harmonic combs at the training-step cadence, and a distinct sub-second periodicity in inference. Across these traces the dominant variance band shifts with workload type (seconds for training and offline inference; tens of seconds and longer for online inference). We report this as a characterization of the measured workloads rather than a universal signature, and take it to indicate that such loads warrant a spectral description rather than a peak-demand one. These signatures directly affect reserve requirements, ramping products, voltage stability, ride-through performance, and harmonic interactions in converter-rich grids.
  Taken together, the analytical framework and empirical results establish a system-level basis for assessing the reliability and cost implications of large AI data center integration across planning and operational horizons.

</details>


### [1246] [Deep learning from a control vantage point](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14385)
*Álvaro Rodríguez Abella,João Pedro Silvestre,Bahman Gharesifard,Paulo Tabuada*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文从控制理论的角度回顾了深度学习的最新进展，重点介绍了前馈网络、残差网络、Transformer、大型语言模型和选择性状态空间模型等，并阐述了控制理论在理解其训练、性质和架构设计中的作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了更好地理解深度学习模型（包括其训练、性质和架构设计），并探索控制理论在这些模型中的潜在应用。

Method: 文章通过回顾不同类别的深度学习模型（如残差网络、Transformer、大型语言模型）并解释控制理论如何应用于它们的分析。具体来说，它将残差网络解释为连续时间控制系统的离散化，将Transformer视为共识算法的离散化，并将反向传播与最优控制联系起来。

Result: 1. 残差网络逼近连续函数的能力可通过非标准可控性问题来解决，利用几何非线性控制。2. Transformer架构（大型语言模型的核心）可被视为共识算法的离散化，表明大型语言模型具有共识性。3. 文章整合了离散时间和连续时间模型中反向传播与最优控制之间的联系。

Conclusion: 控制理论为理解和分析深度学习模型提供了一个强大的框架，特别是在功能逼近、模型架构和训练算法方面。未来的研究方向包括探索选择性状态空间模型等新兴模型。

Abstract: This article offers an overview of recent developments in deep learning from a control vantage point. It reviews several classes of models including feedforward and residual neural networks, transformers, large-language models, and selective state space models while explaining how control theory plays an important role in understanding their training, properties, or architecture design. The article explains how residual neural networks can be interpreted as the discretization of a continuous-time control system thereby enabling the use of control theoretic techniques for its analysis. To illustrate the power of this bridge between control and deep learning, two technical results are discussed: 1) the ability of a residual neural network to approximate arbitrary continuous functions is a non-standard controllability problem that can be solved using geometric nonlinear control and 2) transformers, the key architectural component of most large language-models, can be seen the discretization of a consensus algorithm and thus large language-models exhibit consensus. Another point of contact between control theory and deep learning is the connection between backpropagation, the algorithm used to train neural networks, and optimal control. The article addresses how the older connection between these problems, established in the 80's using discrete-time models can be reconciled with the more recent approach using continuous-time models. Several open problems and directions for future research are discussed, including selective state-space models, a recent class of models inspired by the models used in control.

</details>


### [1247] [Spatial-Temporal Hybrid Path Planning for Multi-UAV Methane Emission Rate Quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14471)
*Ruikun Wu,Derek Hollenbeck,Sihua Shao*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一种基于多无人机（UAV）的甲烷排放速率时空混合路径规划策略，以提高测量精度并加快源定位速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了更准确地量化甲烷点源排放率，提高清单核查和泄漏检测的效率，特别是在传统单架无人机和固定轨迹方法的局限性下，需要一种更优的测量策略。

Method: 该研究结合了源受体矩阵（SRM）估计器和经验可观测性格拉米安（EMGR）路径规划，提出了一种新的空间-时间混合路径规划策略。该策略首先利用多无人机进行空间扩散以快速定位源头，然后切换到以一定时间延迟顺序重复领导者轨迹，以减少量化方差。此外，该方法通过使用基于丝状体羽流模拟器（MOABS）的向前高斯羽流模型校准，并对测量数据进行时间平均，以减小模型失配。

Result: 仿真结果表明，空间阶段能显著快于单无人机基线定位源头；时间阶段方差最低但收敛慢；而提出的混合策略比纯时间策略收敛快得多，同时达到相似的稳态精度，且误差范围比纯空间策略更窄。时间平均窗口长度研究表明，较长的平均窗口存在收益递减效应，支持了空间覆盖和时间平均之间的权衡。

Conclusion: 空间-时间混合路径规划策略是一种有效的方法，能够平衡甲烷源定位速度和排放率量化精度，并且在多无人机协作下可以显著优于纯空间或纯时间策略。时间平均窗口的长度选择也需要在精度和效率之间进行权衡。

Abstract: Accurate emission-rate quantification of methane point sources is essential for inventory verification and leak detection. UAV-borne sensing provides high-resolution, near-source measurements, but existing quantification methods mostly follow a predefined trajectory and rely on a single UAV. Building on a source receptor matrix (SRM) estimator and empirical observability Gramian (EMGR)-based path planning, this paper proposes a spatial-temporal hybrid path planning strategy for multi-UAV methane emission rate quantification. Measurements are time-averaged, and the forward Gaussian plume model is calibrated against a filament-based plume simulator (MOABS) to reduce model mismatch. Cooperating UAVs first spread out spatially to locate the source quickly, then switch to sequentially retracing a leader trajectory with a time lag to reduce quantification variance. Simulations show that the spatial stage localizes the source markedly faster than a single-UAV baseline, the temporal stage yields the lowest variance but converges slowly, and the proposed hybrid strategy converges substantially faster than the purely temporal strategy while matching its steady-state accuracy, with a narrower error band than the purely spatial strategy. A window-length study further shows that longer time-averaging windows exhibit diminishing returns, justifying the balance between spatial coverage and temporal averaging.

</details>


### [1248] [Encrypted collision avoidance maneuver via variational optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14501)
*Yeongjun Jang,Jihoon Suh,Kenshiro Oguri,Takashi Tanaka*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于同态加密（HE）的加密碰撞规避机动（CAM）设计协议，允许用户在不泄露私有协方差的情况下，将CAM设计外包给不可信服务器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的CAM设计需要共享私有协方差信息，这在与不可信服务器交互时存在隐私泄露风险。需要一种在保护隐私的前提下进行CAM设计的方法。

Method: 将约束CAM优化问题重新表述为基于采样的估计问题，并采用变分方法，使得依赖私有协方差的项可以在同态加密下高效计算。协议仅需一轮通信。

Result: 在六个真实世界的目标交汇数据消息上进行了实验，结果表明与使用公共协方差设计的CAM相比，所提出的方法在可行性上有所提高，并能减少燃料消耗。

Conclusion: 提出的基于同态加密的CAM设计协议能够安全地将CAM设计外包给不可信服务器，同时保护用户隐私，并在实际应用中展现出优于使用公共协方差的CAM设计的性能。

Abstract: We propose an encrypted collision avoidance maneuver (CAM) design protocol using homomorphic encryption (HE) that enables operators to outsource CAM design to an untrusted server without revealing their private covariance. To this end, we reformulate the constrained CAM optimization as a sampling based estimation problem via a variational approach, so that the private covariance dependent terms can be efficiently evaluated under HE. The protocol requires only a single round of communication, and experiments on six real-world conjunction data messages demonstrate improved feasibility and reduced fuel consumption compared with CAMs designed using public covariance.

</details>


### [1249] [Shifted-Chart Composition for Horizon-Optimal Time-Varying LQR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14621)
*Viswas Dinesh,Spandan Roy*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 解析错误


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解析错误

Method: 解析错误

Result: 解析错误

Conclusion: 解析错误

Abstract: Horizon optimization in finite-horizon LQR treats the horizon $T$ as a decision variable and adds a penalty $wT$ to the cost. Recent composition-based methods evaluate all candidate horizons in $O(Nn^3)$, instead of the $O(N^2n^3)$ of one Riccati recursion per horizon, but they track the inverse cost-to-go $P^{-1}$ and therefore require every stage and terminal cost to be positive definite, whereas LQR requires only positive semidefiniteness. This excludes costs that leave some states unpenalized. In this work, we track instead the shifted inverse $\widehat{P}_k=(P_k+cI)^{-1}$, the inverse coordinate after a symplectic shear of the state-costate variables. Its domain contains every positive semidefinite Riccati matrix, and $P_k=\widehat{P}_k^{-1}-cI$ recovers the Riccati solution. We show that the shift can be absorbed into the stage coefficients of the inverse-coordinate composition, so the $O(Nn^3)$ search carries over, exact in exact arithmetic, subject to invertibility conditions. These hold for all small $c$ when the dynamics contract the unpenalized directions, fail for at most finitely many $c$ outside a degenerate case, and are certified per horizon at run time. In our experiments, diagonal loading $Q_k+\varepsilon I$ either left cost errors several orders of magnitude above those of the shifted chart or, for small fixed $\varepsilon$, selected the wrong horizon. The shifted chart with a fixed default $c$ selected the correct horizon on all tested instances, reporting long horizons as uncertified in one stress case.

</details>


### [1250] [Defending Consensus-Based Cooperative Sensing Against Conformity-Driven Byzantine Attacks in 6G UAV Swarm Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14639)
*Ruixing Ren,Junhui Zhao,He Fang,Xiaoke Sun,Jiamin Li,Pengcheng Zhu,Dongming Wang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的方法来防御拜占庭攻击在无人机群的 ISAC 系统中，通过模拟进化博弈论来动态调整正常节点的错误概率，从而维持高精度的态势感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的通信融合模型假设节点错误是固定的且独立的，这与拜占庭攻击下正常节点错误动态变化的现实不符，导致防御效果不佳。因此，需要一种新的防御策略来应对这种动态变化。

Method: 文章采用进化博弈论来刻画攻击诱导的正常节点错误动态，并将由此获得的规律传递给融合中心，使其能够动态校正正常节点的真实错误水平。

Result: 仿真结果表明，该方法能够在各种攻击强度和网络规模下，维持近乎完美的态势感知推理，同时支持低延迟决策。

Conclusion: 该方法能够有效防御 ISAC-6G 无人机群感知中的拜占庭攻击，并通过动态校正错误概率来维持高精度态势感知。文章还讨论了实现安全 ISAC-6G 蜂群感知所面临的挑战。

Abstract: In integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) enabled six-generation (6G) networks, unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarms increasingly rely on consensus-based cooperative sensing: each node iteratively exchanges and fuses decisions with its neighbors to approach a global picture of the environment, supporting the high-reliability, low-latency inference demanded by mission-critical tasks. Yet this very mechanism of conformity becomes the lever of Byzantine attacks. By exploiting the update rule, malicious nodes manufacture a false consensus that lures honest nodes into drifting away from their true observations round after round, so that a normal node's actual error probability evolves dynamically and rises far above its intrinsic sensing error. Conventional fusion models, which assume node errors are fixed and independent, are therefore severely mismatched. This article argues for a different defensive perspective: instead of hunting for bad nodes, we seek to understand how good nodes turn bad, characterizing the inducement dynamics with evolutionary game theory and handing this law to the fusion center so that it can dynamically correct the true error level of normal nodes. Simulations show that the approach sustains near-perfect situational inference across a wide range of attack intensities and network sizes, while naturally supporting low latency decisions. We further discuss several open challenges on the path toward secure ISAC-6G swarm sensing.

</details>


### [1251] [Decision-Focused Learning for Optimal Battery Scheduling Under Load and Photovoltaic Power Uncertainty in Microgrids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14782)
*Marios Saleptsis,Antoine Lesage-Landry,Marco Mussetta,Sonia Leva*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种决策聚焦学习（DFL）框架，直接在微电网运营成本上训练预测模型，以优化电池储能系统（BESS）的调度，相比于传统的准确率优化方法，显著降低了运营成本，尤其是在电网受限的条件下。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的预测-优化范式使用对预测误差的成本影响不敏感的统计准确性指标来训练预测器，这对于需要准确日前预测以优化BESS调度的微电网来说是不够的。

Method: 提出了一种决策聚焦学习（DFL）框架，通过隐式微分将梯度的反向传播应用于两阶段能源管理系统的运营成本，从而直接在成本上训练门控循环单元（GRU）预测器，使其能够内化调度问题的惩罚结构。

Result: 与基于准确率优化的基线相比，DFL框架在正常电网条件下将运营成本降低了3.78%，在电网受限条件下降低了30.60%，并且几乎消除了负载甩负荷事件。DFL训练的预测器虽然统计误差较高，但实际运营成本更低。

Conclusion: DFL框架能够通过直接优化运营成本来训练预测器，从而提高微电网BESS调度的效率，证明了预测准确性和决策质量之间并非单调关系，尤其是在受限的微电网调度场景下。

Abstract: The increasing penetration of renewable energy sources in microgrids demands accurate day-ahead forecasting to support optimal battery energy storage system (BESS) scheduling. Yet the conventional predict-then-optimize paradigm trains forecasters on statistical accuracy metrics that are agnostic to the asymmetric and time-varying cost impacts of forecast errors. This work proposes a decision-focused learning (DFL) framework that trains gated recurrent unit forecasters for both load demand and photovoltaic generation directly on the downstream operational cost of a two-stage energy management system, where day-ahead BESS commitments are fixed prior to real-time balancing. Gradients are backpropagated from the real-time operational cost through both optimization stages to the forecaster weights via implicit differentiation, enabling the forecasters to internalize the penalty structure of the scheduling problem. The framework is validated on the MG2Lab experimental microgrid testbed at Politecnico di Milano across two operational scenarios of increasing grid constraint and eight forecasting configurations comprising single-source and combined-forecaster settings. Results illustrate that the DFL-trained pipeline reduces operational cost by 3.78% under normal grid conditions and by 30.60% under grid-constrained conditions relative to the accuracy- optimized baseline, while nearly eliminating load shedding events. Notably, the DFL forecasters exhibit higher statistical errors than their accuracy-trained counterparts yet achieve consistently lower operational costs, confirming that forecast accuracy and decision quality do not share a monotonic relationship in constrained microgrid scheduling.

</details>


### [1252] [An Adaptive Cyber-Resilient Framework for P2P Energy Trading under Optimal Stealthy Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14858)
*Devangi,Yashasvi Bansal,Ankit Singhal*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种针对点对点（P2P）能源交易市场的攻击检测和缓解框架，通过设计隐蔽攻击、开发基于Mahalanobis Boosting的检测器以及实施自适应rho缓解策略，提高了网络安全性和市场鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着P2P能源交易的普及，通信基础设施和分布式协调机制的依赖性增加，导致网络攻击面扩大，现有检测机制难以发现隐蔽的操纵行为，从而威胁到P2P能源市场的稳定运行。

Method: 1. 设计一种最优隐蔽攻击，旨在最大化对微电网的经济破坏，同时保持ADMM市场清算过程的表观收敛特性。 2. 开发一种基于Mahalanobis Boosting的检测器，利用市场层特征捕捉特征间的依赖关系，以区分被篡改的更新和正常的市场运行。 3. 引入一种自适应rho缓解策略，用于限制受损信息的传播，并在检测到攻击后恢复市场鲁棒性。

Result: 该框架在案例研究中展现了有效性，攻击检测准确率达到98.49%。提出的缓解策略将运营成本降低了约18.43%，与未缓解的攻击情况相比。

Conclusion: 该研究提出了一种切实可行的方法，为构建值得信赖且网络安全的分布式P2P能源交易系统提供了解决方案，有效应对了隐蔽的网络攻击。

Abstract: The increasing adoption of peer to peer energy trading has enabled prosumers to actively participate in decentralized energy markets. However, the growing dependence of P2P energy markets on communication infrastructures and distributed coordination mechanisms introduces an expanded cyberattack surface, enabling sophisticated adversaries to manipulate market interactions while remaining concealed from conventional detection mechanisms. This paper first designs an optimal stealthy attack that maximizes economic disruption of the MicroGrids, while preserving the apparent convergence characteristics of the ADMM based market-clearing process. To detect such attacks, a Mahalanobis Boosting detector is developed using market layer features to effectively capture inter feature dependencies and distinguish compromised updates from normal market operation. An adaptive rho based mitigation strategy is then introduced to limit the propagation of compromised information and restore robust market operation once an attack is flagged. The effectiveness of the proposed framework is demonstrated through comprehensive case studies, achieving an attack detection accuracy of 98.49% while the proposed mitigation strategy reduces the operating cost by approximately 18.43% compared to the unmitigated attack case. The proposed approach provides a practical pathway toward trustworthy and cyber-secure distributed P2P energy trading systems.

</details>


### [1253] [Relining or Replacement: How Timing, Costs, and Infrastructure Shape U.S. Primary Steel Decarbonization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14865)
*Mohamed Atouife,Yuezhang He,Jesse D. Jenkins*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该研究利用工厂级产能规划和随机操作模型，量化了美国高炉炼钢厂转向直接还原过程的成本、基础设施和财政需求，并提供了不同减排路径下的成本估算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 美国即将面临高炉大修的投资窗口期，这为钢铁行业脱碳提供了机会。作者旨在量化高炉转向直接还原的成本、基础设施和财政需求，以指导决策。

Method: 研究采用了工厂级产能规划和随机操作建模的方法，分析了在供应侧激励下，将遗留高炉厂转变为直接还原厂的成本、基础设施和财政要求。

Result: 在基线假设下，与高炉成本（包括大修）相比，近零排放的氢基直接还原的补贴后溢价为每吨钢272至427美元，天然气基生产的溢价为每吨钢115至181美元。年产200万吨钢的代表性工厂需要约4至6.5吉瓦的可再生能源发电和0.7至1.1吉瓦时的电池储能。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，更换时机与成本、基础设施和公众支持密切相关。建议通过清洁能源驱动的天然气基直接还原实现有序过渡，以避免高炉大修，将排放量减少57%，并为通过氢气替代或碳捕获实现更深层次脱碳保留选项。

Abstract: Imminent blast furnace relinings create a consequential investment window for U.S. primary steel decarbonization. Using plant-level capacity planning and stochastic operations modeling, we quantify the costs, infrastructure, and fiscal requirements to transition legacy blast furnace sites to direct reduction under supply-side incentives. Under baseline assumptions, post-subsidy premiums above average blast furnace costs, including relining, are 272 to 427 dollars per ton of steel for near-zero-emission hydrogen-based direct reduction and 115 to 181 dollars for natural-gas-based production. Representative facilities producing two million tons of steel annually at legacy locations require approximately 4 to 6.5 and 0.7 to 1.1 GW of renewable generation and battery storage, respectively. This translates to 65 and 12 GW across the unrelined fleet for hydrogen- and natural gas-based pathways, respectively. These findings connect replacement timing to costs, infrastructure, and public support, motivating a sequenced transition through clean-powered natural-gas-based direct reduction to avert blast furnace relining, reduce emissions by 57 percent relative to blast furnaces, and preserve options for deeper decarbonization through hydrogen substitution or carbon capture.

</details>


### [1254] [On the Structural Optimization of Industrial Control Systems Using Metaheuristic Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15052)
*Ruslan Zakirzyanov*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种结合了确定性层次构建和改进的蚁群优化（ACO）的混合方法，用于自动化过程控制系统（APCS）的成本最优硬件架构设计，该方法在处理大规模实例时比遗传算法（GA）、粒子群优化（PSO）和模拟退火（SA）等方法更有效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化过程控制系统（APCS）的成本最优硬件架构设计是一个NP-hard问题，受到多种约束条件（如I/O通道、通信接口、处理器信息容量、调节时间和可靠性）的限制。

Method: 提出了一种混合方法，该方法结合了确定性的层次结构构建和一种改进的蚁群优化（ACO）算法，用于设备类型的选择，并辅以自适应启发式规则。该方法通过将信号按控制室分组来处理问题。

Result: 在具有超过100个IOs的实例上，该混合ACO方法在找到的最佳成本方面比GA、PSO和SA提高了14-38%，并且运行速度快9-14倍。然而，在中位数成本方面，确定性贪婪基线方法（GA获得最佳Friedman排名）更为可靠，因为ACO的运行成本变异性很大。

Conclusion: 该方法适用于早期设计阶段，能在几分钟内合成成本最优且可行的工业规模APCS硬件架构（A高达1086），展示了其在效率和解决大规模问题方面的优势。

Abstract: The paper addresses the synthesis of a cost-optimal hardware architecture of the automated process control system (APCS) for continuous processes. The problem is formalized as the search for a minimum-cost rooted tree of devices subject to constraints on the number of I/O channels, the types and number of communication interfaces, the information capacity of processors, the regulation time and the reliability. The signals are grouped by control rooms. The problem is NP-hard, and a hybrid method is proposed that combines a deterministic hierarchy construction with a modified ant colony optimization (ACO) for device-type selection, enhanced by an adaptive heuristic. On ten instances the method is compared with a genetic algorithm (GA), particle swarm optimization (PSO), simulated annealing (SA) and CP-SAT over 30 runs each. By the best found cost the hybrid ACO outperforms GA, PSO and SA on all instances with more than 100 IOs (by 14-38 %) and runs 9-14 times faster. By the median cost, however, the deterministic-greedy baselines are more reliable (GA attains the best Friedman rank) because the cost of the ACO runs is highly variable. All differences are confirmed by the Friedman and Wilcoxon tests. The method targets the early-design search for the cheapest feasible architecture and synthesizes one within minutes at industrial scale (A up to 1086).

</details>


### [1255] [Co-Optimization of Scheduling, Control, and Incentivization of Electric Vehicles for Improving Power System Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15118)
*Amit Kumer Podder,Tomonori Sadamoto,Aranya Chakrabortty*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于有限时间、贪婪启发式方法的协同优化和最优控制框架，该框架联合优化电动汽车（EV）的充电率、充电时间和控制律，以同时改善配电系统的电压稳定性和小信号动态性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了改善配电系统的电压稳定性和小信号动态性能，同时考虑电动汽车（EV）充电对电网的影响。

Method: 提出了一种有限时间、贪婪启发式方法的协同优化和最优控制框架，该框架通过货币激励在固定预算内，鼓励电动汽车用户灵活调整充电率和充电时间。

Result: 通过 IEEE 33 节点配电系统模型和十个电动汽车充电站（EVCS）的验证结果表明，通过“等待-保存”策略激励用户降低充电率并战略性地重新安排充电时间，可以显著提高系统的电压稳定指数（VSI）以及直流母线电压中频振荡模式的阻尼因子。

Conclusion: 通过联合优化电动汽车的充电率、充电时间和控制律，并结合经济激励措施，可以有效地同时提升配电系统的电压稳定性和动态性能。

Abstract: We present a finite-horizon, greedy heuristic-based co-optimization and optimal control framework that jointly determines the optimized charging rates, charging times, and an optimal charging control law for electric vehicles (EVs) to improve both voltage stability and small-signal dynamic performance of a power distribution system. The proposed strategy encourages EV drivers to be flexible in choosing their charging rates and times through monetary incentivization under a fixed budget. The design is validated using the IEEE 33-bus distribution system model with ten EV charging stations (EVCSs). Results show that incentivizing drivers to settle for lower charging rates, implemented by a wait-and-save strategy, and rescheduling their charging times strategically can significantly improve the voltage stability index (VSI) of the system as well as the damping factors for the mid-frequency oscillation modes seen in the DC-link bus voltage.

</details>


### [1256] [Policy Improvement From Private Information For Decentralized LQG Teams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15289)
*Hung T. Nguyen,Andreas A. Malikopoulos*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 研究了具有通信延迟的多智能体系统中的去中心化 LQG 问题，并提出了一种基于梯度下降的线性策略优化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通信延迟会导致信息不对称，从而可能导致经典控制结果失效，因此需要研究有延迟的去中心化控制问题。

Method: 首先推导了去中心化 LQG 问题中线性策略的收益梯度，然后利用该梯度设计了一个梯度下降算法来优化策略。

Result: 提出了一个可以分析计算线性策略增益梯度的方法，并设计了一个相应的梯度下降算法，该算法在示例中展示了策略的改进。

Conclusion: 通信延迟下的去中心化 LQG 问题可以通过梯度下降算法优化线性策略来获得改进的性能。

Abstract: Sharing of information in multiagent systems allow for improved coordination. Delays in communication can cause asymmetries in information, causing classical results to fail. We study the decentralized LQG problem with delayed information. In general, the optimal policies are not linear and are difficult to calculate. Restricting to linear policies, we analytically calculate the gradient descent for gains from private information. This naturally lends itself to a gradient descent algorithm which we apply to examples to show policy improvements.

</details>


### [1257] [Adaptive Event-Triggered Model Predictive Coverage Control with Average Update-Rate Regulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15325)
*Pengbo Zhu,Jicheng Shi,Colin N. Jones,Andreas A. Malikopoulos*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种自适应阈值的事件触发模型预测控制（MPC）方法，用于在通信和计算受限的多智能体系统中实现覆盖控制。该方法通过在线调整事件触发阈值来精确控制MPC更新的平均速率，从而平衡计算负载和响应性，并提高了覆盖效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的模型预测覆盖控制方法在通信和计算资源受限的情况下，难以平衡优化负载和对空间优先级的响应。固定事件阈值导致更新速率变化，难以维持预定的平均更新预算。因此，需要一种能够根据运行条件动态调整更新速率的方法。

Method: 提出了一种阈值自适应事件触发MPC方法。该方法通过在线调整事件触发阈值，使其与目标平均周期和最近的事件间隔之差成比例，以实现对平均更新周期的精确控制。并通过理论证明了经验平均更新周期收敛到目标值，并建立了累积平均值的界限。最后，将该机制应用于覆盖MPC，并使用任务感知统计量捕获机器人运动和空间重要性变化。

Result: 在非线性基准测试中，该方法证明了预算保证。在五智能体移动密度研究中，自适应策略平均使用204.7次全局MPC更新（目标为200次），而固定阈值策略使用266.7次。与具有相同更新次数的周期性调度相比，自适应策略还降低了覆盖成本。

Conclusion: 所提出的阈值自适应事件触发MPC能够直接调节平均更新预算，并实现有效的任务相关MPC更新调度。这为在资源受限的多智能体系统中实现高效的覆盖控制提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Model predictive coverage control for multi-agent systems operates under tight communication and computation budgets, which requires it to balance the load of optimization against responsiveness to varying spatial priorities. With a fixed event threshold, the update rate varies with operating conditions, making a prescribed average update budget difficult to maintain. We propose threshold-adaptive event-triggered model predictive control (MPC), which adjusts the threshold online in proportion to the difference between the target average period and the latest inter-event interval. We prove convergence of the empirical average update period to any feasible prescribed target and establish initialization-dependent one-sided bounds on the cumulative average. A nonlinear benchmark illustrates these budget guarantees. We then apply the mechanism to coverage MPC using a task-aware statistic that captures robot motion and changes in spatial importance. In a five-agent moving-density study, the adaptive policy uses 204.7 global MPC updates on average against a target of 200, compared with 266.7 for a fixed-threshold policy using the same statistic and initial threshold. It also reduces coverage cost relative to periodic schedules with exactly matched update counts. These results demonstrate direct average-budget regulation and effective task-dependent scheduling of MPC updates.

</details>


### [1258] [Distributed Economic Dispatch Scheme of A BESS Network with A Switching Utility Grid in Energy Internet Paradigm via Reset Consensus Method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15647)
*Yalin Zhang,Zhongxin Liu,Yulin Chen,Donglian Qi,Zengqiang Chen*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于边际成本共识的分布式经济调度方案，用于考虑电网切换的电池储能系统（BESS）网络。通过引入反馈耦合项和带有重置机制的比例积分（PI）控制器，提高了控制器的稳定性和收敛速度，以及边际成本共识的速度和精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分布式经济调度方案存在控制精度低和收敛速度慢的问题，促使本研究进行改进。

Method: 设计了一种基于边际成本共识的分布式经济调度方案。引入反馈耦合项以提高稳定性和收敛率。采用带有重置机制的比例积分（PI）控制器来提高边际成本共识的速度和精度。通过分析矩阵特征值来保证控制器性能。

Result: 所设计的方案能够有效地处理电网切换、分时电价、负荷切换、BESS/Agent即插即用以及大规模系统应用等场景，并展示了其有效性和先进性。

Conclusion: 所提出的分布式经济调度方案通过改进控制器设计，显著提高了控制精度和收敛速度，有效解决了现有方案的不足，并能适用于多种复杂场景。

Abstract: This article aims to design a distributed economic dispatch (ED) scheme based on marginal cost (MC) consensus for a battery energy storage system (BESS) network considering the utility grid switching. Due to the low control accuracy and slow convergence speed of previous schemes, some important changes have been made in this article. Firstly, the feedback coupling term is introduced into the closed-loop error to further improve the stability and convergence rate of the controller. Then, a proportional integral (PI) controller with a reset mechanism is implemented in the designed scheme, which improves the speed and control accuracy of MC consensus. The performance of a control system with a reset mechanism is well guaranteed by analyzing the eigenvalues of the corresponding matrix. Finally, some tests focus on UG switching, time phased pricing, load switching, a BESS/agent plug and play, and large-scale system applications to illustrate the effectiveness and progressiveness of the design scheme.

</details>


### [1259] [Learned Graph Bases for Neural Operators on Power-System Transients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15651)
*Shubhan Bhattacharya,Avi Bagchi*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 研究了傅里叶神经算子预测电力系统瞬态轨迹时空间谱基的选择，发现可学习基相较于固定的傅里叶基在不同工况下有显著提升，并且学习到的模型和固定模型的组合能提供鲁棒的预测和故障检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有傅里叶神经算子在预测电力系统瞬态轨迹方面表现出高精度，但空间谱基的选择对其性能影响有待进一步研究，特别是在应对未见过的故障位置和变化的运行工况时。

Method: 研究者们比较了两种空间谱基：一是基于电网自身耦合网络的图傅里叶变换，二是可学习基。可学习基在固定傅里叶基的基础上进行训练，并与傅里叶控制进行对比。实验在一个统一的流程中，通过三种协议（包括未见过的故障位置和变化的运行工况）进行评估。

Result: 可学习基在参数和计算预算相同的情况下，相较于离散傅里叶变换（DFT）变体，在分布内（in-distribution）协议上提升了7-14%，并且在两种分布内协议上均有显著提升，而在第三种（分布外）协议上没有性能损失。这种提升主要来源于模型对数据的适应性，而非仅仅依赖于坐标信息。研究者们还发现，平均学习和冻结模型可以得到最佳的鲁棒预测器，而它们的差异可以作为一种无需标签的警报，能标记出所有变化的工况案例，且无漏报。

Conclusion: 可学习的空间谱基能有效提升傅里叶神经算子在电力系统瞬态轨迹预测中的性能，尤其是在应对变化运行工况方面。通过结合学习和固定模型，可以实现既鲁棒又准确的预测，并且模型的差异性可用于无监督的异常检测。

Abstract: Fourier neural operators predict power-system transient trajectories with high accuracy. We extend this line of work by examining the choice of spatial spectral basis, studying both the graph Fourier transform derived from the grid's own coupling network and learnable bases trained from that starting point and from a Fourier control. Evaluated in one controlled pipeline across three protocols spanning unseen fault locations and shifted operating regimes, the learnable bases improve on a parameter- and budget-matched DFT variant by 7-14% in distribution, with per-case significance on both in-distribution protocols and no loss on the third; the gain comes from adaptation rather than from the coordinates alone. We further characterize the regime dependence of this gain, identifying its cause, locus, and continuity, and show that a resolution requires no new model: averaging the learned and frozen variants gives the best shift-robust predictor, while their disagreement provides a label-free alarm that flags every shifted case with no false alarms.

</details>


### [1260] [Singular Sampling in Nonlinear Observability: Higher-Order Minimax Laws and Timing Crossovers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15906)
*Jerzy Baranowski*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 解析错误


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解析错误

Method: 解析错误

Result: 解析错误

Conclusion: 解析错误

Abstract: We study deterministic bounded-noise state reconstruction for nonlinear systems when the measurement schedule drives the sampled-output map through a rank-deficient configuration. Local reconstruction is governed by the leading pairwise separation order and its corresponding higher-order modulus, which together determine the leading minimax noise-to-state law. For corank-one cubic singular schedules, including overdetermined sampled maps, we derive the exact physical $\ell_\infty$ cubic modulus through quotient geometry in $\mathbb{R}^q/\operatorname{Im}DF$ and show how the required finite jet is computed from trajectory sensitivities. We then prove a uniform signed timing crossover: a transversal timing perturbation has transition scale $\varepsilon=O(δ^{2/3})$, linking the regular, cubic-singular, and fold regimes. A damped pendulum provides closed-form crossover coefficients and exact nonlinear minimax validation, while a four-state downward cart--pole verifies the rectangular theory. The results show that measurement timing can change not only reconstruction conditioning but the exponent governing bounded-noise state uncertainty.

</details>


### [1261] [Rayleigh-Benard Stabilization by Fredholm Backstepping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15943)
*Miroslav Krstic,Eugene Lavretsky*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 研究人员提出了一种通过对上板施加显式反馈来稳定瑞利-贝纳尔层中的对流不稳定性。这种反馈是通过全状态耦合速度-温度系统和极点配置获得的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 瑞利-贝纳尔层中的对流不稳定性是流体动力学不稳定的基准，可能导致混沌现象。研究目的是稳定这种不稳定性。

Method: 研究人员利用Fredholm反步法和极点配置技术，通过对上板的切向速度、温度和法向速度施加显式反馈来稳定流体层。这种反馈是基于完整的状态。

Result: 该方法能够以任何瑞利数和普朗特数稳定导电状态，并实现任意指定衰减率。在Ra=10^6时，该层有85个不稳定的模式，增长率高达2137，而反馈控制可以消除这些不稳定性。

Conclusion: 通过对上板施加精心设计的全状态反馈，可以有效地稳定瑞利-贝纳尔层中的导电状态，并消除对流不稳定性，为控制混沌现象提供了一种方法。

Abstract: Among Navier--Stokes systems, the Rayleigh--Bénard layer, a fluid between two horizontal plates heated from below and cooled from above, is the benchmark of hydrodynamic instability that manifests itself as the unsteady convection phenomenon, which in turn can be interpreted as the onset of chaos: the Lorenz equations represent the Fourier--Galerkin approximation coefficients for the minimal three-mode truncation of it. Its instability has no mean flow behind it. The fluid is at rest, the velocity and the temperature are each stable alone, and buoyancy closes a positive loop between them. The linearization is self-adjoint, its unstable spectrum real, and the number of unstable modes grows without bound in the Rayleigh number; at $\Ra=10^6$ the layer has $85$ of them, with growth rates up to $2137$. We stabilize the conductive state at every Rayleigh and Prandtl number, with any prescribed decay rate, by explicit feedback of the full state to the tangential velocity, temperature, and normal velocity of the upper plate. The feedback laws are obtained by Fredholm backstepping of the coupled velocity--temperature system, with pole placement for the lowest modes.

</details>


### [1262] [Physics-guided machine learning for saturation control across variable hydraulic conditions in heap leaching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15947)
*Sultan Alhamdan,Daniel Navia,Paulina Quintanilla*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文开发了一种参数化物理引导机器学习（PGML）模型，用于快速预测堆浸过程中的饱和度变化，并将其应用于模拟的饱和度控制，与传统的PI控制器相比，该模型在预测精度和灌溉效率方面均表现出竞争力，并且计算速度远超数值求解器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 堆浸过程中各区域水力学特性存在差异，需要快速预测模型来适应不同的材料属性。

Method: 研究人员开发了一种参数条件化的物理引导机器学习（PGML）代理模型，利用4096个数值模拟轨迹数据集进行训练，并通过近似Gardner质量平衡损失函数进行优化。将该模型应用于24小时的模拟饱和度控制，并与比例-积分（PI）控制器进行比较。

Result: PGML控制器在200个恒定灌溉率的模拟中，中位数全周期跟踪偏差为目标饱和度的4.9%，与最优PI控制器相当，但灌溉量减少了约4%，且无超调。适度的物理引导使长期预测误差降低了约30%，但略微增加了闭环跟踪误差。PGML代理模型比数值求解器快约70倍。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，PGML代理模型是一种可重用的工具，能够为大规模模拟中的堆浸饱和度控制提供快速且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Heap-leaching hydraulics vary between regions of an ore bed, motivating fast prediction models that accommodate different material properties. This study develops a parameter-conditioned physics-guided machine-learning (PGML) surrogate and demonstrates its use in simulated saturation control. A dataset of 4096 numerical Richards-equation trajectories was divided into 2867 training, 614 validation and 615 evaluation cases. The network predicts hourly saturation profiles from the current profile, irrigation rate and four hydraulic parameters, and is trained with an approximate Gardner mass-balance penalty. A daily predictive controller compared 200 constant irrigation rates over a 24-hour horizon. Across the evaluation cases, the median full-cycle tracking deviation was 4.9% of a 0.70 saturation target, equal to that of a tuned proportional-integral (PI) controller, while the PGML controller reached the target without overshoot in the median and applied approximately 4% less irrigation. Moderate physics guidance reduced long-horizon prediction error by approximately 30% relative to data-only training and reduced irrigation-bound activity, but slightly worsened closed-loop tracking. For a matched prediction workload, the surrogate was approximately 70 times faster than the numerical solver, and batched evaluation cost under 2 ms per column for 5000 columns. The results support a reusable physics-guided surrogate for large-scale saturation control in simulation.

</details>


### [1263] [Distributed Observation Scheduling and Sensor Fusion For Large Agile Constellations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15949)
*Nicholas Niziolek,Ryan Draves,Nolan Ales,Nolan Stevenson,Eli Jones,Eric Frew,Nisar Ahmed*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种完全分布式的方法来管理大型地球观测卫星星座，结合了基于 BWCBBA 的任务分配和调度算法，以及基于所有权的传感器数据融合算法，并分析了不同去中心化程度下的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大型地球观测卫星星座的兴趣激增，如何有效地指挥和利用这些系统成为一个日益重要的问题。

Method: 采用 BWCBBA 和轻量级观测调度器相结合的方法进行分布式观测任务分配和调度；采用基于所有权的分布式数据融合模型，其中一个卫星负责系统轨迹的管理，并在本地信息共享的基础上进行进一步融合。

Result: 所提出的分布式方法能够产生任务到指令代理的唯一映射；通过对不同去中心化架构的性能分析，揭示了其与传统集中式方法相比的性能损失。

Conclusion: 该分布式方法为管理大型卫星星座提供了一种可行的解决方案，但需要权衡其在去中心化带来的优势与潜在的性能损失。

Abstract: With the rapid increase in interest towards large scale earth observing satellite constellations, the problem of properly commanding and utilizing these systems has become increasingly relevant. This work focuses on a complete distributed approach to this problem, incorporating an observation task allocation and scheduling algorithm in addition to a sensor data fusion algorithm for end-to-end target coverage and processing. Observation task allocation and scheduling is performed in this work through the combination of the bid warped consensus based bundle algorithm (BWCBBA) and a lightweight observation scheduler for bid scoring. This method produces a unique mapping of tasks to command agents when allowed to iterate sufficiently. The approach to distributed data fusion in this work occurs primarily through an ownership model in which one satellite takes ownership of a system track in the constellation. After local information is shared between the sensing nodes to create the system tracks, the dedicated fusion nodes assume ownership for further information fusion and track information is disseminated throughout the constellation for data association. This paper analyzes the performance of these two algorithms over a set of increasingly decentralized architectures to highlight the performance losses compared to more traditional centralized methods.

</details>


### [1264] [AC-Aware Steady-State Security Region Characterization via Exclusion Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16073)
*Zhirou Wang,Zhengshuo Li,Shuo Yang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为AC-ITER的迭代方法，通过逐步排除不安全区域来精确描述交流安全区域（AC-SR），解决了现有方法在精度和计算效率上的权衡问题。同时，引入AC-SSA加速不安全点搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代电网中，有功功率调度与无功支撑和电压安全日益耦合，而精确的稳态交流潮流（AC-PF）约束导致AC-SR的计算困难，难以同时保证精度和效率。

Method: 提出AC-ITER方法，通过构建并移除不安全点周围的凸局部排除子区域来逐步精炼AC-SR。利用边界点搜索和基于对偶的局部排除割来近似松弛引起的不可靠部分。采用基于均匀采样的统计认证方法评估残余区域安全性并指导终止，并引入AC-SSA加速不安全点搜索。

Result: AC-ITER方法能够精确描述AC-SR，而AC-SSA方法能够显著提高计算效率。数值研究证实了AC-ITER的准确性和AC-SSA的效率。

Conclusion: AC-ITER方法为精确表征AC-SR提供了一种有效且计算效率高的方法，为电力系统的安全评估提供了有价值的工具。

Abstract: As active power dispatch becomes increasingly coupled with reactive power support and voltage security in modern power systems, AC security regions (AC-SRs) under exact steady-state AC power flow (AC-PF) constraints provide valuable insights into admissible operating boundaries and security margins for security assessment. However, the nonconvexity of exact AC-PF constraints makes it difficult to achieve both accuracy and computational efficiency in AC-SR characterization. To this end, this paper proposes an AC-aware iterative exclusion refinement (AC-ITER) approach that refines a given convex-relaxed AC-SR toward the exact AC-SR by progressively constructing and removing convexlocal exclusion subregions around numerically identified insecure points. Boundary-point searches and dual-based local exclusion cuts provide a tractable approximation of relaxation-induced insecure portions. A statistical certification method based on uniform sampling is developed to support high-confidence assessment of residual-region security and guide termination, while an AC-PF security similarity-based acceleration (AC-SSA) approach is introduced to further accelerate the sampling-based search for insecure operating points. Numerical studies on academic test systems and real-world systems demonstrate the characterization accuracy of AC-ITER and the computational efficiency gained through AC-SSA.

</details>


### [1265] [Adaptive Calibration of Day-Ahead Flexibility Reserve Requirements Under Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16075)
*Napoleon Costilla-Enriquez,Yang Weng,Miguel A. Ortega-Vazquez*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种自适应的、顺序更新的框架，用于在可再生能源并网导致电力系统不确定性增加的情况下，动态调整灵活性备用金。该框架结合了自适应保形推理和滚动风险控制，能在有限的时间范围内保证备用金不足的频率和预期未覆盖偏差的控制，且无需假设平稳性或可交换性。在ERCOT真实数据上的测试表明，该框架可以提高覆盖率，降低未覆盖偏差，并能节省备用金。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 日益增长的可再生能源发电带来了天气驱动的波动性和不确定性，给电力系统运行带来挑战。传统的静态或仅基于历史数据的方法在面对超出历史数据范围的运行条件时，可靠性会下降。因此，需要一种能够根据实时运行结果动态调整备用金需求的方法。

Method: 提出了一种顺序框架，在获得运行结果后更新前一天的备用金需求。该框架结合了两种方法：1. 自适应保形推理（Adaptive Conformal Inference），用于控制备用金不足的频率；2. 滚动风险控制（Rolling Risk Control），用于控制预期未覆盖偏差（即超过计划备用金的平均残差）。作者证明了有限视界内实现的误覆盖和有上限的未覆盖偏差损失的界限。

Result: 在ERCOT真实数据上的测试表明，该框架实现了大约90%的覆盖率，上下误覆盖率接近5%。风险校准将预期未覆盖偏差控制在接近其预算水平，同时比未校准的要求节省了5.3%的备用金。

Conclusion: 该框架能够生成自适应的备用金需求，可以在有限的时间范围内，在不假设平稳性或可交换性的情况下，可证明地控制选定的可靠性指标（备用金不足频率和预期未覆盖偏差），有效应对可再生能源发电带来的不确定性。

Abstract: The increasing integration of variable renewable generation introduces weather-driven variability and uncertainty into power-system operations. System operators manage the resulting deviations between day-ahead forecasts and real-time net load by scheduling upward and downward flexibility reserves. These requirements have traditionally been set using simple deterministic rules. Newer data-driven methods tailor reserves to forecasts and operating conditions. However, their reliability may deteriorate when conditions depart from the historical data. We address this limitation with a sequential framework that updates day-ahead reserve requirements as operating outcomes become available. Within this framework, Adaptive Conformal Inference targets the frequency of insufficient reserve, whereas Rolling Risk Control targets expected uncovered deviation, the mean residual beyond the scheduled reserve. We prove finite-horizon bounds on realized miscoverage and capped uncovered-deviation loss. We test the framework on real ERCOT data in a chronological deployment simulation that respects operational timing: outcomes from one day first affect the reserve schedule two days later. Training and validation use 2022--2023 data; the uninterrupted test covers 2024--2025. Coverage calibration achieves approximately 90% coverage, with upward and downward miscoverage near 5%. Risk calibration brings expected uncovered deviations close to their budgets while using 5.3% less reserve than the uncalibrated requirements. The framework thus produces adaptive reserve requirements that provably control the selected reliability metrics over finite horizons without assuming stationarity or exchangeability.

</details>


### [1266] [Event-Driven Safe Control of a Black-Box Balancing Wheel with Friction-Gated Actuation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16223)
*Kanishka Harwani,Neha Navarkar,Aliasghar Arab,Farshad Khorrami*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 研究人员改造了一款独轮车，加入了导螺杆和反作用轮，并开发了一个基于概率和实时更新的控制系统，以提高其稳定性和操控性，并在模拟和实际硬件上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商业独轮车的封闭系统限制了其操控性，研究人员希望通过增加机械部件和开发更智能的控制算法来增强其控制能力，使其能够进行更精确的纵向移动和转向。

Method: 该研究通过在独轮车上增加一个用于纵向运动的导螺杆和一个用于偏航的反应轮来改造其硬件。在软件方面，研究人员通过24次脉冲扭矩测试，建立了一个两部分的模型来描述脉冲是否能引起旋转以及旋转角度，其中扭矩作为随机变量。同时，研究人员将重量转移建模为速率限制输入。基于这些模型，开发了一个事件触发的监督器，该监督器根据预期的航向改善来安排脉冲，并在预测的制动路径可能超出安全范围时进行制动，同时考虑模型不确定性并在线更新摩擦估计。

Result: 在模拟中，基于 fitted model 的鲁棒监督器完成了 92.6% 的任务，安全违规率为 1.8%，安全中止率为 1.6%。相比之下，使用平均模型的监督器完成率为 84.0%，安全违规率为 7.2%。而忽略摩擦的基线方法完成率为 1.8%，安全违规率为 20.4%。

Conclusion: 通过引入导螺杆和反作用轮，并结合一个能够处理不确定性和实时更新的监督控制策略，可以显著提高独轮车的稳定性和操控性，克服现有商业独轮车的局限性。该方法在模拟和实际硬件实验中均取得了良好的效果。

Abstract: Commercial balancing wheels are closed systems: an internal controller keeps the board upright, and a rider steers by shifting weight and twisting the hips. We augment a one-wheel with a lead-screw weight shift for longitudinal motion and a reaction wheel for yaw. The reaction wheel stores limited momentum, so a turn is a sequence of torque pulses, and whether a pulse rotates the body depends on static friction at the tire contact. From a 24-pulse torque sweep on one surface we fit a two-part model that gives the probability that a pulse rotates the body, treating the breakaway torque as random, and the rotation angle when it does; at maximum torque the posterior engagement probability is 0.54 (90% credible interval 0.24-0.84). The weight shift is modeled as a rate- limited input with a measured speed gain and an assumed first-order response, which predicts stopping distances four times those of a direct-force model. These models drive an event-triggered supervisor that schedules pulses by expected heading improvement, brakes when the predicted braking path would leave the safe set, tightens margins for model uncertainty, and updates the friction estimate online. In simulation on 500 plants drawn from the fitted models, the robust supervisor completed 92.6% of missions with 1.8% safety violations and 1.6% safe aborts, versus 84.0% and 7.2% for a supervisor using mean models and 1.8% and 20.4% for a baseline that ignores friction. A video of the hardware experiments is available online (https://github.com/ASAS-Labs/x-wheel).

</details>


### [1267] [$H_2$-optimal model order reduction using hyperbolic geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16249)
*Andrea Angino,Tamás Dózsa,Matthias Voigt*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的方法，通过使用马尔姆奎斯特-塔肯纳卡（Malmquist-Takenaka）正交展开和双曲几何，来计算稳定且 $H_2$-最优的降阶模型（ROM），解决了迭代有理克雷洛夫算法（IRKA）可能产生不稳定模型的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有用于计算 $H_2$-最优降阶模型的迭代有理克雷洛夫算法（IRKA）在实际应用中不能保证生成稳定模型，这促使研究人员开发一种能够强制稳定性的新方法。

Method: 该方法利用马尔姆奎斯特-塔肯纳卡正交展开和双曲几何来构建一个平衡函数（equilibrium function）。通过求解该平衡函数的零点来确定 $H_2$-最优 ROM 的极点。针对这种非线性根查找问题，提出了一种基于庞加莱圆盘流形（Poincaré disk manifolds）乘积的牛顿型方法，其更新沿双曲测地线进行，从而在每次迭代中都保证了稳定性的约束。

Result: 研究提出的新框架能够生成稳定的 $H_2$-最优降阶模型。数值实验表明，在离散时间和连续时间 LTI 系统模型降阶（MOR）问题上，该方法在 IRKA 产生不稳定模型的情况下，仍然能够保持模型的稳定性。

Conclusion: 该工作开发了一种新颖的框架，利用双曲几何和正交展开，成功地实现了稳定且 $H_2$-最优的降阶模型计算，克服了现有方法的局限性，并在数值实验中得到了验证。

Abstract: We revisit the problem of approximating a linear time-invariant LTI model by a reduced-order model (ROM) in an $H_2$-optimal sense. A widely used method for computing such ROMs is the iterative rational Krylov algorithm (IRKA). However, in practice, the stability of the resulting ROM is not generally guaranteed. In this work, we develop a novel framework that can be used to obtain $H_2$-optimal models of single-input single-output LTI systems while enforcing stability of the ROM. We use Malmquist-Takenaka orthogonal expansions in the corresponding $H_2$-spaces and their connection to hyperbolic geometry to develop an equilibrium function. We show that the poles of an $H_2$-optimal ROM transfer function are defined by the zeros of this equilibrium function. The resulting nonlinear root-finding problem is solved using a Newton-type method formulated on the products of Poincaré disk manifolds, where updates are performed along hyperbolic geodesics ensuring that the stability constraint is satisfied at every iteration. We present numerical experiments on benchmark systems for both discrete- and continuous-time LTI MOR problems, including examples where IRKA produces unstable reduced models while the proposed method preserves stability throughout the iteration.

</details>


### [1268] [Equilibria and consensus in discrete-time opinion dynamics with mixed weighted-averaging and weighted-median mechanisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16406)
*Junkai Cheng,Wenjun Mei*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一个结合了加权平均和加权中值更新的离散时间意见动力学模型，并分析了其在固定有向网络上的均衡和收敛性。研究表明，当且仅当不存在两个不相交的特定类型的“凝聚集”时，所有初始条件都能达成共识；否则，存在一类初始条件导致持久分歧。此外，将加权中值个体替换为加权平均个体可以保持已有共识的保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机在于理解个体间的相互影响如何导致群体意见的趋同或持续分歧，并探索影响这些结果的网络结构和更新规则。

Method: 该研究通过分析局部平衡条件和意见水平集来表征模型的均衡点，并利用非扩张性和Krasnosel'skii--Mann理论证明了模型收敛到一个Lyapunov稳定的均衡。引入了“类型依赖的凝聚集”概念来区分加权平均和加权中值个体的行为。

Result: 研究发现，所有初始条件都能达成共识的充要条件是不存在两个不相交的凝聚集。如果存在不相交的凝聚集，则存在一类（非空开集）初始条件会导致持久分歧。将加权中值个体替换为加权平均个体，在共识已得到保证的情况下，可以维持这种保证。数值研究表明，加权平均个体的比例与其达致预设共识容忍度的频率呈非递减关系，但个体实现结果可能不遵循此趋势。

Conclusion: 该模型提供了一个量化分析意见动力学的框架，揭示了网络结构（通过凝聚集）和个体更新规则（加权平均 vs. 加权中值）对群体意见走向（共识或分歧）的关键作用。研究结果有助于理解社会影响传播的复杂性以及设计促进共识的网络或策略。

Abstract: Opinion dynamics models relate interpersonal influence to consensus or persistent disagreement. We study a discrete-time model combining weighted-average and weighted-median updates on a fixed directed network. Individuals update synchronously with possibly different adjustment coefficients. We characterize equilibria through local balance conditions and opinion level sets, and establish convergence to a Lyapunov-stable equilibrium using nonexpansiveness and Krasnosel'skii--Mann theory. We define type-dependent cohesive sets: each weighted-average member assigns all its weight to the set, whereas each weighted-median member assigns at least one half. Consensus is reached from every initial condition if and only if no two such sets are disjoint. Otherwise, an open set of initial conditions leads to persistent disagreement. Replacing weighted-median individuals by weighted-average individuals preserves consensus whenever it is already guaranteed for all initial conditions. Four numerical studies examine the number and locations of weighted-average individuals. The frequency of reaching a prescribed consensus tolerance is nondecreasing with their fraction in the sampled ensembles, but individual realizations need not follow this trend.

</details>


### [1269] [Aerodynamic Promptness of Tilting-Propeller Multirotors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16532)
*Antonio Franchi*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于多旋翼飞行器（其螺旋桨方向可随机构配置变化）的空气动力学敏捷性几何理论，该理论通过黎曼度量定义了敏捷性，并解释了不同飞行器架构的控制能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多旋翼飞行器控制理论主要关注固定方向的螺旋桨，而对于螺旋桨方向可以改变的飞行器（如倾转旋翼无人机），缺乏有效的理论框架来描述和量化其控制能力和灵活性。

Method: 研究提出了一种基于黎曼几何的理论框架，将执行器状态（螺旋桨转速和机构配置）映射到执行器微分。利用该度量诱导的音乐同构和对偶微分，定义了一个从力和力矩协向量到力和力矩变化率向量的任务速率权限映射。通过该映射的矩阵行列式的平方根来定义空气动力学敏捷性。

Result: 提出了空气动力学敏捷性的量化指标，并证明了正敏捷性等价于局部力和力矩变化率满射性。该理论还揭示了如何通过内部运动来调节敏捷性而不改变瞬时力和力矩。此外，该理论框架能够统一解释独立倾转和径向排列的Holocopter和Voliro等飞行器架构的现有控制分配和秩构建方法。

Conclusion: 本文开发了一个新的几何理论，用于理解和量化具有可变螺旋桨方向的多旋翼飞行器的空气动力学敏捷性。该理论提供了一个统一的框架来分析不同飞行器设计，并有助于设计更灵活、响应更快的飞行控制系统。

Abstract: This work develops a geometric theory of aerodynamic promptness for multirotor platforms whose propeller directions depend on a smooth orientation-mechanism configuration. The actuator state consists of the actual signed propeller speeds and the mechanism configuration, and the nonlinear actuator map retains both the signed-quadratic propeller law and the configuration-dependent thrust directions.
