Constant direction maps represent fixed propellers, while shared dependence on mechanism coordinates represents mechanically coupled tilts. A Riemannian metric on the product actuator manifold compares propeller accelerations and orientation-mechanism rates through physically interpretable scales. Composing the actuator-map differential, the musical isomorphism induced by this metric, and the dual differential defines a task-rate authority map from wrench covectors to wrench-rate vectors. In fixed task coordinates, the square root of the determinant of its matrix defines aerodynamic promptness. Positive promptness is equivalent to local wrench-rate surjectivity, while the associated spectrum resolves directional authority and conditioning. The same construction yields the metric horizontal inverse, the orthogonal projector onto wrench-fiber directions, and task-preserving internal motions that regulate promptness without changing the instantaneous wrench. The construction is related intrinsically to dynamic feedback linearization and specialized to the independently tilting, radially arranged Holocopter and Voliro architectures, clarifying how their established allocation and rank constructions fit within the same actuator-manifold geometry.

</details>


### [1270] [Scalable Identification of Physics-Based and Neural Dynamics from Partial Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16559)
*Yibo Zhou,Johannes Köhler*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出了一种可扩展的非线性动力学辨识方法，结合了预测误差法（PEM）和移动视窗估计（MHE），并提出了一种优化算法以提高计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在处理大量模型参数时计算效率低下，需要一种更快的辨识非线性动力学的方法。

Method: 采用预测误差法（PEM）结合移动视窗估计（MHE）来辨识非线性动力学，并推导了一种新的优化方法，避免了显式参数灵敏度矩阵，利用了时间结构来提高计算效率。

Result: 新方法在超梯度评估方面实现了高达 215 倍的速度提升。在赛车模拟中，该方法能准确预测并辨识轮胎力参数。在真实世界数据中，结合了神经残差的灰盒模型提高了预测精度，同时保持了物理可解释性。

Conclusion: 所提出的可扩展方法能有效且高效地辨识具有一般非线性动力学的系统，并能处理物理模型、神经网络模型和灰盒模型，在模拟和实际应用中均取得了良好效果。

Abstract: We present a scalable method for identifying nonlinear dynamics from partial measurements, supporting physics-based, neural-network, and gray-box models. We use the Prediction Error Method (PEM) coupled with state estimation performed by a Moving Horizon Estimation (MHE) scheme, which can account directly for general nonlinear dynamics. This results in a bi-level optimization problem that scales poorly with increasing model parameters. To improve computational efficiency, we derive a reformulation that avoids explicit parameter-wide sensitivity matrices and exploits the temporal structure of the underlying optimization problem. Numerical comparisons show up to a $215\times$ speedup in hypergradient evaluation. Racing-vehicle simulations demonstrate accurate prediction and physical-parameter recovery in tire-force identification. Real-world data show that the gray-box model improves prediction accuracy with a neural residual while retaining physical interpretability.

</details>


### [1271] [Design of Privacy-Preserving Estimators Under Prior Information Exposure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16556)
*Le Liu,Yu Kawano,Ming Cao*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究了在考虑对手先验知识的情况下，如何实现具有隐私保护的离散时间线性随机系统状态估计。发现卡尔曼滤波器在无加性释放噪声时会最大化隐私泄露，并提出了一个衡量隐私泄露的下界。最后，通过半定规划设计了兼顾隐私和估计性能的估计器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有隐私保护状态估计框架未能充分考虑对手可能拥有的先验知识，导致估计结果可能泄露敏感的私有状态信息。

Method: 1. 分析卡尔曼滤波器的隐私泄露特性，揭示其在无加性释放噪声时的“隐私反最优性”。2. 建立$(\varepsilon, \delta)$-PML隐私下的稳态估计误差的下界。3. 推导保证$(\varepsilon, \delta)$-PML隐私的释放噪声条件，分别针对卡尔曼滤波器和一般稳定线性估计器。4. 提出一个半定规划方法，联合设计估计器增益和释放噪声协方差，以获得具有估计误差上界的隐私保护估计器。

Result: 1. 证明了在无加性释放噪声时，稳态卡尔曼滤波器会最大化PML隐私泄露。2. 提出了$(\varepsilon, \delta)$-PML隐私下的稳态估计误差的非平凡下界。3. 确定了实现$(\varepsilon, \delta)$-PML隐私的释放噪声条件。4. 提出了一种求解隐私保护估计器的方法，并给出其稳态估计误差的上界。5. 通过电力系统仿真展示了隐私与效用的权衡。

Conclusion: 该研究为在存在对手先验知识的情况下实现隐私保护状态估计提供了理论基础和实用方法。通过联合优化估计器增益和释放噪声，可以设计出在满足隐私要求的同时，将状态估计误差控制在可接受范围内的系统。

Abstract: State estimation is widely used in networked dynamical systems, but released estimates may inadvertently reveal sensitive information about private state variables. Existing privacy-preserving estimation frameworks often do not explicitly account for adversarial prior knowledge. Motivated by this gap, we study privacy-preserving state estimation for discrete-time linear stochastic systems under prior information exposure using pointwise maximal leakage (PML). We first reveal a privacy anti-optimality property of the Kalman filter: in the absence of additive release noise, the steady-state Kalman filter maximizes PML privacy leakage among the considered class of stable linear estimators. We further establish a nontrivial lower bound on the steady-state estimation error enforced by $(\varepsilon,δ)$-PML privacy. We then derive sufficient release-noise conditions that guarantee $(\varepsilon,δ)$-PML privacy, first for the Kalman filter and then for stable linear estimators. Finally, a convex semidefinite program is formulated for a joint design of the estimator gain and release noise covariance, providing a tractable privacy-preserving estimator with an explicit upper bound on the steady-state estimation error. Simulations on a source--load power system demonstrate the proposed privacy--utility tradeoff.

</details>


### [1272] [NANO: A Unified Optimization Framework for Nonlinear Gaussian Filtering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16576)
*Zhenxuan Ma,Haoning Wang,Wenhan Cao,Shengbo Eben Li*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了自然梯度高斯近似（NANO）框架，用于非线性滤波，将预测和测量更新视为高斯分布上的优化问题，使用自然梯度更新分布参数，并实现了两种具体方法NANO-P和NANO-W，在多个基准测试中取得了最佳估计精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的卡尔曼滤波在高斯近似下，近似误差会影响状态估计和不确定性。需要一种新的方法来改善非线性系统中的滤波精度。

Method: 将预测和测量更新公式化为高斯分布上的优化问题，将整个高斯分布作为优化变量。采用自然梯度优化，联合更新分布参数。提出了基于KL散度的NANO-P和基于Wasserstein距离的NANO-W两种具体实现。

Result: NANO框架下的NANO-P和NANO-W在六个基准测试中都取得了比现有方法更高的估计精度。NANO-P通过曲率近似保持协方差正定，NANO-W通过协方差传输更新处理不确定曲率。

Conclusion: NANO框架提供了一个统一的非线性滤波方法，能够通过自然梯度优化高斯分布，实现优于现有方法的估计精度，并且通过不同的距离度量（KL散度和Wasserstein距离）可以适应不同的情况，具有实际应用的可行性。

Abstract: Conventional Gaussian filtering typically approximates nonlinear models or their statistical moments and retains the Kalman update structure. The resulting approximation errors can affect both state estimates and their uncertainty. This paper presents the Natural Gradient Gaussian Approximation (NANO) framework for nonlinear filtering. Both prediction and measurement update are formulated as optimization problems over Gaussian distributions, with the entire Gaussian distribution serving as the optimization variable. The framework integrates observation losses, distributional discrepancies, natural-gradient optimization, and finite-step update rules, providing a unified formulation for constructing different filters. Natural-gradient iterations account for the geometry of the Gaussian family and jointly update the distribution parameters. The framework incorporates the existing NANO-P method using the Kullback-Leibler divergence and introduces NANO-W using the Wasserstein distance. NANO-P maintains covariance positive definiteness through a positive-semidefinite curvature approximation, while NANO-W uses a covariance transport update that accommodates indefinite curvature. Their update rules and sufficient conditions for covariance positive definiteness are established within the common framework. Through these two realizations, the proposed framework achieves the best estimation accuracy among the evaluated methods on each of six benchmarks. Runtime evaluations further assess its computational feasibility for practical applications.

</details>


### [1273] [Safeguarding Intelligent Power Dispatch:A Performance-Equivalent-Model-Based Safety-Critical Control Method for DC Microgrids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16718)
*Shaoliang Zhou,Ziqing Zhu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一种安全感知的调度调整框架，结合性能等效模型（PEM-CLS）和高阶控制屏障函数/控制李雅普诺夫函数（HOCBF-CLF-QP），以解决微电网智能功率调度的安全问题，即使在系统动态不确定和异构的情况下也能确保安全执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有微电网智能功率调度方法由于准确表征可行操作区域的困难以及指令执行过程中的动态不安全性而受到现实部署的限制。

Method: 提出了一种安全感知的调度调整框架，该框架使用性能等效建模（PEM-CLS）来捕获闭环系统的动态，并且嵌入高阶控制屏障函数和控制李雅普诺夫函数于二次规划（HOCBF-CLF-QP）中。PEM-CLS仅从端口响应中建模，误差可分析界定。HOCBF-CLF-QP则用于协调异构瞬态功率响应并纠正不安全的EMS指令。

Result: 在四个极端压力测试场景中，提出的框架保持了QP的可行性，并将DC-bus电压偏差限制在安全范围内，而没有该框架的干预，电压都会超出安全限值。

Conclusion: 该框架为智能功率调度提供了一个算法无关的安全执行层，无需精确的可行区域模型或详细的底层设备内部信息，有效地解决了动态执行过程中的不安全性问题。

Abstract: Intelligent power dispatch is enabling fast and self-adaptive decision-making in microgrids, yet its deployment in real-world industry remains limited due to unresolved safety concerns. Existing safety-preserving approaches typically rely on an accurate characterization of the feasible operating region, which is impossible to obtain under uncertain and heterogeneous system dynamics. Moreover, even a dispatch command verified as feasible at a discrete setpoint may become unsafe during its continuous physical execution. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a safety-aware dispatch adjustment framework that uses performance-equivalent modeling of closed-loop systems (PEM-CLS) and embeds high-order control barrier functions and control Lyapunov functions within a quadratic programming formulation (HOCBF-CLF-QP). PEM-CLS captures EMS-required power-regulation dynamics solely from port-level responses, without requiring internal subsystem models, parameters, or controller information. Its modeling error is analytically characterized and explicitly bounded, enabling requirement-oriented dynamic abstraction for safety-critical control. Based on these PEMs, the HOCBF-CLF-QP safety controller coordinates heterogeneous transient power responses and corrects unsafe EMS commands to maintain dynamic safety during command execution. Four deliberately constructed extreme stress-test scenarios are used to expose conflicts between nominal EMS commands and physical safety. Without intervention, the DC-bus voltage violates its safety limit in all four cases, whereas the proposed framework maintains QP feasibility and limits the voltage deviation. The results demonstrate that the proposed framework provides an algorithm-agnostic safety execution layer for intelligent power dispatch without requiring an exact feasible-region model or detailed internal information of lower-level devices.

</details>


### [1274] [DCCB-Capability-Aware Optimal Info-Power Flow for Transmission Switching in AC/MTDC Grids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16777)
*Haixiao Li,Aleksandra Lekić*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的信息-电力流（OIPF）优化模型，用于解决交流/多端直流（MTDC）电网在直流侧故障后的输电切换问题，该模型考虑了通信资源可用性和直流断路器（DCCB）的延迟开断能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有输电切换模型未考虑通信资源限制和DCCB的延迟开断能力，这可能导致实际应用中的问题。因此，需要一个能同时考虑信息传输和电力流优化的模型。

Method: 开发了一个显式的最优信息-电力流（OIPF）模型，将其构建为混合整数二阶锥规划（MISOCP）问题。该模型结合了通信路径可用性、通信资源以及考虑了延迟开断电流的DCCB可行性约束。

Result: 仿真结果表明，有限的通信容量和路由成本会影响输电切换的可行性和经济性。同时，考虑延迟的DCCB开断约束可能会倾向于选择延迟较低但成本较高的通信路径。

Conclusion: 提出的OIPF模型能够更准确地评估AC/MTDC电网中考虑通信和DCCB延迟约束的输电切换策略，为实际系统运行提供了更可靠的决策支持。

Abstract: Transmission switching is an effective approach for restoring operational flexibility and improving the economic performance of AC/multi-terminal DC (MTDC) grids following DC-side faults. Its practical implementation requires that the faulted branch be safely isolated and that the associated switching commands be successfully delivered through the communication network. However, conventional transmission switching models generally represent switching actions using binary variables, without considering the availability of communication resources or whether the corresponding DC circuit breakers (DCCBs) can interrupt the fault current affected by time delay. To address these issues, this paper develops an explicit optimal info--power flow (OIPF) formulation that incorporates information transmission into the post-fault transmission-switching optimization for AC/MTDC grids. The switching status of each DC branch is determined by the availability of its communication path and associated communication resources. In addition, binary switching decisions are supplemented by a DCCB feasibility constraint that limits the estimated delayed-interruption current to the DCCB breaking capability. The resulting problem is formulated as a mixed-integer second-order cone programming (MISOCP) model that can be efficiently solved using off-the-shelf optimization solvers. Numerical results reveal that limited communication capacity and additional routing costs may render electrically beneficial switching actions infeasible or uneconomical, while delay-aware DCCB interruption constraints may favor lower-delay communication routes despite their higher costs.

</details>


### [1275] [Venusian Radio Occultation Constellation Design and Reconfiguration Problems: A Benders Decomposition Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16807)
*David O. Williams Rogers,Trupti P. Gosavi,Hang Woon Lee*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种利用航天器星座进行金星大气射电掩星（RO）测量的整数线性规划模型，以解决单航天器数据吞吐量限制的问题，并提出了Benders分解方法来解决大规模实例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有金星大气研究的单航天器射电掩星（RO）方法受限于数据吞吐量，而现有星座方法过于简化，无法适应复杂任务需求。任务目标可能需要实时重构星座。

Method: 提出两个整数线性规划问题：RO星座配置设计问题（RO Constellation Configuration Design Problem）和RO星座重构问题（RO Constellation Reconfiguration Problem）。采用Benders分解方法解决模型求解空间爆炸的问题。

Result: 数值实验表明，所提出的模型适用于星座配置设计，能够支持从全球大气剖面探测到特定区域（如火山区域）的按需探测。Benders分解方法能够高效地获得大规模实例的高质量解。

Conclusion: 所提出的整数线性规划模型和Benders分解方法能够有效地解决金星大气RO测量的星座设计和运行问题，实现更高的数据吞吐量和更灵活的任务响应能力。

Abstract: Driven by the scientific value of Venusian atmospheric studies, numerous missions, such as Magellan and Venus Express, have relied on single-spacecraft radio occultation (RO) experiments. Despite their proven success, data throughput is inherently limited by the use of a single transmitter and its relative geometry with respect to Earth-based receivers. Therefore, the literature proposes leveraging a constellation of spacecraft to increase RO measurement opportunities and improve spatial and temporal coverage; however, current efforts impose strict simplifying assumptions that limit their applicability and responsiveness to complex mission narratives. Beyond initial constellation design, evolving mission objectives may require event-based constellation reconfiguration during operations. To address both design and operational needs, we propose two problems formulated as integer linear programs: the RO Constellation Configuration Design Problem and the RO Constellation Reconfiguration Problem. Further, we address the programs' solution-space explosion with a Benders decomposition approach. Numerical experiments show the applicability of our problems for constellation configuration design, tackle the full mission pipeline, transitioning from global atmospheric profiling to on-demand regional profiling above areas of volcanic interest, and show that the Benders decomposition approach efficiently obtains high-quality solutions to large-scale instances.

</details>


### [1276] [Controller-Agnostic Runtime Safety Certificates for Tool-Using AI Agents via Data-Driven Robust Reachability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16865)
*Ali Baheri,Peng Wei*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 研究提出了一种运行时过滤器（shield），用于约束大型语言模型（LLM）软件代理执行不可撤销工具调用时的风险。该方法将LLM代理视为一个不透明的反馈控制器，并利用日志数据构建一个有限的马尔可夫链模型，然后在该模型上进行安全保证计算。该过滤器保证在有界任务期间达到不安全状态的概率有界，并且对控制器具有鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型软件代理通过工具调用进行交互，其中一些操作是不可逆的。将LLM视为一个难以分析的不透明反馈控制器，需要一种方法来保证其行为的安全性，特别是在执行关键任务时。

Method: 该研究提出了一种运行时过滤器（shield），放置在LLM控制器和环境之间。它首先利用谓词抽象和候选后继集，然后从日志中提取数据。通过日志数据，将闭环系统建模为一个有限的受控马尔可夫链，并为估计的转移核加上一个无分布的置信区域。接着，在建立的模型上运行鲁棒的reach-avoid价值迭代算法来计算安全保证。该过滤器提供了一个概率近似正确（PAC）的保证，并且对于满足过滤器的控制器是统一的。

Result: 在所有测试的数据集上，真实风险都保持在证书和预算范围内。在一个文件系统沙箱环境中，该过滤器对一个日志中很少覆盖的危险场景保持了其有效性，而一个基线方法失败了。此外，该过滤器对七个不同的控制器（包括三个开源模型）保证了在1050个试验中零不安全结果。

Conclusion: 所提出的运行时过滤器（shield）能够有效地为大型语言模型软件代理提供运行时的安全保证，限制达到不安全状态的概率，并且对不同的模型具有鲁棒性，无需重新计算。

Abstract: Software agents built on large language models act by issuing tool calls, some of which cannot be undone. To control theory the model is an opaque feedback controller, replaced every few months, whose closed loop cannot be analyzed directly. We propose a runtime filter, or shield, between any such controller and its environment that certifies a bound on the probability of reaching an unsafe condition during a bounded task. Given a predicate abstraction and candidate successor sets, everything else comes from logs: the loop becomes a finite controlled Markov chain, the estimated kernel is surrounded by a distribution-free confidence region, and robust reach-avoid value iteration runs over it. The certificate is probably approximately correct and uniform over controllers respecting the filter, so one model may replace another without recomputation. In all tested datasets the true risk stayed within certificate and budget; in a file-system sandbox the filter stays sound against a hazard the logs barely covered, where a plug-in baseline certifies safety and fails; and it holds seven controllers, three of them open-weights models, to zero unsafe outcomes in 1050 episodes.

</details>


### [1277] [Counterfactual Action-Conditioned Graph Prediction for Cascading-Failure Mitigation in Power Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16905)
*Fangxin Liu,Zhentao Tian*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种动作条件图预测器（ACGP）来预测多步级联故障并进行闭环缓解。通过反事实分支程序，ACGP能够学习动作对电网状态、线路连通性和保护动作的影响。将其嵌入到滚动视界控制器中，可以在预测的未来中选择最优干预措施，从而显著降低电网故障率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的级联故障缓解方法难以应对复杂的、多步骤的电网动态变化。研究动机是开发一种能够预测不同干预措施对电网未来轨迹影响的方法，从而实现有效的闭环控制。

Method: 提出了一种动作条件图预测器（ACGP），采用“同状态反事实分支”程序生成数据集，该程序在相同的电网初始状态下模拟不同操作（动作）产生的不同电网状态、线路连通性、保护动作和终端风险。ACGP被集成到一个滚动视界控制器中，该控制器评估未来五步的可能情况，选择最佳干预措施，并在观察到下一个状态后重新规划。

Result: ACGP在测试集上取得了5步线路负载平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.0369，重调度配对排序准确率为0.806。与不采取任何措施相比，在闭环Grid2Op实验中，终端故障率从53.3%降至12.2%，级联故障率从51.1%降至7.8%，接近模拟器参考值。

Conclusion: 同状态反事实预测能够有效地支持不同干预措施的比较，并实现有效的基于反馈的级联故障缓解，显著提高了电网的稳定性和可靠性。

Abstract: Cascading failures develop through coupled power flow redistribution, protection actions, and topology changes, making remedial control dependent on how alternative interventions modify the subsequent trajectory. This paper develops an action-conditioned graph predictor (ACGP) for multi-step cascade prediction and closed-loop mitigation. A same-state counterfactual branching procedure replays identical post-contingency grid states under multiple legal actions while preserving the exogenous trajectory, providing direct supervision for action-dependent electrical states, line connectivity, automatic protection trips, and terminal risk. ACGP is embedded in a receding-horizon controller that evaluates five-step candidate futures, executes the selected intervention, and replans from the observed next state. The final dataset contains 2,860 counter factual roots and 22,880 action-conditioned branches. On the held-out test set, ACGP achieves a five-step line-loading MAE of 0.0369 and a redispatch pairwise ranking accuracy of 0.806; action ablations reduce the ranking accuracy to approximately chance level. In closed-loop Grid2Op experiments, terminal-failure and cascade rates decrease from 53.3% and 51.1% under do-nothing operation to 12.2% and 7.8%, respectively, close to the simulator-reference values of 11.1% and 6.7%. The results show that same-state counterfactual prediction can support effective action comparison and feedback-based cascading-failure mitigation.

</details>


### [1278] [A Power-Trajectory Framework for Data Center Participation in Day-Ahead Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16918)
*Menghan Zhang,Caisheng Wang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于功率轨迹的框架，允许数据中心在日前电力市场中声明其可预测的聚合负荷演变，以解决当前基于时间段的交易方式与数据中心实时负荷需求之间的不匹配问题，从而实现更精确的结算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据中心电力需求快速增长，而当前电力市场以时间段为基础的交易方式无法准确反映数据中心内部负荷的动态变化，可能导致发电不匹配和结算问题。

Method: 提出功率轨迹框架，数据中心在市场出清前声明其可预测的聚合负荷演变，这些轨迹作为外生输入用于构建发电轨迹和对应的价格轨迹。通过连续时间功率平衡、发电运行约束和经济结算的双重时间一致性来保证市场出清结果的可行性。

Result: 所提出的框架能够消除由表示方式引起的功率不平衡。通过案例研究，量化了因时间一致性清算和结算而产生的供应侧补偿的货币价值，并识别了其发生的时间和物理来源。

Conclusion: 功率轨迹框架能够更精确地匹配数据中心的负荷需求和发电调度，消除表示引起的功率不平衡，并为供应侧补偿提供清晰的结算机制，尤其是在数据中心负荷需求波动的情况下。

Abstract: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) is driving substantial growth in data center electricity demand. Interval-based energy blocks in day-ahead markets do not explicitly retain predictable intra-interval demand evolution, potentially creating mismatches with ramp-feasible generation trajectories and affecting settlement. This paper proposes a power-trajectory framework in which data centers declare predictable aggregate demand evolution through continuous demand-side power trajectories before market clearing. The declared trajectories are treated as exogenous inputs for constructing generation trajectories and the corresponding price trajectory. For feasible market-clearing outcomes, physical temporal consistency is established through continuous-time power balance and satisfaction of the modeled generation operating constraints, while economic temporal consistency is established by preserving the dispatch-price correspondence in energy settlement on a common temporal basis. Under the adopted settlement definitions, a trajectory-based settlement analysis separately quantifies the monetary magnitude of representation-induced power imbalances and the supply-side compensation that may remain under temporally consistent clearing and settlement. An illustrative 5-bus case demonstrates the elimination of representation-induced power imbalance and identifies the timing and physical sources of supply-side compensation. A modified IEEE RTS-GMLC case further illustrates these compensation effects across multiple generating units under workload-driven data center demand variations.

</details>


### [1279] [Multi-Agent Deferred-Decision Trajectory Optimization with Anytime-Valid Target Retention for Moving Candidates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17003)
*Farbod Siahkali,Mengxue Hou,Vijay Gupta*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出了一种多智能体末端拦截控制器 (DDTO)，该控制器能够处理目标身份和目标位置不确定的情况，并通过顺序候选拒绝和机会成本约束分配来优化轨迹，成功率可达 85%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究的是多智能体末端拦截问题，其中目标身份和目标末端位置均不确定，需要同时确定目标身份并执行拦截。

Method: 开发了一种称为“前进视界延迟决策轨迹优化”(DDTO) 的控制器。该控制器结合了：1) 一致的末端位置预测；2) 顺序候选拒绝；3) 容量约束分配；4) 候选依赖规划。在满足交换性条件和可预测查询的情况下，该方法可以实现固定时间的末端位置覆盖和随时有效的目标保留。

Result: 在控制器最后一次重新规划（剩余一步控制）时，该控制器限制了 DDTO 计划通过非线性滚动验证但捕获失败的联合概率。在 100 对模拟场景中，当严格的控制成本预算下，目标捕获率为 79%；当预算放宽时，捕获率为 85%。

Conclusion: 所提出的 DDTO 控制器能够有效地处理多智能体末端拦截中的不确定性问题，并在实际应用中展现出较高的目标捕获成功率。

Abstract: We study multi-agent terminal interception when one of several moving candidates is the unknown target and both target identity and candidate terminal locations are uncertain. We develop a receding-horizon deferred-decision trajectory optimization (DDTO) controller that combines conformal terminal-location prediction, sequential candidate rejection, capacity-constrained assignment, and candidate-contingent planning. Under exchangeability conditions for terminal and identity residuals, with predictable querying, we establish fixed-time terminal-location coverage and anytime-valid target retention. At the final replan, when one control step remains, we bound the joint probability that a tightened-set DDTO plan passes nonlinear rollout verification but capture fails. The closed-loop controller applies fallback guidance to any agent without a verified DDTO plan and, across 100 paired scenarios, captures 79% of targets under the strict control-effort budget and 85% when that budget is relaxed.

</details>


### [1280] [Wing Rock Modeling and Control for Flight-Critical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17011)
*Eugene Lavretsky,Miroslav Krstic*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种基于洛伦兹动力学系统模拟的机翼摆动（WR）模型，并利用此模型进行了飞行控制设计研究，以抑制WR现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三角翼飞机在低速高迎角时，常出现阻尼不足的横侧向动力学，例如荷兰滚模式，导致机翼摆动（WR）现象。

Method: 将WR定义为由外部涡流输入引起的、频率接近阻尼不足的荷兰滚模式。涡流信号来源于纳维-斯托克斯方程的傅里叶-伽辽金近似，空气速度由三个耦合双线性常微分方程组成的洛伦兹动力学系统计算得出。该系统作为干扰发生器，作用于飞机横侧向模式，激发WR。基于此模型，进行飞行控制设计权衡研究。

Result: 所提出的模型能够模拟并解释WR现象，为飞行控制设计提供了基础。

Conclusion: 通过建立基于洛伦兹动力学系统的WR模型，可以有效地研究和设计飞行控制策略来抑制三角翼飞机的WR现象。

Abstract: Aircraft equipped with delta wings are designed to be aerodynamically efficient in high-speed flight. However, at low-speed flight conditions with sufficiently high angle of attack, these vehicles often have lightly damped, close to unstable lateral-directional dynamics, such as the dutch roll mode. As a result, a delta wing aircraft often exhibits the so-called wing rock (WR) phenomenon, with a back and forth rocking motion, while the aircraft sideslip angle, the roll and the yaw angular rates remain small. In this paper, the WR dynamics are defined as a lightly damped dutch roll mode excited by airmass vortical external input, acting at or near the dutch roll natural frequency. The vortical signal comes from Fourier-Galerkin approximation of the Navier-Stokes equation, with no-penetration boundary conditions and the resulting airmass velocities are calculated by the Lorenz dynamical system of three coupled bilinear ordinary differential equations. In that context, the Lorenz bilinear dynamics become the disturbance-generator exosystem, acting on the lightly damped lateral-directional aircraft mode at or near its natural frequency, and thus exciting it to produce near oscillatory wing rocking motion. Using the proposed model, a flight control design trade study is conducted to mitigate and suppress the WR phenomenon.

</details>


### [1281] [A Deficiency-Based Approach for Unbalanced Three-Phase Distribution System Expansion Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17106)
*Eli Brock,Miguel Heleno,Javad Lavaei,Somayeh Sojoudi*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种迭代式配电网规划方法，通过交替解决最优潮流（OPF）和混合整数线性规划（MILP）问题，来有效地处理不平衡三相电网的升级规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的配电网规划方法存在无法处理不平衡三相电网或难以扩展的问题。需要一种更有效、可扩展的优化方法。

Method: 该方法采用迭代规划过程，交替进行以下两类问题求解：1. 最优潮流（OPF）问题：量化候选投资组合的不足，通过优化可控设备的调度来测量热力和电压违规，最优值为零时表示规划足够。OPF乘子用于近似估计每个投资候选的缓解效果。2. 混合整数线性规划（MILP）问题：基于OPF乘子的近似，使用切割平面搜索法提出下一个候选投资组合。

Result: 在SMART-DS数据集的六个不平衡三相馈线上，该方法优于基于线性化优化的基准方法。不同OPF定义下的结果也表现出一致性。

Conclusion: 所提出的迭代规划方法能够有效解决不平衡三相配电网的升级规划问题，并在性能上优于现有方法。

Abstract: Distribution planners typically characterize grid needs through power flow studies and fit upgrades to those needs by hand. More principled one-shot optimization methods either do not scale or misrepresent unbalanced three-phase networks. This paper proposes an iterative planning process that alternates between two problem classes with mature off-the-shelf solvers. An optimal power flow (OPF) problem quantifies the deficiency of a candidate portfolio by optimizing the dispatch of controllable devices and measuring thermal and voltage violations on a common scale, with an optimal value of zero exactly at adequate portfolios. The OPF multipliers give a first-order approximation of the relief each investment candidate would provide. We bound the error of this approximation and show that structural properties of the deficiency guard it against overestimation. Building on this property, a heuristic cutting-plane search uses a mixed-integer linear program to propose each next portfolio from these approximations. On six unbalanced three-phase feeders from the SMART-DS dataset, the search outperforms a linearized optimization-based benchmark, and the results agree across five variants of the deficiency.

</details>


### [1282] [Coordinated Conservation Voltage Reduction and Network Topology Reconfiguration in Active Distribution Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17122)
*Rida Fatima,Hassan Zahid Butt,Xingpeng Li*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一种联合优化电压控制（CVR）和网络拓扑重构（NTR）的日调度框架，以提高配电网的效率和可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的CVR和NTR策略通常独立部署，忽略了它们之间相互作用的影响。本研究旨在通过联合优化来弥补这一不足，以实现更好的效益。

Method: 提出了一种基于混合整数二阶锥规划（MISOCP）的日调度框架，联合优化馈线电压控制和网络重构。该框架考虑了交流潮流约束、ZIP负荷模型、分布式能源（DERs）、电池储能系统以及多馈线径向性。

Result: 在IEEE 33节点和123节点系统上的仿真结果表明，联合优化CVR和NTR在降低有功能量损耗、减少电压相关负荷方面优于单独使用CVR或NTR。在不同负荷和DER渗透率下，联合优化显示出互补且依赖于运行条件的效益。在高负荷情况下，联合优化策略能保持系统可行性。

Conclusion: 联合优化CVR和NTR策略可以提供比独立部署更显著的效益，并且这些效益受到负荷特性、DER组合、馈线拓扑和电压裕度等多种因素的影响。因此，联合优化对于提升配电网的运行效率和可靠性具有重要价值。

Abstract: Distribution networks rely on conservation voltage reduction (CVR) and network topology reconfiguration (NTR) to manage demand, distributed energy resources (DERs), and tighter operating margins. Yet these strategies are typically deployed independently, despite coupled effects on feeder voltages, losses, and loading. This paper addresses that gap by developing a day-ahead mixed-integer second order cone programming (MISOCP) framework that jointly optimizes feeder head voltage control and network reconfiguration. The formulation incorporates AC branch flow constraints, ZIP load models, DERs, battery energy storage systems, and multi substation radiality. Using modified IEEE 33 bus and 123 bus systems, four configurations isolate the individual and coordinated effects of CVR and NTR. On the 33-bus system under mixed ZIP loading, NTR reduces active energy loss by 2.50%, while coordinated operation reduces it by 2.91% relative to SDN and produces a 2.46% CVR induced active load reduction relative to SDNTR. Under constant impedance loading, coordinated operation reduces active energy loss by 17.65% relative to SDN, while CVR reduces active load by 14.61% relative to SDNTR. DER portfolio scaling shows a nonmonotonic coordinated load reduction response, strongest at 20% penetration and decreasing at higher levels. On the 123 bus system, NTR reduces losses by 19.3%, while CVR reduces voltage dependent load energy by 2.3 to 2.4%. Under loading stress, SDN becomes infeasible at 120% loading, whereas CEDNTR remains feasible. Overall, the results demonstrate complementary, operating condition dependent benefits shaped by load composition, DER portfolio scaling, feeder topology, voltage margins, and source constraints, highlighting the value of joint optimization.

</details>


### [1283] [Reduced-Order Backstepping Control of Nonlinear Mechanical Systems with Input Delay via Galerkin Projection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17272)
*Amirhossein Asadi,Nitin Sharma*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种用于处理输入延迟的非线性机械系统的轨迹跟踪方法，通过将延迟转化为偏微分方程，并使用Galerkin方法进行降阶近似，最终设计了反步控制器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决具有输入延迟的非线性机械系统的轨迹跟踪问题，以克服实际应用中延迟带来的挑战。

Method: 将输入延迟表示为传输偏微分方程，构建耦合的植物-通道模型。利用Galerkin投影对延迟通道进行有限维近似，得到显式的常微分方程模型。在此基础上，设计反步控制器，并通过Lyapunov稳定性分析证明其稳定性。此外，还提出了命令滤波反步控制器以简化实际操作。

Result: 推导了控制器，并通过Lyapunov分析证明了降阶模型名义跟踪误差的均匀指数稳定性。对于命令滤波版本，证明了均匀最终有界性。

Conclusion: 所提出的基于Galerkin近似和反步法的控制器能够有效地实现具有输入延迟的非线性机械系统的轨迹跟踪，并且命令滤波版本有助于实际应用。

Abstract: This paper addresses trajectory tracking for a class of nonlinear mechanical systems with input delay. The delayed actuator channel is represented as an equivalent transport partial differential equation, thereby transforming the original delayed system into a coupled plant-channel representation. A finite-dimensional approximation of the delay channel is then constructed through Galerkin projection, resulting in an explicit ODE model of the delayed actuator dynamics. Using this reduced-order plant-channel model, a backstepping controller is developed, and Lyapunov analysis establishes uniform exponential stability of the nominal tracking error dynamics for the reduced-order Galerkin model. To enhance practical implementation, a command-filtered version is also introduced to avoid direct differentiation of virtual controls, for which a corresponding uniform ultimate boundedness result is obtained. Simulation studies are provided to validate the proposed design and illustrate the effectiveness of the method.

</details>


### [1284] [Safety-Aware Dimension Selection for Reduced-Order Model Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17274)
*Amirhossein Asadi,Nitin Sharma*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种安全感知的降维方法，用于模型预测控制（MPC），该方法能够根据维持有限时间范围内的安全条件所需的模型阶数来动态调整降维，从而在保证安全性的前提下最小化计算复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维系统的模型预测控制（MPC）在计算上可能非常耗时，而为了保证安全关键操作而选择的降维模型可能不足以满足性能要求。因此，需要一种能够平衡性能和安全性的降维方法。

Method: 该方法结合了动态激活子空间（用于性能导向的降维）和有限时间范围内的误差界（用于离散时间控制屏障函数约束）。控制器会选择最小的预测阶数，以确保安全关键的MPC问题仍然可行。通过理论证明了全阶时间范围内的安全性、递归可行性和安全集闭环不变性。

Result: 所提出的方法能够根据安全要求自适应地调整预测的复杂性，避免在正常运行期间进行不必要的高维预测。理论上证明了该方法的安全性、递归可行性和安全集不变性。

Conclusion: 该安全感知降维框架能够有效管理MPC的计算复杂度，同时保证安全关键系统的安全性，通过动态调整降维阶数来满足安全需求，从而实现计算效率和安全性的兼顾。

Abstract: Model reduction can substantially reduce the computational burden of model predictive control (MPC) for high-dimensional systems, but a reduced dimension chosen for performance may be insufficient for safety-critical operation. This paper introduces a safety-aware dimension-selection framework in which the prediction model adapts to the order of the model required to maintain a certified finite-horizon safety condition. Dynamic active subspaces provide a performance-oriented ordering of reduced coordinates, while finite-horizon error bounds robustly enforce discrete-time control barrier function constraints. The controller selects the smallest prediction order for which the resulting safety-critical MPC problem remains feasible. We establish full-order horizon safety, recursive feasibility, and closed-loop invariance of the safe set under the proposed reduced-order formulation. The proposed approach therefore adapts the prediction complexity to safety requirements, avoiding unnecessary high-dimensional prediction during benign operation.

</details>


### [1285] [Stabilizing Low-Stiffness Soft Robots at Unstable Equilibria: A Model-Based Optimal Control Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17295)
*Nikhil Nair,Daniele Caradonna,Anup Teejo Mathew,Federico Renda,Cosimo Della Santina,Daniel Feliu-Talegon*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于DDP的非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）方法，用于稳定具有高非线性和欠驱动特性的连续体软体机器人，尤其是在低刚度、重力主导的情况下，并在实时（50-150 Hz）下实现了高效稳定的控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续体软体机器人在不确定性和重力占主导的低刚度环境下，稳定其在不稳定的平衡点附近非常困难，需要一种高效且适合实时运行的控制方法。

Method: 结合了基于微分动态规划（DDP）的非线性模型预测控制（NMPC），以及一种带有解析导数的降阶变量应变模型（Variable Strain model）。

Result: 该方法能够有效稳定软体倒立摆和其他混合软硬体系统，相比传统控制器表现更优，能稳定更具挑战性的配置，并在实时频率（50-150 Hz）下可靠运行。

Conclusion: 该NMPC框架证明了其在解决连续体软体机器人稳定问题上的有效性和实际可行性，尤其是在低刚度和重力影响显著的场景下，并可在实时速度下操作。

Abstract: Continuum soft robots are highly nonlinear and underactuated systems, which makes stabilizing them around unstable equilibrium points difficult. This challenge becomes even greater in low stiffness regimes, where gravitational forces dominate elastic forces. In this letter, we explore whether optimal control can address these challenges using a computa- tionally efficient method suitable for real time use. We propose a nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) approach based on Differential Dynamic Programming (DDP), combined with an accurate reduced order Variable Strain model with analytical derivatives. This results in an efficient control framework for addressing the stabilization problem. Tested on a soft inverted pendulum and other hybrid soft rigid systems, the method outperforms traditional controllers, stabilizes more challenging configurations, and operates reliably at real time speeds (50 150 Hz), demonstrating both effectiveness and practical feasibility in experimental settings.

</details>


### [1286] [Reach-Avoid Certificates for Contact-based Stochastic Hybrid Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17308)
*Tianyi Xia,Ryan K. Cosner*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出了一种用于随机混合系统的认证可达-避免控制的新方法，该方法能够处理由随机微分方程控制的连续流和由控制器的输入决定的跳跃分布，实现了无限时间范围内的概率保证，并通过线性规划求解。该方法在模拟和实际问题中均取得了良好效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于随机混合系统的认证可达-避免控制方法存在局限性，如假设跳跃时间是自发的或由控制器选择、仅限于有限时间范围或离散时间动力学。本文旨在克服这些局限性，实现无限时间范围内、概率保证的可达-避免控制。

Method: 本文引入了“可达-避免接触证书”，该证书仅在子层级走廊上施加流和跳跃条件。通过兼容的重置策略，证明了任何此类证书都能满足规范。利用一个逐点安全过滤器，将保证从验证扩展到控制，约束任意标称控制器。证明了执行是非Zeno的，并给出了期望稳定时间和重置计数的界限。证书搜索被框架化为在任何二次可微词典上的线性规划，然后进行独立的验证。

Result: 提出的方法能够覆盖93.6%的真实情况的认证区域。在带球问题中，基于证书的安全过滤器在200次试验中将碰撞次数从68次降至零，同时实现了目标。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一种用于随机混合系统的认证可达-避免控制的新方法，该方法在理论上和实践上都具有有效性，能够处理复杂的随机动态，并为安全可靠的控制系统设计提供了新的途径。

Abstract: This work studies certified reach-avoid control of stochastic hybrid systems in which a stochastic differential equation governs continuous flow and a controlled stochastic kernel governs guard-triggered resets. The input appears only in the reset kernel, where it determines the post-jump distribution. Certificates for such systems have so far assumed spontaneous or controller-chosen jump times, a finite horizon, or discrete-time dynamics; we certify, over the infinite horizon, that the target is reached before the unsafe set with at least a prescribed probability. First, we introduce reach-avoid contact certificates, whose flow and jump conditions are imposed only on a sublevel corridor, and prove that any such certificate with a compatible reset policy meets the specification; a pointwise safety filter extends this guarantee from verification to control by constraining arbitrary nominal controllers. Next, we prove that executions are non-Zeno and bound the expected settling time and reset count. We frame certificate search as a linear program over any twice-differentiable dictionary followed by independent verification. We illustrate our approach via comparisons where the certified region is a subset covering 93.6\% of the ground truth and where our certificate-based safety filter reaches the goal while reducing collisions from 68 to zero across 200 episodes of a dribbling ball problem.

</details>


### [1287] [STATCOM-Based Flicker Mitigation in Electric Arc Furnace Systems Using DQ-PI and Lyapunov-Based Nonlinear Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17330)
*Vikram Chekuri,Narapareddy Ramarao,Prashanth N A*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文比较了两种STATCOM内部控制器（分频DQ-PI和Lyapunov非线性设计）在抑制电弧炉引起的电压闪变方面的性能。结果显示，两种控制器都能显著降低闪变严重程度，但Lyapunov控制器在不同随机工况下的鲁棒性更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电弧炉引起的随机无功功率波动会导致公共连接点电压闪变，影响电网质量。需要有效的控制器来抑制这种闪变。

Method: 使用分频DQ-PI和Lyapunov非线性控制器两种STATCOM内部控制策略。通过冻结的元启发式算法优化控制器增益，并使用IEC 61000-4-15数字闪烁表在600秒内进行评估。后经过对原始随机模型进行周期性检查后，在十个独立的、预先指定的随机工况下进行验证，并与未补偿情况进行对比。

Result: 两种控制器均能显著降低平均短期闪变严重程度（相对未补偿基线约62%），两者之间的平均闪变严重程度没有统计学上的显著差异。然而，在不同随机工况下的敏感性方面，Lyapunov控制器相对于DQ-PI控制器具有约三分之一的标准差，显示出更好的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 在评估STATCOM控制器时，仅基于单一随机轨迹推断出的控制器排序并不可靠，需要进行集成验证（ensemble validation）来准确衡量其随机鲁棒性。Lyapunov控制器在面对不同随机电弧行为时表现出更稳定的性能。

Abstract: Electric arc furnaces inject stochastic reactive-power swings that cause voltage flicker at the point of common coupling. This paper compares two STATCOM inner controllers for an 11~kV, 50~Hz furnace feeder: a split-frequency DQ-PI design and a Lyapunov-based nonlinear design whose integral state is retained in the storage function, giving global asymptotic stability of the nominal unsaturated current-error subsystem. Gains for both controllers were tuned by a frozen metaheuristic campaign and then evaluated over 600~s with an IEC~61000-4-15 digital flickermeter. A post-campaign audit showed that the stochastic arc realization used for the original comparison was periodic, so the two selected gain sets were frozen without retuning or reselection and evaluated on ten independent stochastic realizations that had been specified and archived before the STO-ENS validation campaign, together with a paired uncompensated case for each realization. Both controllers reduce the mean short-term flicker severity by about 62% relative to the STO-ENS uncompensated baseline, and no statistically detectable difference in mean flicker severity is found between them. They separate instead in realization sensitivity: the Lyapunov standard deviation across arcs is roughly one third that of DQ-PI. Controller ordering inferred from a single stochastic trajectory is therefore not a reliable measure of stochastic robustness, and ensemble validation is necessary.

</details>


### [1288] [Filtering for Liveness: Recurrence via Backup Reachability Control Barrier Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17337)
*David E. J. van Wijk,Pio Ong,Aaron D. Ames,Joel W. Burdick*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种新的控制框架，用于保证动态系统的周期性重复访问某个集合（即“循环性”），即使允许暂时偏离该集合，只要能及时返回。该框架结合了控制障碍函数（CBF）和基于时间的机制，以在必要时调整名义控制器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的控制方法难以保证系统能够周期性地重复完成某个任务，特别是当任务需要系统在一段时间内离开某个关键区域但又必须及时返回时（例如，无人机竞赛中信标的可视性）。现有的CBF方法主要关注集合的前向不变性，无法满足这种“及时返回”的要求。

Method: 提出一个控制-过滤框架，包含两个关键组件：1.  一个“备份可达性CBF”，用于确保即使在名义控制器行为下，系统也总能在允许的时间内返回目标集合。2.  一个“基于时间的机制”，仅在名义行为可能无法满足返回时间要求时，才激活一个“到达控制器”。

Result: 所提出的框架能够保证系统的循环性，同时在可能的情况下保留名义控制器的行为。通过无人机竞赛的例子验证了该方法在满足循环性约束（如信标可见性）方面的有效性。

Conclusion: 该框架成功地解决了保证动态系统循环性的问题，为需要临时偏离关键区域但要求及时返回的应用提供了新的解决方案，并且在保持名义控制行为和系统性能之间取得了平衡。

Abstract: Liveness requires a dynamical system to repeatedly accomplish a desired objective over time. In this work, we consider a particular form of liveness known as recurrence, which requires the closed-loop trajectory to regularly revisit a prescribed set, with no more than a specified amount of time between visits. Inspired by the control barrier function (CBF) safety-filter paradigm, we develop a controller-filtering framework that makes adjustments to a nominal controller only when necessary to guarantee recurrence. Unlike conventional CBF methods, which enforce set forward invariance, our framework allows the trajectory to leave the set while guaranteeing its timely return. To achieve this, our framework combines two components: a backup reachability CBF that preserves the ability to return to the prescribed set within the allowable time, and a timing-based mechanism that invokes a reaching controller only when the nominal behavior would otherwise fail to meet the return-time requirement. The resulting framework guarantees recurrence while preserving the nominal behavior when possible, enabling control objectives that require temporary excursions from the set, such as traversal between disjoint regions. Our method is successfully utilized in a drone racing example with a recurrence constraint on beacon visibility.

</details>


### [1289] [Direct Electromechanical Actuation of the Shift Drum in Non-Synchronized Motorcycle Transmissions: From Actuator Sizing and Electronics Design to Closed-Loop Position Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17385)
*Johannes Stockhammer*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一种用于摩托车变速鼓的直接机电驱动系统，通过直流电机和自锁蜗轮蜗杆驱动，消除了传统的脚踏换挡机构。系统包括机械、软件和控制设计，并进行了实测验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 消除摩托车变速鼓的传统脚踏换挡机构，实现更高效、更直接的机电驱动。

Method: 使用直流电机通过自锁蜗轮蜗杆驱动变速鼓。开发了定制的换挡控制器，包括电源滤波、传感器信号调理、H桥电机驱动和基于SAMD21微控制器的电路板。固件实现了基于比例控制器的位置控制。

Result: 在齿轮箱测试台上，换挡时间短至80毫秒以内，无超调，且优于手动换挡的平均时间（上挡80毫秒，下挡92毫秒）。分析了蜗轮蜗杆传动比的选择权衡：比率30时，约93%的电机扭矩用于加速；比率约20时，所需扭矩减半，但失去自锁性。发布的换挡时间数据为开放数据集。

Conclusion: 该直接机电驱动系统成功实现了摩托车变速鼓的快速、精确控制，消除了传统换挡机构，并提供了优于手动换挡的性能。蜗轮蜗杆传动比的选择存在扭矩需求和自锁性之间的权衡。

Abstract: This thesis presents the direct electromechanical actuation of the shift drum in a non-synchronized motorcycle transmission. A DC motor drives the shift drum through a self-locking worm gear, so the entire foot shift mechanism is eliminated. As a reference, 84 manual gear changes of a large-displacement series-production motorcycle were measured on a chassis dynamometer; the mean shift time is 80 ms for upshifts and 92 ms for downshifts. The system design covers the complete chain from the mechanics to the software. The actuator motor is sized from inertia, friction and gear ratio. A dedicated shift controller is developed with supply filtering, signal conditioning for the position sensor and the incremental encoder, an H-bridge motor driver and a custom circuit board based on a SAMD21 microcontroller. The embedded firmware implements position control of the shift drum with a proportional controller, without inner speed or current loops. On a gearbox test rig, a gear change is completed in less than 80 ms without overshoot in a single measurement, below the mean of the manual reference shifts. The analysis reveals a trade-off in the choice of the worm gear ratio: at a ratio of 30, about 93% of the motor torque is needed to accelerate the motor shaft and the worm. A ratio of about 8 halves the required torque, but the worm gear then loses its self-locking. The measured shift times are published as an open dataset.

</details>


### [1290] [Input-Constrained Active Disturbance Rejection Control for AUVs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17498)
*Minh-Quan Le,Ying Tan,Jinghe Yang,Jason Monty,Ye Pu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一种用于自主水下航行器（AUVs）的改进型主动抗扰控制（ADRC）方法，通过主动输入饱和和后饱和低通滤波来解决动态环境中由外部干扰和模型不确定性引起的控制难题，并实现了半全局实际渐近稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的ADRC在处理未知干扰和执行器限制下的AUV控制时，其稳定性分析通常假设控制输入及其导数有界，这在实践中难以保证。作者旨在弥合理论与实践之间的差距，提高AUV在复杂环境下的控制鲁棒性。

Method: 该研究在ADRC框架中引入了主动输入饱和和后饱和低通滤波。主动输入饱和限制了控制信号的幅度，而低通滤波器则对饱和后的信号进行正则化处理，确保了输入速率的变化是有界的。结合扩展状态观测器（ESO）在线估计和补偿总计不确定性。

Result: 通过强制执行输入饱和和滤波条件，该方法成功保证了AUV系统的半全局实际渐近稳定性。在高保真仿真和实际水下机器人平台实验中，证明了该方法在恶劣环境干扰和执行器约束下具有鲁棒的控制性能。

Conclusion: 所提出的结合主动输入饱和和后饱和低通滤波的ADRC框架，能够有效地解决AUV在动态环境中控制的挑战，并实现了理论上可证明的稳定性，在实践中表现出优异的鲁棒性。

Abstract: This paper addresses the control of autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) operating in dynamic environments, where wave-induced forces, modelling errors, and actuator limitations make reliable control challenging. Active disturbance rejection control (ADRC), together with an extended state observer (ESO), estimates lumped uncertainties online, simplifying control design using nominal models. However, existing stability analyses typically assume bounded control inputs and derivatives, which are difficult to guarantee under unknown disturbances and measurement noise. To bridge this theory--practice gap, this paper introduces an ADRC framework with active input saturation and post-saturation low-pass filtering. The saturation constrains the control magnitude, while the filter regularizes the saturated signal to ensure bounded input-rate variations. By explicitly enforcing these conditions, the proposed system guarantees semi-global practical asymptotic stability. High-fidelity simulations and experiments on an underwater robotic platform demonstrate robust control performance under severe environmental disturbances and actuator constraints. A supplementary video is available at https://youtu.be/AEFlZ69Yg00.

</details>


### [1291] [Multi-Day Stochastic Dispatch for Power Systems With Long-Duration Storage Using Diffusion-Generated Weather Forecasts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17502)
*Leonard Göke*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种随机多日调度方法，并将其与确定性方法进行比较，以解决高比例风能和太阳能发电系统中长期储能的调度问题，结果表明随机调度可以减少备用发电并消除负荷损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着电力系统向高比例风能和太阳能转变，长期储能对于平衡不确定的多日供应和需求变得至关重要。然而，目前缺乏针对长期储能的随机多日调度策略，现有研究仅考虑短期或特定时间范围内的不确定性。

Method: 研究人员提出了一种结合扩散模型、半马尔可夫天气模型和气象预报误差增长模型的随机调度方法，并与确定性调度方法在滚动视界设置下进行基准测试。

Result: 在高可再生能源比例下，随机运行可以减少热备用发电并消除负荷损失。当可再生能源比例较低、长期储能容量较小或预报准确度较高时，随机调度的效益会降低。

Conclusion: 拥有高比例可再生能源的电力系统可以从概率性多日预报和随机调度中获益匪浅。

Abstract: As power systems shift toward high shares of wind and solar, long-duration storage becomes pivotal for balancing multi-day deficits and surpluses of uncertain supply and demand. Current dispatch strategies for long-duration storage either assign a fixed value to stored energy or extend the modeled horizon using a single forecast. Stochastic system dispatch with a multi-day horizon for long-duration storage remains unexplored, and existing stochastic dispatch only considers day-ahead uncertainty or Markovian uncertainty beyond one week of perfect foresight. Therefore, we benchmark stochastic multi-day dispatch against deterministic alternatives in a rolling-horizon setup. To emulate probabilistic multi-day forecasts, we combine diffusion with a semi-Markov model of weather regimes and a logistic growth model for meteorological forecast errors. At high renewable shares, stochastic operation reduces thermal backup generation and consistently eliminates loss of load. The benefits decrease with smaller shares of renewables, less long-duration storage, or higher forecast skill. Overall, our results suggest that systems with high shares of variable renewables can substantially benefit from probabilistic multi-day forecasts and stochastic dispatch.

</details>


### [1292] [A Collision-Aware Predictive Rerouting Framework for Connected and Automated Vehicles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17505)
*Tony Kinchen,Ting Bai,Andreas A. Malikopoulos*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种用于网联自动驾驶车辆 (CAVs) 的碰撞感知预测性重路由框架，以减轻城市交通拥堵，并在模拟中显示其提高了运行稳定性，减少了重路由频率，但并未在总旅行时间、距离或排放方面全面优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市交通拥堵是一个普遍问题，特别是在网联自动驾驶车辆 (CAVs) 普及的背景下。需要一种有效的策略来预测和适应性地重新规划 CAV 的路线以缓解拥堵。

Method: 研究人员提出了一种碰撞感知预测性重路由框架，该框架整合了 SUMO 微观模拟、基于 DCRNN 的时空交通状态预测、碰撞窗口前瞻和多目标路线评分。该框架利用预测的拥堵、实时排放信息、路线长度惩罚和事件窗口约束来决定何时让 CAV 偏离当前路线。

Result: 在三个城市网络场景、五个 CAV 渗透水平、三个随机种子和多个基线重路由策略的模拟活动中，所提出的完整框架在聚合旅行时间、距离或排放方面并未全面优于所有基线。然而，其主要优势在于运行稳定性：在保持可比的网络效率的同时，显著降低了相对于主动重路由基线的重路由频率。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，将基于图的预测和碰撞意识嵌入实时 CAV 重路由具有潜力，但也存在权衡。未来的工作应侧重于预测校准、不确定性感知预测以及 CAV 和非 CAV 交通之间的系统级公平性。

Abstract: In this paper, we investigate the problem of mitigating non-recurrent congestion in urban transportation networks through predictive and adaptive routing for connected and automated vehicles (CAVs). We propose a collision-aware predictive rerouting framework that integrates microscopic SUMO simulation, DCRNN-based spatiotemporal traffic-state forecasting, collision-window lookahead, and multi-objective route scoring. The routing controller uses predicted congestion, live emission information, route-length penalties, and incident-window constraints to decide when CAVs deviate from their current routes. The completed simulation campaign across three urban network scenarios, five CAV penetration levels, three random seeds, and multiple benchmark rerouting strategies shows that the proposed full framework does not dominate all baselines in aggregate travel time, distance, or emissions. Instead, its principal advantage is operational stability: it maintains comparable network-level efficiency while substantially reducing rerouting frequency relative to active rerouting baselines. These results demonstrate both the promise and the tradeoffs of embedding graph-based prediction and collision awareness into real-time CAV rerouting, and they motivate further work on forecast calibration, uncertainty-aware prediction, and system-level fairness between CAV and non-CAV traffic.

</details>


### [1293] [Stability Transfer for Autonomous Systems via Higher-Order Taylor-Truncated Lyapunov Certificates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17604)
*Jose D. Hoyos,Zehui Lu,Shaoshuai Mou*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于李雅普诺夫函数有限阶泰勒多项式近似的非线性自治系统局部渐近稳定性分析方法，将原非线性动力学问题转化为计算更易处理的多项式域问题，并可计算吸引域的内近似。该方法结合 SOS 编程和网格搜索，用于寻找多项式李雅普诺夫函数，从而获得较大的认证阈值半径，并提取原非多项式系统的吸引域的内近似。最后，将此框架应用于寻找能够保证给定初始状态属于非多项式闭环系统认证吸引域的低增益 LQR 控制器设计问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的非线性系统稳定性分析（尤其是吸引域的计算）面临计算复杂度的挑战。本文旨在开发一种新的方法，将稳定性分析问题转化为更易于计算的多项式域，从而获得吸引域的显式计算和控制器设计。

Method: 1. 基于有限阶泰勒多项式近似，推导出非线性自治系统局部渐近稳定性的充分条件。 2. 利用和平方 (SOS) 编程和网格搜索，系统地寻找多项式李雅普诺夫函数。 3. 提取认证的不变集作为吸引域的内近似。 4. 将此框架应用于 LQR 控制器设计，以确保给定初始状态属于认证吸引域。

Result: 1. 提出了基于泰勒多项式近似的李雅普诺夫稳定性分析的解析充分条件。 2. 实现了使用 SOS 编程和网格搜索来寻找多项式李雅普诺夫函数和计算吸引域的内近似。 3. 成功应用于具有非线性阻尼的摆和非线性控制系统的实例，并验证了控制器的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的方法能够有效地分析非线性自治系统的局部渐近稳定性和计算吸引域的内近似，并且可以用于设计控制器以满足特定稳定性要求。该方法通过将问题转化为多项式域，克服了传统方法的计算障碍。

Abstract: We develop analytical sufficient conditions for certifying the local asymptotic stability of nonlinear autonomous systems based on Lyapunov functions derived from their finite-order Taylor polynomial approximations. This approach translates the stability analysis problem from the original nonlinear dynamics to a more computationally tractable polynomial domain. The derived conditions allow for the explicit calculation of a guaranteed inner approximation of the region of attraction ($\mathrm{ROA}$). We show how sum-of-squares (SOS) programming and grid search can be used to systematically search for polynomial Lyapunov functions that yield a large certified threshold radius and extract a certified invariant set inner approximation of the $\mathrm{ROA}$ of the nonpolynomial original system. The framework is then applied to a control tuning problem: finding reduced-effort Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) controllers that ensure that a given initial state of interest belongs to the certified $\mathrm{ROA}$ of the nonpolynomial closed loop system. The effectiveness of the overall methodology is demonstrated using a pendulum with nonlinear damping and a nonlinear control system.

</details>


### [1294] [Constrained Grid-Forming Control for Photovoltaic Systems: A Control Barrier Function Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17606)
*Amir Afshari,Dominic Groß*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一种结合控制障碍函数（CBF）的 grid-forming (GFM) 控制方法，用于解决并网光伏（PV）系统中电压源换流器（VSC）和 PV 资源的约束问题，以确保在电网故障、辐照度突变和负载扰动下的安全可靠运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并网光伏系统在电网故障、辐照度变化和负载扰动时，VSC 和 PV 资源的物理和运行限制可能导致系统不稳定，需要一种能够系统性地考虑这些约束的 GFM 控制方法。

Method: 1. 使用 CBF 对 PV 系统的交流和直流端电流电压限制进行编码。2. 将 CBF 应用于双端口 GFM 控制，以限制 VSC 和 PV 在瞬态和稳态下的动态。3. 定义一个成本函数，平衡交流电压相位/频率和电压幅值形成，同时满足约束。4. 使用实时优化，在 CBF 编码的安全集内，对（无约束）双端口 GFM 控制状态进行最小程度的修改。

Result: 所提出的受约束 GFM 控制方法通过 EMT 仿真证明了其在不同扰动下的有效性，确保了 PV 系统的安全可靠运行。

Conclusion: 结合 CBF 的 GFM 控制是一种有效的解决方案，可以处理并网 PV 系统中的 VSC 和 PV 约束，从而在各种电网扰动下实现安全可靠的运行。

Abstract: This paper leverages control barrier functions (CBFs) to systematically account for constraints of voltage source converters (VSCs) and photovoltaic (PV) resources in grid-forming (GFM) control. The proposed control combines (unconstrained) dual-port GFM control with control barrier functions (CBFs) to ensure reliable and safe operation of a GFM PV system under grid faults, sudden changes in irradiance, and load perturbations. First, CBFs are used to encode physical and operational limits of the PV system, namely current and voltage limits at its ac and dc terminals. Then, CBFs are used to restrict the dynamics of dual-port GFM control to within the VSC and PV limits during both transient and steady states. To this end, a cost function is defined that encodes trade-offs between forming the ac voltage phase angle/frequency and voltage magnitude under constraints. Then, real-time optimization is used to make the least modification, as measured by the cost function, to the (unconstrained) dual-port GFM control state to remain within the safe set encoded by the CBFs. Finally, the performance of the developed constrained GFM control is evaluated through EMT simulations in MATLAB/Simulink.

</details>


### [1295] [Service-Aware Hosting Capacity Assessment of Edge Data Centers with Workload Flexibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17645)
*Linhan Fang,Haoxiang Wan,Anurag Srivastava,Xingpeng Li*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一种考虑工作负载调度可转移性的边缘数据中心（DC）接入容量评估模型，以应对边缘计算、内容分发和AI服务的需求增长。研究表明，通过优化工作负载调度，可以显著提高数据中心的接入容量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘计算、内容分发和AI服务需求的增长，使得边缘数据中心需要与配电网络互联。在互联前，电力公司需要评估数据中心容量对电网的影响，而现有的固定峰值负荷模型无法充分考虑服务依赖性、冷却需求和可延迟计算任务，因此需要一种更精细的评估方法。

Method: 开发了一个边缘数据中心的接入容量（HC）评估模型，该模型考虑了三种代表性的边缘数据中心类型（MEC、CDN、AI DC）以及工作负载的调度可转移性。模型通过结合固定基本负荷、服务驱动负荷、冷却开销系数和可转移工作负载来模拟设施负荷。在满足到达因果律、最大延迟、每日能量平衡约束的条件下，优化工作负载执行，并将由此产生的有功和无功负荷纳入配电潮流模型进行计算。

Result: 与不考虑负荷转移的基线模型相比，在IEEE 33节点系统上，对于MEC数据中心，接入容量最大可提高4.46%；对于AI数据中心，最大可提高9.89%。然而，在设定的缓存管理窗口下，CDN数据中心的接入容量增益微乎其微。

Conclusion: 通过引入工作负载调度可转移性，可以有效提升边缘数据中心在配电网络中的接入容量，尤其是在MEC和AI数据中心场景下。CDN数据中心通过此方法获得的增益相对较小，可能与其缓存管理策略有关。

Abstract: The growing demand for edge computing, content delivery, and AI services is driving the interconnection of edge data centers (DCs) with distribution networks. Before interconnection, utilities evaluate how much DC capacity can be accommodated without violating feeder current and voltage limits. Fixed peak load representations can overlook service dependent demand patterns, cooling related facility demand, and delay tolerant computing tasks. This paper develops a hosting capacity (HC) assessment model for edge DCs with shiftable workload scheduling. Three representative types are considered: mobile edge computing (MEC), content delivery network (CDN), and AI DCs. Facility demand is modeled by combining fixed base demand, service driven demand, prescribed cooling-overhead coefficient, and a shiftable workload component. Workload execution is optimized under arrival causality, maximum delay, daily energy balance constraints, and the resulting active and reactive loads are embedded in a distribution power flow model. Compared with the baseline without load shifting, the maximum bus level HC gain on the IEEE 33-bus system reaches 4.46% for MEC DCs and 9.89% for AI DCs, while CDN case shows negligible gain under the assumed cache management windows.

</details>


### [1296] [A Programming, Robotics and Automatic Control Intervention for Secondary Education Students in Sweden and Italy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17793)
*A. S. Yamashita-Fridesjö,C. Hertzberg,M. Morano,G. Fiara,B. Castagna,D. Scaradozzi*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 一项关于AutoSTEM研讨会的评估，该研讨会结合了严肃游戏和PID控制硬件。研究发现，无论是否采用SDT（自我决定理论）引导，参与者的技术自我效能感都有显著提升，但客观知识的提升有限。SDT引导似乎并未带来显著优势，但女性参与者在PID自我效能感上的提升幅度小于男性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估一个结合了严肃游戏和PID控制硬件的名为AutoSTEM的教育干预措施的效果，并比较两种不同的引导方式（SDT知情引导和传统引导）对学习效果的影响。

Method: 在瑞典和意大利进行了七期研讨会。瑞典工作坊采用了SDT知情引导框架，而意大利工作坊则沿用了现有的教育机器人格式。通过自我报告、客观知识测试和定性反馈，并使用多站点调整的统计方法进行分析。

Result: 技术特定的自我效能感在两种条件下都有显著提升（大效应量），而客观知识仅有微弱、不显著的提升。SDT条件与对照条件在主要结果上没有显著差异。对照组的参与度感知更高，但此发现需谨慎解读。对PID的学习提供了定性证据，但也发现了技术和进度上的障碍。女性参与者在PID自我效能感上的提升幅度小于男性。

Conclusion: 这项技术丰富的干预措施能够促进能力发展，无论是否采用SDT知情的引导方式。然而，客观知识的提升有限，并且存在技术和进度方面的挑战。

Abstract: This study evaluates the AutoSTEM workshop, an intervention for secondary education that combines a serious game with PID-controlled hardware. Seven workshops were conducted across Sweden and Italy. The six Swedish workshops adopted an explicitly SDT-informed facilitation framework, while the Italian workshop followed the existing educational robotics format without a formally defined SDT facilitation protocol. Self-reports, an objective knowledge quiz, and qualitative responses were analysed using multiple site-adjusted statistical approaches. Technical-specific self-efficacy increased substantially in both conditions, with large effect sizes, while objective knowledge showed only modest, non-significant gains. No significant site-adjusted differences were found between SDT and control conditions for the primary outcomes. Perceived engagement was higher in the control condition, although this finding should be interpreted cautiously. The objective knowledge composite remained positive but non-significant across sensitivity analyses. Female participants reported smaller PID self-efficacy gains than males. Qualitative findings supported evidence of PID learning while identifying technical and pacing barriers. Overall, the results suggest that the technology-rich intervention supports competence development, regardless of SDT-informed facilitation.

</details>


### [1297] [Safe Unicycle Navigation Among Multiple Obstacles Under Bounded Disturbances: A Learning-Augmented CLF-CBF Approach (Extended Version)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17916)
*Shubham Singh,Anjali Tiwari,Anand Singh,Katsuki Fujisawa*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出了一种鲁棒控制框架，用于在未知时变干扰下，在多个静态障碍物中实现独轮机器人到目标的 안전 导航。该控制器通过一个实时的二次规划（QP）来整合目标达成和障碍物安全，并利用鲁棒控制势垒函数确保安全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机是为了解决在存在未知时变干扰的情况下，独轮机器人在多障碍物环境中安全导航到目标的问题。

Method: 采用一个实时的二次规划（QP）求解器，该求解器结合了目标达成项和每个障碍物的安全项。目标达成项基于机体坐标系下的跟踪误差，而非航向角。安全性通过每个障碍物的鲁棒控制势垒函数来保证，并考虑了状态依赖的干扰界限。引入了松弛变量来处理安全与收敛的冲突。还提出了一个结合了强化学习的变体，用于加速收敛，以及一个学习的虚拟目标，用于处理狭窄的障碍物间隙。

Result: 所提出的QP控制器能够保证在所有允许的干扰下，障碍物的安全集的前向不变性。Lyapunov分析给出了到目标距离的明确最终界限。强化学习变体加速了多约束同时激活时的收敛。计算了障碍物分离的临界值，低于该值将无法通过。学习的虚拟目标可以安全地绕过障碍物。

Conclusion: 该鲁棒控制框架能够有效地实现独轮机器人在未知干扰和多障碍物环境下的安全导航。通过集成先进的控制理论和机器学习方法，提高了系统的鲁棒性和收敛速度，并能处理复杂的导航场景。

Abstract: This paper presents a robust control framework for safe navigation of a unicycle robot to a goal among multiple static obstacles under an unknown, time-varying disturbance. The controller solves a single real-time quadratic program (QP) that combines a goal-reaching term with one safety term per obstacle. The goal-reaching term is a cross-track control Lyapunov function built from body-frame tracking errors rather than a bearing angle, which keeps its Lie derivatives bounded everywhere, including the goal. Safety is encoded using robust control barrier functions, one per obstacle, each tightened by a closed-form, state-dependent disturbance bound. When stabilization and safety conflict, a slack variable relaxes only the convergence requirement, so that the safety constraints remain strictly enforced. Whenever the QP is feasible, the robust barrier constraints guarantee forward invariance of every obstacle's safe set under all admissible disturbances. Complementing this safety guarantee, a Lyapunov analysis yields an explicit ultimate bound on the distance to the goal. A learning-augmented variant replaces the fixed objective with a reinforcement-learning reference, which accelerates convergence when multiple constraints are simultaneously active. We further derive the obstacle separation below which the gap between two obstacles becomes too narrow to pass through under the robust constraints. For such gaps, a learned virtual goal for the Lyapunov function steers the robot around the obstacles without compromising safety. Simulations, a Monte Carlo study, and a comparison against a sampled-data robust baseline support the theoretical results.

</details>


### [1298] [Enforcing a Strict Safety Margin in LLM Text Generation via Barrier Lyapunov Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17929)
*Anand Singh,Shubham Singh,Anjali Tiwari,Katsuki Fujisawa*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种基于障碍李雅普诺夫函数（BLF）的安全滤波器，用于增强大型语言模型（LLM）生成文本时的安全性，确保生成内容与有毒文本的边界保持一定的安全距离，从而克服了现有控制障碍函数（CBF）方法的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于CBF的安全滤波器虽然能使LLM的生成轨迹保持在无毒区域，但无法保证与有毒区域边界的距离，导致生成内容可能非常接近有毒阈值，容易受到模型误差或扰动的影响。研究旨在解决这一限制，提供更强的安全保障。

Method: 提出了一种基于BLF的安全滤波器，该滤波器在保持Transformer模型连续时间动力学（包括前馈层）的同时，强制要求在整个生成过程中与有毒边界保持预设的安全裕度。安全输入集被定义为一个由控制输入决定的半空间约束。研究还推导了显式可计算的、保证安全裕度不会被违反的扰动预算。

Result: 证明了在满足特定条件（如分类器非退化）下，安全输入集非空。对于满足裕度兼容的初始条件，证明了安全裕度不会被违反，并且预设裕度会指数级恢复，从而获得明确的安全裕度底线。当裕度趋近于零时，可容许轨迹满足指数二阶CBF条件。此外，还得到了一个显式的、充分的扰动预算，在此预算下安全裕度保证会逐步下降。仿真结果表明，该BLF安全滤波器提高了安全性。

Conclusion: BLF安全滤波器能够为LLM的文本生成过程提供比CBF方法更强的安全保证，通过维持明确的安全裕度来应对模型误差和扰动，从而显著提高生成文本的安全性。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed without formal guarantees against toxic text generation. Existing control barrier function (CBF) based safety filters can keep the generation trajectory within a toxicity-free region, but do not enforce a positive distance from its boundary, allowing formally safe trajectories to approach the toxicity threshold arbitrarily closely and leaving little buffer against modelling errors or disturbances. We address this limitation with a Barrier Lyapunov Function (BLF) safety filter that enforces a prescribed clearance margin throughout generation while retaining the continuous-time transformer dynamics, including feedforward layers. The resulting safe input set is a half-space defined by a constraint affine in the control input, and is non-empty under certified surjectivity and classifier-nondegeneracy conditions. For margin-compatible initial conditions we prove that the clearance margin is never violated and that the prescribed clearance is restored exponentially, yielding an explicit clearance floor, and show that, as the margin vanishes, the admissible trajectories satisfy the exponential second-order CBF condition. We further derive an explicitly computable sufficient disturbance budget under which the clearance guarantee degrades gracefully. Simulations on a small transformer illustrate the resulting improvement in safety clearance.

</details>


### [1299] [Preliminary Exploration of Large Models Based on Self-Supervised Learning for Health Monitoring of Power Electronic Converters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18138)
*Xinyuan Liao,Xiangtian Deng,Yang Liu,Zhaobing Cai,Haoran Wang,Yi Zhang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为PE-TSFM的时间序列基础模型，用于电力模块健康监测，利用大量未标记的实际运行数据，在降级分类任务中取得了87%的准确率，远超传统模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的AI方法在利用电力电子转换器运行过程中产生的海量未标记数据方面存在局限，而这些数据对提升模型性能具有巨大潜力。

Method: 采用PatchTST架构结合自监督学习，在超过1.43亿个时间戳（其中98%以上是未标记的实际运行数据）上训练PE-TSFM模型。

Result: 在降级分类任务中，PE-TSFM的准确率达到87%，显著优于五种传统时间序列AI模型（准确率在27%至45%之间）。模型表现出强大的少样本学习能力和跨不同运行条件下的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该研究展示了PE-TSFM利用大规模未标记运行数据的能力，推动了电力电子领域从专用模型向统一、可扩展的基础模型转变，以充分挖掘运行数据的价值。

Abstract: Current artificial intelligence (AI) methods for power electronics converters make limited use of the abundant unlabeled data generated during real-world operation. This underexplored resource holds significant potential for advancing model performance. To address this gap, this paper presents PE-TSFM, a time-series foundation model tailored for power module health monitoring. The model adopts the PatchTST architecture combined with self-supervised learning and is trained on more than 143 million timestamps, where over 98\% of this training data is unlabeled and collected directly from an operating traction converter. In degradation classification tasks, PE-TSFM achieves an accuracy of 87\%, considerably surpassing five conventional time-series AI models whose performance ranges from 27\% to 45\%. These results demonstrate the model's strong few-shot learning capability and generalization across different operating conditions. This work promotes a shift from narrowly focused models in power electronics toward unified, scalable foundation models that can unlock value from large-scale unlabeled operational data.

</details>


### [1300] [Generic Local Identifiability Does Not Imply Generic Global Identifiability in Linear Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18228)
*Anders Hansson*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一个反例，证明了具有固定拓扑、独立未知边系数以及选定激励和测量节点的线性网络中，通用局部可辨识性不能推导出通用全局可辨识性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究的动机是探讨线性网络中可辨识性问题的推导关系，特别是局部可辨识性是否能保证全局可辨识性。

Method: 研究通过构造一个六节点、九个未知系数的网络，并引入六个激励和测量节点，证明了即使在参数受限的情况下，仍然存在模糊性。证明使用了有理变换、一个公共的极限矩阵以及有理数证书。

Result: 研究发现，一个具有十二节点、四十二个独立未知系数的网络，存在非空开集参数，对应两个不同的兼容网络，满足任意给定的最大特征值模界限。在某些开区域，只存在一个可接受的解。这在实数和复数系数下都成立。

Conclusion: 该研究结论是，对于具有固定拓扑、独立未知边系数以及选定激励和测量节点的线性网络，从通用局部可辨识性推导出通用全局可辨识性是不成立的。研究还表明，参数的代数延拓和特定条件下的可辨识性是独立的问题。

Abstract: We give a counterexample to the implication from generic local to generic global identifiability for linear networks with a fixed topology, independently unknown edge coefficients, and selected excited and measured nodes. A six-node network with nine unknown coefficients has exactly two compatible parameter vectors generically. Adding six excited and measured nodes preserves this ambiguity while making the added coefficients directly recoverable. The resulting twelve-node structure has forty-two independent unknown coefficients and zero diagonal. For every positive bound on the largest eigenvalue magnitude, a nonempty open set of parameters has two distinct compatible networks satisfying that bound. This holds for both real and complex coefficients. Other open regions have exactly one admissible solution. The proof uses a rational transformation exchanging the two solutions and a common limiting matrix whose fourth power vanishes. Exact rational-number certificates verify an explicit pair. The construction also extends algebraically when the unknown coordinates are whole rational transfer functions. Genericity in prescribed numerator and denominator coefficient families, and the requirement that every transfer function vanish at infinite frequency, remain separate questions.

</details>


### [1301] [Data-Driven Surrogate-Model for Real-Time Loads Prediction in Floating Wind Farms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18264)
*Federico Bellini,Majid Ebrahimi,Alessandro Fontanella,Marcus Becker,Jan-Willem Van Wingerden,Sara Muggiasca,Marco Belloli*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一种数据驱动的负荷代理建模框架，用于海上浮动风力发电场的实时控制，通过结合中等保真度模拟和机器学习，实现了对关键负荷（如塔基弯矩、叶根弯矩等）的实时高精度估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了实现海上浮动风力发电场的实时负荷感知控制，需要能够快速准确地预测风力涡轮机的关键负荷，而传统的详细模拟计算成本过高。

Method: 采用两阶段代理建模方法：第一阶段使用前馈神经网络（FFNN）训练单机模拟数据；第二阶段使用高斯过程回归（GPR）或另一FFNN修正第一阶段模型的残差误差。数据生成过程结合了OpenFAST、FAST.Farm仿真以及MLife疲劳分析，模拟了尾流转向条件下的浮动风力涡轮机负荷。

Result: 该框架能够以低于15%的误差估计塔基弯矩、叶根弯矩、偏航轴承力矩和艉部张力等关键负荷，同时计算时间适合实时应用。研究还揭示了模型在不同环境和控制条件下泛化能力的挑战，尤其是在大型风力发电场中。

Conclusion: 所提出的负荷代理建模方法为实现海上浮动风力发电场的负荷感知实时控制提供了可行方案，展示了其在实际应用中的潜力，但也指出了泛化能力方面的挑战。

Abstract: This work presents a data-driven load-surrogate modelling framework for real-time control of floating offshore wind farms. The proposed methodology uses mid-fidelity simulations performed with OpenFAST and FAST.Farm together with MLife fatigue analysis to generate Damage Equivalent Load (DEL) datasets of floating wind turbines under wake steering conditions. A two-stage surrogate modelling approach is adopted: first, a Feed-Forward Neural Network (FFNN) is trained using data from simulations of a single floating wind turbine, while a second stage corrects the residual error between the FFNN predictions and FAST.Farm simulations using either Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) or an additional FFNN. The results show that the proposed framework can estimate DELs with errors generally below 15% for tower base bending moment, blade root bending moment, yaw bearing moment, and fairlead tension, while maintaining computational times compatible with real-time applications. The study also highlights the challenges related to generalization of the load-surrogate model under varying environmental and control conditions, especially for large floating wind farms. Overall, the proposed methodology demonstrates the potential of surrogate-based DEL estimation for load-aware floating wind farm control applications.

</details>


### [1302] [Fast Analytical Method for Resource Adequacy Assessment in Renewable-Rich Power Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18274)
*Seyed Amir Hosseini,Mohammad Reza Karimi Gharigh,Antonello Monti,Peter Palensky,Saeed Peyghami*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于含高比例可再生能源电力系统资源充分性评估的新型解析方法，利用应力-强度法结合中心极限定理和Gram-Charlier展开来计算LOLE和EENS指数，并在IEEE测试系统上验证了其计算效率和准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了在含高比例可再生能源的电力系统中进行高效且准确的资源充分性评估，特别是在运行规划阶段，需要一种计算速度快的评估方法。

Method: 采用应力-强度方法估计LOLE和EENS指数。假定负荷服从正态分布，发电侧的概率分布由常规、风能和太阳能发电的联合概率分布函数推导。利用中心极限定理（CLT）模拟不确定性的累积影响，并在CLT不足时采用基于累积量的Gram-Charlier展开提高精度。

Result: 所提出的方法在IEEE单区域和多区域RTS-96测试系统上通过蒙特卡洛模拟得到了验证。结果表明，该方法显著缩短了计算时间，同时保持了准确性。随着可再生能源渗透率的提高，其性能得到改善。

Conclusion: 该新型解析方法能够高效且准确地评估资源充分性，特别适用于高比例可再生能源电力系统的运行和规划。

Abstract: This paper proposes a novel analytical method for resource adequacy assessment in renewable rich power systems. The approach begins by applying the stress strength method to estimate two key resource adequacy indices: loss of load expectation (LOLE) and expected energy not supplied (EENS). This method requires defining the probability distribution functions (PDFs) for both the generation side and the load side. The load is assumed to follow a normal probability distribution, while the generation side probability distribution is derived from the combined PDFs of conventional, wind, and solar power sources. The approach models the cumulative impact of uncertainties on resource adequacy using the central limit theorem (CLT), and improves accuracy with a cumulant based Gram Charlier expansion when the CLT alone is insufficient. The effectiveness of the proposed method is validated through Monte Carlo simulations conducted on the IEEE single area and multi-area RTS-96 test systems. The results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a substantial reduction in computational time, which is crucial in the context of operational planning, without sacrificing accuracy. Furthermore, its performance improves as renewable penetration increases, making it particularly suitable for future power systems operation and planning.

</details>


### [1303] [On Over-Conservatism Under Low-Probability Extreme Events: A KL-Regularized Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Planning Method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18290)
*Xinda Shen,Yifan Su,Bo Hu,Yanbo Chen,Changzheng Shao,Tao Wu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种改进的 Wasserstein 距离不确定性集，通过引入 KL 散度正则化来解决传统 Wasserstein DRO 在极端事件下过度保守的问题，并将其应用于可再生能源和储能的规划问题，通过指数锥规划求解，并在 PJM 5 节点和 IEEE 118 节点系统上验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着可再生能源渗透率的提高，电网面临低概率极端事件的风险增加，现有基于 Wasserstein 距离的分布鲁棒优化 (DRO) 方法在处理低概率极端事件时存在过度保守的问题，导致投资决策不经济。

Method: 提出了一种新的不确定性集，通过在 Wasserstein 距离中加入 Kullback-Leibler (KL) 散度正则化项来修改传统的 Wasserstein 不确定性集。基于该新的不确定性集，构建了一个两阶段分布鲁棒规划模型，用于优化光伏、风电和储能的装机容量。最后，将该模型重构为等价的指数锥规划问题，以便于求解。

Result: 数值结果表明，标准 Wasserstein DRO 在低概率极端事件下存在过度保守现象。所提出的规划模型及其求解算法在 PJM 5 节点和 IEEE 118 节点系统上表现出有效性和高效性。

Conclusion: 通过引入 KL 散度正则化，可以有效缓解传统 Wasserstein DRO 在处理低概率极端事件时的过度保守问题，并提出了一种计算上可行的分布鲁棒规划方法，为可再生能源和储能的投资决策提供了更优的解决方案。

Abstract: The increasing penetration of renewable energy makes power systems more vulnerable to low-probability extreme events, elevating system planning to a critical role in ensuring reliability. Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) based on the Wasserstein distance is widely used to address this challenge. However, we find that the conventional Wasserstein ambiguity set tends to excessively amplify the probabilities of low-probability extreme events, leading to over-conservative investment decisions. To mitigate this over-conservatism, this paper proposes a novel ambiguity set that modifies the Wasserstein distance with a Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence regularization term. By leveraging the KL divergence's sensitivity to relative probability changes, the proposed set effectively curbs the unrealistic magnification of low-probability events. A two-stage distributionally robust planning model built upon this new ambiguity set is developed to optimize the installed capacity of photovoltaic, wind, and energy storage. The complex model is then reformulated as an equivalent exponential cone program with strict theoretical proofs, making it computationally tractable. Numerical results on the PJM 5-bus and IEEE 118-bus systems reveal the over-conservatism of standard Wasserstein DRO under low-probability extreme events and validate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed planning model and solution algorithm.

</details>


### [1304] [Infrastructure-Aware Runtime Protection of Co-Deployed AI Services at the Industrial Edge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18313)
*Nitya Sathyavageeswaran,Dibyajyoti Nath,Ziran Min,Pavan Athreya Narasimha Murthy*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种名为运行时关键性评分（RCS）的机制，用于工业边缘系统中的自主AI服务。RCS能够量化服务在资源受限情况下的效用和生存紧迫性，并支持服务之间无需中央控制器即可进行资源分配、迁移和协调角色重新分配的去中心化协商，以应对非崩溃性的服务降级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在现代生产线中，多个AI服务（如扭矩控制、视觉检测、预测性维护）在同一边缘设备上共享CPU和网络资源。当网络饱和时，这些服务不会崩溃，但会产生不准确或过时的输出，导致对工厂状况的误判。论文旨在解决这种“沉默的、部分故障”场景。

Method: 将每个共部署的服务视为一个自主代理。引入运行时关键性评分（RCS），由服务代理计算，反映其在资源约束下的固有效用和生存紧迫性。RCS基于六个维度（物理后果、推理质量、输入新鲜度、近期可用性压力、执行器耦合、可用保护措施）计算，并通过轻量级贝叶斯更新在线调整维度权重，以适应不同类型的干扰（如网络延迟、热节流）。代理通过开放的P2P发现通道发布RCS，并利用RCS进行本地阈值执行、迁移到可接受的对等节点以及协调者角色重新分配的协商。

Result: 所提出的框架能够捕捉AI服务的沉默降级，并通过去中心化、物理约束的代理协调实现跨不同所有者的服务在开放网络上的自主重组、能力公告和资源竞标。

Conclusion: RCS提供了一种用于工业边缘系统服务故障检测和恢复的有效机制，实现了代理间的去中心化协商，增强了系统的鲁棒性和适应性，即使在资源受限和通信受扰的情况下也能保证服务的关键功能。

Abstract: In modern production lines, a single edge device simultaneously runs multiple AI services like a torque-control model, a vision inspector, a predictive maintenance routine. All these services run on the same CPU and same shared network segment. When the shared network segment saturates, the services do not crash. The services just produce outputs that are inaccurate or stale, and no longer reflect the plant's conditions. Our paper targets this class of silent, partial failure scenarios in Industrial Edge Systems.
  We treat each co-deployed service as an autonomous agent. We introduce the Runtime Criticality Score (RCS), which each service agent uses to express at any moment, its intrinsic utility and survival urgency under resource constraints. The score is computed from six normalized dimensions covering physical consequence, inference quality, input freshness, recent availability stress, actuator coupling, and available protective actions on the host. Its dimension weights are adjusted online through a lightweight Bayesian update driven by the type of disturbance currently observed, so the same service is ranked differently under a network delay than under thermal throttling. Agents publish their RCS to peers over an open, peer-to-peer discovery channel, and use it to negotiate three things without a central controller: (i) local threshold enforcement on their own host, (ii) migration to a willing peer when the current host can no longer protect them, (iii) reassignment of the coordination role when the incumbent coordinator is itself impaired. Beyond the immediate benefit of catching silent degradation, the framework contributes a concrete instance of decentralized, physically grounded agent coordination. Agents belonging to different owners can advertise capabilities, bid for protection, and reorganize across an open network.

</details>


### [1305] [Adaptive Handling of Deadline Misses via Stochastic MPC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18361)
*Melanie Gallant,Paolo Pazzaglia,Christoph Mark,Kevin Schmidt,Martina Maggio*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种控制驱动的混合溢出策略，用于在实时控制系统中动态优化处理控制器执行超出截止时间的情况，以提高系统在不同运行条件下的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的实时控制系统处理控制器执行溢出（超出截止时间）的方法是静态的，例如直接丢弃或跳过下一次激活。这种静态策略在系统运行条件变化时可能导致性能下降，因此需要一种能够自适应的策略。

Method: 研究人员将闭环系统建模为马尔可夫跳变线性系统（Markov jump linear system），其中系统模式编码了溢出历史。然后，他们提出了一种基于场景树的随机模型预测控制（stochastic model predictive control）问题，以预测和优化截止时间命中和错过的序列。

Result: 在双积分器和飞机俯仰系统等线性基准测试中，提出的混合溢出策略被评估并证明有效。

Conclusion: 控制驱动的混合溢出策略能够根据运行时条件动态调整截止时间错过的处理方式，从而在实时控制系统中实现最优性能，尤其是在系统运行条件变化的情况下。

Abstract: Real-time control systems may experience sporadic computational overloads that cause controller executions to overrun their expected deadlines, affecting the timely update of control inputs. Such overruns are classically handled with static decisions, e.g., by either stopping and discarding the late execution at the deadline instant, or continuing it while skipping the next activations. This paper first demonstrates that such static policies can lead to suboptimal performance when the controlled system undergoes varying operating conditions, and thus proposes a control-driven hybrid overrun strategy that optimally adapts the deadline miss handling at runtime. We model the closed loop as a Markov jump linear system, whose modes encode overrun histories, and we formulate a scenario-tree-based stochastic model predictive control problem that predicts and optimizes over possible sequences of deadline hits and misses. We evaluate our proposal on linear benchmarks including a double integrator and an aircraft pitch system.

</details>


### [1306] [Computation of Price Signals for Controlling Flexible Prosumers in Distribution Grids Incorporating Stochasticity and Fairness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18383)
*Plouton Grammatikos,Chloé Voirol,Pierre Roduit,Fabrizio Sossan*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种方法，使配电系统运营商 (DSO) 能够为灵活的产消者设计公平的动态定价信号，同时考虑电网约束和产消者行为的不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于局部定价在电网约束激活时可能导致价格不公平，因此需要一种能够解决此问题的定价机制。

Method: 研究采用基于场景的最优潮流 (OPF) 问题来计算与电网约束相关的拉格朗日乘子，并为不同场景下的产消者计算个体化价格信号。然后，提出两种方法将个体化价格聚合为跨产消者的统一公平价格。

Result: 仿真结果表明，该方法能够减少产消者之间的成本差异，同时满足电网约束。研究还评估了公平性对产消者收入和成本变化的影响。

Conclusion: 该研究提出了一种能够同时考虑电网约束、产消者行为不确定性和价格公平性的动态定价方法，为DSO管理配电系统提供了有效工具。
