Abstract: This paper proposes a method for distribution system operators (DSOs) to design spatially fair dynamic price signals for flexible prosumers, accounting for both distribution grid constraints and the stochastic behavior of prosumers. Since locational pricing can introduce price unfairness when grid constraints are active, the proposed approach includes mechanisms to enforce price fairness across the network. The method involves the DSO solving a scenario-based optimal power flow (OPF) problem to derive, similarly to locational marginal prices in transmission systems, the Lagrange multipliers associated with grid constraints and to compute individualized price signals for each prosumer under various PV generation and demand scenarios. Subsequently, two methods are introduced to aggregate these individualized prices into a single fair price across prosumers. Their performance is evaluated through simulations on a model distribution grid, comparing prosumer revenues, grid constraint violations, and analyzing the impact of fairness on reducing cost variance among prosumers.

</details>


### [1307] [Impact of Data Center Load on Co-Optimized Generation and Transmission Expansion Planning with Embedded Unit Commitment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18385)
*Haoxiang Wan,Xingpeng Li,Jonghwan Kwon*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究了大型数据中心负荷对输电网和发电网的联合规划（TEP和GEP）的影响，发现数据中心负荷显著增加了系统成本和LMP，并可能改变最优规划策略，从侧重于输电网扩展转向侧重于发电能力增加，即战略性选址的发电设施可替代部分电网升级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注数据中心负荷的运行灵活性，而忽略了其对长期投资决策（如电网扩展规划）的影响。本文旨在填补这一空白，研究大型数据中心负荷在多节点部署时如何影响输电网和发电网的联合规划。

Method: 将问题建模为一个多年度、包含单元承诺（UC）的混合整数线性规划问题。在修改后的IEEE 24总线可靠性测试系统（RTS-24）上进行仿真，并使用ERCOT的可用可再生能源数据。500 MW的数据中心负荷根据电压等级、发电余量、可再生能源共址和网络连通性分配到四个节点。

Result: 集成数据中心负荷后，15年的系统总成本净现值增加了1,794百万美元（+61.6%），系统平均LMP提高了45.2%。运营成本占总成本的84.2%，资本投资占15.8%。可再生能源弃置量保持很低。新增负荷几乎完全由增量燃煤发电满足。最重要的是，数据中心负荷将最优规划策略从仅侧重于输电网扩展转变为仅侧重于发电能力扩展，用新的400 MW联合循环燃气轮机替代了基准情况下的230 kV输电网加强。

Conclusion: 大型数据中心负荷的引入显著增加了电力系统的成本和LMP。数据中心负荷的位置选择至关重要，战略性选址的发电设施可以替代部分输电网的升级。在规划中考虑数据中心负荷的长期影响对于优化电网投资决策至关重要。

Abstract: The rapid growth of hyperscale data centers challenges grid expansion planning, yet existing studies focus largely on operational flexibility rather than long-term investment decisions. This paper examines how large data center loads sited at multiple buses affect co-optimized Transmission Expansion Planning (TEP) and Generation Expansion Planning (GEP). The problem is formulated as a multi-year, Unit Commitment (UC)-embedded mixed-integer linear program on the modified IEEE 24-bus Reliability Test System (RTS-24) with Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT)-calibrated renewable energy profiles. A 500 MW data center load, about 17.5% of the base-year peak, is allocated across four buses by voltage level, generation headroom, renewable co-location, and network connectivity. Integrating this load raises the 15-year net present value of total system cost by 1,794 million USD (+61.6%) and the system-average locational marginal price (LMP) by 45.2%, with operating cost dominating capital investment (84.2% versus 15.8%). Renewable curtailment remains negligible: existing renewables are already near full utilization, so the added demand is served almost entirely by incremental thermal generation. Most notably, the load shifts the optimal plan from transmission-only to generation-only, replacing the base-case 230 kV reinforcement with a new 400 MW combined-cycle gas turbine and showing that strategically sited generation can substitute for network reinforcement.

</details>


### [1308] [Impact of Security Modeling Fidelity on Hyperscale Data Center Hosting Capacity Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18405)
*Haoxiang Wan,Linhan Fang,Jonghwan Kwon,Jesus Silva-Rodriguez,Jianyi Yang,Jaya Yellajosula,Fan Jiang,Xingpeng Li*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该研究评估了传输电网中超大规模数据中心的托管容量（HC），并量化了单位承诺、备用要求和N-1安全对HC估算的影响。研究发现，在N-SCUC模型下，平均HC为444兆瓦，省略N-1安全会高估19.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超大规模数据中心对电力系统提出了新的挑战，了解其在电网中的托管能力对于规划和可靠运行至关重要。不同的电网运行安全约束（如单位承诺、备用和N-1安全）会影响托管容量的估算，因此需要量化这些因素的影响。

Method: 使用修改后的IEEE 24总线系统，通过四种不同保真度的模型来评估数据中心的托管容量（HC）。模型复杂度递增，分别代表：1) 不考虑单位承诺的DC最优潮流（DC-OPF）；2) 不考虑可靠性约束的基本安全约束单位承诺（SCUC）；3) 考虑旋转备用的SCUC；4) 同时考虑备用和N-1安全约束的N-SCUC。HC被定义为在24小时高峰日内，单个目标节点上可容纳的最大时不变有功功率需求。

Result: 在N-SCUC模型下，平均HC为444兆瓦。省略N-1安全约束后，HC估算值升至532兆瓦，高估了19.8%。DC-OPF和基本的SCUC模型进一步高估了HC。

Conclusion: 模型复杂度和估算准确性之间存在权衡。在评估超大规模数据中心的托管容量时，必须考虑单位承诺、备用要求和N-1安全等实际运行安全约束，否则会显著高估托管容量。

Abstract: This paper assesses hyperscale data center hosting capacity in transmission grids. Hosting capacity (HC) analysis quantifies the maximum additional load a bus can accommodate without violating operational constraints. This paper defines data center HC as the maximum time-invariant active power demand at a single target bus over a 24-hour peak-day horizon, and evaluates it under four models of increasing fidelity (i.e., the extent to which the model enforces real-world operational security requirements) on the modified IEEE 24-bus system: (i) DC optimal power flow (DC-OPF) without unit commitment (UC), (ii) basic SCUC (security-constrained unit commitment) without reliability constraints, (iii) SCUC with spinning reserve, and (iv) N-SCUC with both reserve and branch-contingency security. Comparing these models quantifies the impact of unit commitment, reserve requirements, and N-1 security on bus-level HC estimates. The N-SCUC yields an average HC of 444 MW; omitting N-1 security raises this to 532 MW, a 19.8% overestimation. The DC-OPF and basic SCUC models further overestimate HC, indicating a trade-off between model complexity and estimation accuracy.

</details>


### [1309] [Evidence-Governed Deployment Readiness for Networked Agents on Industrial OT Infrastructure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18426)
*Dibyajyoti Nath,Nitya Sathyavageeswaran,Ziran Min,Pavan Athreya Narasimha Murthy*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于证据治理的框架，用于解决在工业 OT 网络中部署工作负载时遇到的跨层先决条件复杂性和多团队协作问题。该框架通过单一的、版本化的网络意图制品来描述工作负载的要求，并在部署前通过覆盖驱动的测试循环验证证据。它能够区分未经验证的要求和实际故障，提供修复建议，并监控运行时偏差，以确保持续的治理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前部署工作负载到工业 OT 网络时，存在多个跨层先决条件（如持久寻址、名称解析、时间同步、证书信任等）需要同时满足，并且这些要求由不同团队负责。现有的工具将部署前检查、故障归因、修复和持续合规视为独立问题，导致证据无法复用，这种碎片化在共享基础设施上部署自适应代理时成为治理难题。所有阶段都面临一个共同问题：工作负载的要求在给定网络上是否满足。

Method: 提出了一个证据治理框架，通过一个单一的、版本化的网络意图制品（Network-Intent Artifact）来定义工作负载特定发布版本的跨层要求。在部署前，通过覆盖驱动的测试循环（Coverage-driven Test Loop）将测试证据附加到每个要求上。在现场， readiness 报告为 ready, not ready, 或 undecidable，区分了未测试的要求和真正的失败。修复步骤（Repair Step）提出在保留共址工作负载的情况下进行修复。漂移监控组件（Drift-watch Component）在发生变化时重新评估现场，以延长工作负载生命周期的保障。通过一个多工作负载 OPC UA 调试案例来说明所有四个阶段。

Result: 该框架能够区分未经验证的要求和实际故障，提供修复建议，并通过漂移监控组件在运行时检测到偏差时暂停代理的保证，直到注册了刷新后的制品。这为在共享工业基础设施上适应性代理集合提供了可审计的治理。

Conclusion: 该证据治理框架能够整合部署流程的各个阶段，通过一个版本化的网络意图制品作为单一参考，并附带可验证的证据，从而解决了工业 OT 网络部署中的碎片化问题，并为共享基础设施上的自适应代理集合提供了持续的可审计治理。

Abstract: Deploying a workload on a cyber-secure industrial operational-technology (OT) network requires many cross-layer prerequisites to hold at once, including persistent addressing, name resolution, time synchronization, certificate trust, proxy traversal, and reachable industrial-protocol endpoints. These are owned by different teams, yet current tools treat pre-deployment checking, fault attribution, remediation, and ongoing compliance as separate problems, so evidence is rarely reused across stages. As edge platforms come to host self-adapting agents on shared infrastructure, this fragmentation becomes a governance problem. All four stages ask one question: do a workload's requirements hold on a given network?
  We present an evidence-governed framework that answers it through a single reference, a versioned network-intent artifact specifying a workload's cross-layer requirements for a specific release. A coverage-driven test loop attaches tested evidence to each requirement before deployment. At a site, readiness is reported as ready, not ready, or undecidable, separating untested requirements from genuine failures; a repair step proposes fixes that preserve co-located workloads; and a drift-watch component re-evaluates the site on change, extending assurance across the workload's lifetime. A multi-workload OPC UA commissioning case illustrates all four stages. By detecting runtime deviations and suspending an agent's guarantees until a refreshed artifact is registered, the framework grounds auditable governance for adapting agent collectives on shared industrial infrastructure.

</details>


### [1310] [Shadow Pricing in Transient Stability-Constrained Optimal Power Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18563)
*Alex Coelho,Araceli Hernandez,Luis Badesa*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种考虑暂态稳定性的经济调度方法，并推导了与资产相关的影子价格，以解决现有方法在市场结算方面的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法未能充分表征暂态稳定性约束对电网经济调度、价格信号和市场结算的影响，特别是未能导出单个资产（如发电机和负荷）的影子价格。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 通过直接离散化嵌入系统动力学微分代数方程，从考虑暂态稳定性的最优潮流问题中推导出影子价格。影子价格分解为节点能量分量和稳定性分量，后者由动态方程的对偶变量构成。

Result: 所提出的影子价格能够实现资产特定的定价，即共址发电机和负荷可能具有相同的节点能量分量，但由于暂态行为不同而具有不同的稳定性分量。案例研究表明，基于所提出的影子价格进行结算，可以在没有额外支付的情况下将稳定性约束的成本分配给资产。减少稳定性裕度的资产将被收费，而提高稳定性裕度的资产将获得报酬，并且没有发电机亏损。

Conclusion: 本文提出的考虑暂态稳定性的资产特定影子价格能够有效地将稳定性约束的成本分配给相关资产，并实现无损耗的市场结算。

Abstract: Transient stability constraints alter the economic dispatch of power systems, while the resulting price signals and their implications for market settlement remain insufficiently characterized. Existing approaches identify stability-related components in locational marginal prices, without deriving shadow prices for individual assets, such as generators and loads, or analyzing the resulting settlement. To address this gap, this paper derives shadow prices from a transient stability-constrained optimal power flow in which the differential-algebraic equations governing the system dynamics are embedded through direct discretization. Each shadow price decomposes into a nodal energy component and a stability component, the latter formed by the dual variables of the dynamic equations in which the power of the asset appears. Shadow prices are therefore asset-specific: co-located generators and loads are assigned the same nodal energy component, but can be subject to different stability components when their transient behaviors differ. Case studies on the WECC 9-bus system and a modified IEEE 39-bus system show that settlement at the proposed shadow prices allocates the cost of the stability constraints among the assets without any side payment. An asset that reduces the stability margin is charged its stability component, whereas an asset that improves it is paid, and no generator is dispatched at a loss.

</details>


### [1311] [Rethinking electrified transportation: The case for dynamic wireless charging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18708)
*Dipanjan Ghose,Junjie Qin,S. Sivaranjani*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种联合投资评估框架，用于评估美国州际货运网络中电动汽车动态无线充电（DWC）和固定式充电站（SCS）的投资。研究发现，更高的利用率和更长的项目寿命会显著增加对DWC的投资，并且DWC能够比SCS提供更高的充电容量，同时需要更少的电网基础设施投资。结合DWC和SCS的投资组合可以最大化长期价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期基础设施投资需要在成熟技术（固定式充电站）和资本密集型新兴技术（动态无线充电）之间进行权衡。对于电动汽车充电，了解何时何地部署DWC至关重要，以避免技术锁定或资本浪费。

Method: 该研究使用了一个耦合DWC、SCS和配套电网基础设施的联合投资评估框架，覆盖了美国近49,000英里的州际货运网络。

Result: 研究发现，更高的利用率和更长的项目寿命会使DWC的投资份额迅速增加。DWC路段可以共享电网连接，提供比SCS高六倍的额定充电容量，但电网基础设施投资减少46%。结合DWC和SCS的投资组合比仅SCS的投资组合具有更高的价值。

Conclusion: 该研究确定了塑造SCS和DWC各自优势的具体交通需求、建设和电网接入条件，为电动汽车充电基础设施的长期投资和政策制定提供了可操作的部署阈值。

Abstract: Long-term infrastructure investment often requires choosing between an established technology and a capital-intensive alternative that gains value as demand matures. For electric vehicle (EV) charging, this trade-off is between incumbent stationary charging technology and emerging dynamic wireless charging (DWC). DWC could fundamentally alter transportation electrification by enabling high-throughput charging in motion and reducing reliance on large onboard batteries; however, its high upfront cost makes the timing and location of deployment critical. Overcommitting to stationary charging stations (SCS) risks technological lock-in and forgoing the benefits of DWC, whereas premature DWC deployment can strand capital in underutilized corridors. Through a joint investment assessment framework coupling DWC, SCS, and supporting grid infrastructure across nearly 49,000 miles of the US Interstate freight network, we find that higher utilization and longer project lifetimes rapidly shift investment toward DWC, whose share rises sharply from 48% at a project lifetime of 30 years to 100% at 32 years. Contiguous DWC segments can share grid connections, enabling them to provide over six times the rated charging capacity of SCS while requiring 46% less investment in new distribution-grid infrastructure. We also find that a combined DWC and SCS portfolio reaches a maximum lifetime value of USD 60 billion, 63% above the case with only SCS. We further identify specific traffic demand, construction, and grid access conditions that shape where each technology becomes advantageous, yielding actionable thresholds for SCS and DWC deployment that directly inform long-term EV charging infrastructure investment and policy.

</details>


<div id='eess.IV'></div>

# eess.IV [[Back]](#toc)

### [1312] [Temporal Diffusion Bridge Model for Vessel Extraction Using Physics-informed Synthetic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14105)
*Jinkui Hao,Donald R. Cantrell,Ramez Abdalla,Sameer A. Ansari,Bo Zhou*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为TDBM的时间扩散桥模型，用于从X射线冠状动脉造影（XCA）中提取血管，无需手动标注，并能保留重要的血管内对比度信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有XCA血管提取方法面临血管可见性低、运动伪影、手动标注不足等挑战，且大多数深度学习方法仅生成二值化血管掩码，丢失了临床相关的血管内对比度信息。

Method: 提出基于物理的XCA合成引擎生成带对比度和无对比度的图像对，用于训练TDBM。TDBM将血管提取视为图像翻译任务，利用时间信息和血管感知对比损失来提高血管分割的准确性和一致性。

Result: TDBM在两个XCA血管分割数据集上表现优于现有方法，并在真实患者XCA序列数据集的读者研究中获得积极反馈。此外，TDBM在视网膜成像和荧光显微镜等其他成像模态上也展现出良好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: TDBM是一种有效的XCA血管提取方法，无需手动标注即可生成高质量的血管分割，并保留了有价值的对比度信息，且具有跨模态泛化能力。

Abstract: Accurate artery extraction from X-ray coronary angiography (XCA) is essential for coronary artery disease diagnosis and intervention. However, low vessel visibility, respiratory and cardiac motion, and limited annotations challenge existing methods. Moreover, most deep learning approaches produce binary vessel masks without preserving clinically relevant intra-arterial contrast information. We propose a Temporal Diffusion Bridge Model (TDBM) that formulates vessel extraction as image translation and learns from physics-informed synthetic data without manual vessel annotations. A physics-based XCA synthesis engine generates diverse, perfectly aligned pairs of contrast-enhanced and contrast-free images. Using these pairs, TDBM learns cross-domain mappings to recover high-fidelity vessel information. Temporal conditioning incorporates adjacent frames to improve consistency, while a vessel-aware contrastive loss exploits background-invariant synthetic pairs to enhance vascular discrimination. We evaluate TDBM on two XCA vessel segmentation datasets and conduct a reader study using two real-patient XCA sequence datasets. Zero-shot segmentation is further assessed on retinal imaging and fluorescence microscopy datasets. Results demonstrate that TDBM consistently outperforms existing methods and generalizes effectively across imaging modalities. Code and trained weights will be available at: https://github.com/Advanced-AI-in-Medicine-and-Physics-Lab/TDBM

</details>


### [1313] [Exploring the Latent Structure of AMD Severity Using Retinal Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14138)
*Niccolò Fineschi,Jovana Panic,Atsushi Watanabe,Hideaki Hayashi,Kazuya Nishimura,Yuki Maeno,Samanta Rosati,Gabriella Balestra,Kohji Nishida,Hajime Nagahara*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该研究使用年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）作为案例，分析了视网膜基础模型（RET-CLIP）如何在其学习到的嵌入空间中表示疾病严重程度，并评估了这种表示方式对下游任务性能的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 了解疾病相关信息在视网膜基础模型学习到的嵌入中的表示方式，以及这种表示方式如何影响下游预测性能。

Method: 利用AREDS数据集的双侧眼底图像，采用RET-CLIP模型（与非视网膜编码器进行基准测试），首先表征AMD严重程度在学习到的表示空间中的分布，然后评估这种结构如何影响三个不同粒度的临床相关任务的分类性能，最后结合特征归因、统计表型关联和定性图像分析来解析最具影响力的潜在维度。

Result: RET-CLIP将AMD严重程度表示为一个连续的光谱，而非离散的类别，健康和晚期疾病阶段的分离比中间阶段更清晰。这种组织结构影响了下游任务的性能，从二分类AMD和晚期AMD检测的0.844和0.814的平衡准确率下降到六分类分级的0.446。最具影响力的潜在维度在统计上与不同的视网膜表型相关，包括玻璃疣积累、色素改变和晚期视网膜病变。

Conclusion: 视网膜基础模型表示空间的结构会影响临床相关预测任务的难度，并且通过表示层面的分析可以更好地理解疾病的组织方式和提高模型的可解释性。

Abstract: Retinal foundation models have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of ophthalmic tasks, yet relatively little is known about how disease-related information is represented within their learned embeddings and whether this distribution influences downstream prediction performance. In this work, we use Age-related Macular Degeneration (AMD) as a case study to investigate how disease severity is represented within the embedding space of RET-CLIP, a retinal vision-language foundation model, using bilateral fundus images from the AREDS dataset, benchmarked against non-retinal encoders. We first characterize the distribution of AMD severity within the learned representation space and then evaluate how this structure influences classification performance across three clinically relevant task formulations of increasing granularity. Finally, we analyze the most influential latent dimensions combining feature attribution, statistical phenotype association, and qualitative image analyses. Our results show that RET-CLIP represents AMD severity as a continuous spectrum rather than a set of discrete categories, with healthy and advanced disease stages exhibiting clearer separation than intermediate ones. This organization was reflected in downstream performance, which decreased from a balanced accuracy of 0.844 and 0.814 for binary AMD and Late-AMD detection respectively to 0.446 for six-class grading. Furthermore, the most influential latent dimensions were statistically associated to distinct retinal phenotypes, including drusen accumulation, pigmentary alterations, and advanced retinal lesions. These findings suggest that the structure of retinal foundation-model representations influences the difficulty of clinically relevant prediction tasks and demonstrate the potential of representation-level analysis for understanding disease organization and improving interpretability.

</details>


### [1314] [Frozen Site-Probe Accuracy Is Not a Standalone Harmonization Score: An Audit of Evaluation Practice for Multi-Site MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14140)
*Muhammad Muqsit Islam,Gloria García Cuenco,José M. Martínez,Pierrick Coupé*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 研究发现，当前评估MRI图像协调性（harmonization）的方法存在缺陷。依赖于“冻结探针”（frozen probe）的准确度下降来判断协调是否成功，这种方法不可靠，因为探针的训练方式和对预处理的敏感性都会影响结果，低准确度不一定代表站点信息已被移除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前评估MRI图像协调性（harmonization）的方法——使用冻结的站点分类器（frozen site probe）——的有效性受到质疑，需要对其进行审计和改进。

Method: 在ABIDE I数据集上，使用十种不同的协调方法和对照组，训练和评估了多种站点分类器（探针）。研究了探针的训练方式（在原始数据还是协调数据上训练）、随机种子、高斯模糊、头部形状、强度、预处理和目标对齐等因素对探针准确度的影响。

Result: 冻结探针的准确度对训练方式非常敏感，即使在同一组协调输出数据上，准确度也可能从0.13到0.59不等。增加高斯模糊（增加强度距离）会降低冻结探针的准确度至接近随机水平。即使冻结探针表现不佳，在协调后的数据上训练的新探针（包括仅使用强度直方图的探针）仍能有效地识别站点信息。

Conclusion: 冻结探针的低准确度并不能证明站点信息已被有效移除。建议在评估MRI图像协调性时，报告多个在不同条件下训练的探针（包括在协调后数据上训练的探针），并报告目标对齐情况，以更全面地评估协调效果。

Abstract: Image-level MRI harmonization is often evaluated with a frozen site probe, a site classifier trained on raw scans and applied unchanged to harmonized ones: a drop in its accuracy is read as removal of site effects. We audit this practice on ABIDE I (1,112 T1-weighted scans, 17 sites) with ten output sets from seven harmonization methods and controls for chance, head shape, intensity, preprocessing and target alignment. We find that this verdict depends on how the probe is trained, even among probes that classify raw scans well: across random seeds, its balanced accuracy on the same CycleGAN outputs ranges from 0.13 to 0.59 (chance: 0.06). Low frozen-probe accuracy can also arise without harmonization: a Gaussian blur, which increases the intensity distance to the target site, lowers this accuracy to chance. Moreover, where the frozen probe fails, probes trained on the harmonized scans still recover the site, even from intensity histograms alone: on HACA3 outputs, the frozen probe scores 0.25, a probe trained on those outputs 0.75, and one using only their intensity histograms 0.71. Low frozen-probe accuracy therefore does not show that site information has been removed. We recommend reporting several probes trained to convergence, probes trained on harmonized scans, and target alignment.

</details>


### [1315] [RePrior: Measurement-Reconciled Prior Correction for Sparse-View CBCT Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14102)
*Mengrui Yin,Tianxingjian Ding,Wufan Zhao,Ziyang Yan,Yu Tian*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为RePrior的多阶段先验校正框架，用于解决稀疏视角锥束CT（CBCT）重建中的两个关键挑战：先验与当前重建的不匹配以及校正与X射线测量的冲突。RePrior通过选择性校正建议（SCP）、测量约束协调（MCR）和混合残差增强（HRE）三个阶段，实现了可操作的、与测量一致的、并具有更强表示能力的先验校正，在不依赖测试时真值或网络微调的情况下，显著提升了重建质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏视角CBCT重建由于X射线投影数量不足而受到严重约束。现有的学习重建方法可以提供解剖学信息，但将其作为患者个体化高斯重建的先验时，存在先验-重建不匹配的空间非均匀性以及校正与X射线测量值冲突的问题。

Method: 提出RePrior框架，包含三个阶段：1. 选择性校正建议（SCP）识别先验-重建差异中有用且可操作的局部校正；2. 测量约束协调（MCR）强制校正与患者个体化的X射线测量值保持一致；3. 混合残差增强（HRE）通过互补的体素域和高斯域自由度来恢复额外的校正能力。

Result: RePrior在LUNA16、PANORAMA和PENGWIN数据集上，相比R²-Gaussian在3D PSNR上平均提高了约2.6 dB。此外，它在体积质量、观测视角投影保真度以及保持未见视角保真度方面均取得了显著提升。

Conclusion: RePrior是一种有效的多阶段先验校正框架，能够解决稀疏视角CBCT重建中的先验不匹配和测量冲突问题，无需测试时真值或网络微调，显著提高了重建质量和投影保真度。

Abstract: Sparse-view cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) is severely under-constrained by limited X-ray projections. Learned reconstruction can provide complementary anatomical information, but using it as a prior in patient-specific Gaussian reconstruction introduces two challenges. First, the discrepancy between the learned prior and current reconstruction is spatially non-uniform: some local differences contain useful missing 3D information, whereas others reflect prior bias. Second, even a volumetrically beneficial correction can conflict with the observed X-ray measurements. Since X-ray measurements are line integrals, spatially separated corrections may affect overlapping rays, with their signed projection responses reinforcing or partially canceling in the measurement residual, so their feasibility cannot always be assessed independently. In this paper, we introduce RePrior, a multi-stage progressive prior-correction framework that addresses correction actionability, measurement feasibility, and representation expressivity. Selective Correction Proposal (SCP) first identifies actionable signed local corrections from prior--reconstruction discrepancies. Measurement-Constrained Reconciliation (MCR) then jointly enforces their consistency with patient-specific X-ray measurements, while Hybrid Residual Enhancement (HRE) recovers additional correction capacity through complementary voxel- and Gaussian-domain degrees of freedom around the reconciled anchor. RePrior requires neither test-time ground truth nor case-specific network fine-tuning. RePrior gains approximately 2.6~dB in 3D PSNR over R$^2$-Gaussian across LUNA16, PANORAMA, and PENGWIN. Beyond prior-assisted reconstruction, it delivers additional gains in volumetric quality and observed-view projection fidelity, with consistent gains in held-out-view fidelity in the backbone-matched evaluation.

</details>


### [1316] [Learning Perceptual Rules in a Fragmented Visual World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13988)
*Tianqin Li,Isaac Lin,Leiran Song,Tai Sing Lee*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本研究使用掩码自编码器（MAEs）探索了视觉预测在形成组织性视觉先验方面的作用，发现通过学习预测缺失的视觉信息可以涌现出类似于完好持续、对称性和整体形状等经典格式塔原则的感知组织。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机在于探究视觉感知组织中的结构性先验的起源，特别是学习预测缺失视觉信息是否能产生类似格式塔原则的组织。

Method: 使用掩码自编码器（MAEs）在自然图像上进行训练，通过分析其对缺失区域的重建能力来评估感知组织。研究还通过将MAEs适应于自然图像或破坏了全局空间组织的texforms来操纵视觉经验，并观察这如何影响其预测行为。

Result: MAEs在自然图像上训练后，展现出与完好持续、对称性和整体形状相符的感知补全能力。当改变远处元素时，缺失区域的重建会受到影响，表明局部预测受全局组织约束。改变视觉经验会削弱全局支持的补全，并在局部和全局约束冲突时，使感知推理更倾向于局部持续。

Conclusion: 视觉组织的原则可能源于通过视觉预测学习到的自然场景的结构规律。这些预测整合了多尺度空间的结构先验，并且局部与全局组织的平衡会根据视觉经验的统计结构进行调整。经典格式塔原则可能作为从视觉世界统计结构中学习到的适应性感知先验而出现。

Abstract: Visual perception organizes incomplete sensory evidence into coherent structures, but where do the principles governing this organization come from? We investigate whether learning to predict missing visual information can give rise to structural priors resembling classical Gestalt principles. Masked autoencoders (MAEs) trained on natural images exhibit perceptual completion consistent with good continuation, symmetry, and global form. Critically, when local evidence surrounding a missing region is held constant, manipulating distant elements systematically changes its reconstruction, demonstrating that local predictions are constrained by the global organization of the visual input. We next manipulate visual experience by adapting MAEs to either natural images or texforms that preserve local image statistics while disrupting global spatial organization. This altered experience weakens globally supported completion and shifts perceptual inference toward local continuation when local and global constraints conflict. Together, these results suggest that perceptual organization reflects structural regularities of natural scenes acquired through visual prediction: predictions integrate structural priors across multiple spatial scales, and the balance between local and global organization adapts to the statistical structure of visual experience. More broadly, our findings suggest that classical Gestalt principles may emerge as adaptive perceptual priors learned from the statistical structure of the visual world.

</details>


### [1317] [C$^2$LUE: Clinically Aligned Patient-Level Ultrasound Diagnosis via Evidence-Aware Multi-Instance Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14143)
*Qin-Yi Zhang,Linying Cao,De-Xing Huang,Haichuan Lin,Yi Yang,Manzhi Wang,Xiao-Hu Zhou,Chen Chen,Shuangyi Wang,Zeng-Guang Hou*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为 C$^2$LUE 的新型多实例学习框架，用于超声诊断，该框架通过证据感知聚合和风险对齐正则化来提高准确性并平衡诊断风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多实例学习方法在处理超声诊断中异质的诊断线索时，聚合器常会稀释信息并仅优化全局准确性，导致敏感性和特异性之间的不良权衡，而临床上需要对不对称的诊断风险进行缓解。

Method: C$^2$LUE 框架结合了多查询交叉注意力机制（基于 LoRA 适应的 DINOv3 主干）以提取和分离不同的形态模式，从而保留证据的异质性并防止注意力坍塌。同时，引入动态权衡正则化目标，在训练过程中惩罚敏感性-特异性失衡，以实现更平衡的误差分布。

Result: 在患者级别的甲状腺和乳腺超声数据集（经活检证实的）上进行的大量评估表明，C$^2$LUE 的性能始终优于现有方法。

Conclusion: C$^2$LUE 成功地结合了强大的鉴别能力和平衡的误差分布，为实际的超声筛查和诊断提供了一个有前景的解决方案，能有效应对临床风险对齐的需求。

Abstract: Patient-level ultrasound diagnosis demands not only high predictive accuracy but also clinically aligned mitigation of asymmetric diagnostic risks. While Multi-Instance Learning (MIL) effectively models routine multi-view exams, standard aggregators often dilute heterogeneous diagnostic cues and optimize solely for global accuracy. This frequently yields undesirable sensitivity-specificity trade-offs. To bridge this gap, we propose C$^2$LUE, a novel MIL framework coupling evidence aware aggregation with risk-aligned regularization. To preserve evidence heterogeneity and prevent unimodal attention collapse, C$^2$LUE employs a multi-query cross-attention mechanism built upon a LoRA-adapted DINOv3 backbone. Multiple latent queries explicitly extract and disentangle diverse morphological patterns from the ultrasound sequence. Furthermore, to improve clinical risk alignment, we introduce a dynamic trade-off regularization objective that penalizes sensitivity-specificity imbalance during training. Rather than leaving the clinical trade-off entirely to post-hoc threshold adjustment, this objective encourages the learned score distribution toward a more balanced operating region. Extensive evaluations on patient-level, biopsy-proven thyroid and breast ultrasound datasets demonstrate that C$^2$LUE consistently outperforms prior alternatives. By uniting strong discrimination with a balanced error profile, C$^2$LUE provides a promising solution for real-world ultrasound screening and diagnosis.

</details>


### [1318] [Beyond Discrimination: Evaluating Probability Calibration in Radiomics-Image Fusion for Renal Cell Carcinoma Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14151)
*Yuan Liang,Morgan May,Abraham Campbell,Sourav Bhattacharjee,Simon Caton,Pierpaolo Dondio*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 研究发现，在肾细胞癌（RCC）的影像融合模型中加入影像组学（radiomics）可以同时提高鉴别能力和概率预测质量，包括校准度。特别地，一种概率平均集成模型在所有评估的架构中表现出优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床上需要机器学习分类器提供可靠的概率估计，但目前肾细胞癌（RCC）的影像融合模型主要关注鉴别能力，对概率性能的评估不足。

Method: 研究者使用了396名患者的KiTS23数据集，评估了在四种影像模型家族中加入影像组学是否能提升概率性能。他们评估了17个单独的模型和4个概率平均集成模型，使用了鉴别能力、概率校准和评分指标。

Result: 与仅使用影像的模型相比，12种匹配的影像-融合对比中，AUC和AP在所有对比中均有提升；Brier score和NLL在11种对比中提升；ECE在8种对比中提升。3D MedVAE门控融合模型展现出最强的个体模型性能。概率平均集成模型在鉴别能力和概率预测质量上均优于仅使用影像的模型。

Conclusion: 影像组学-影像融合可以提升概率预测的质量，并且其校准性能会因影像架构和融合策略的不同而异。研究提出的概率平均集成模型能够在所有架构中同时改善鉴别能力和校准度。

Abstract: Reliable probability estimates are important for the clinical interpretation of machine-learning classifiers, yet radiomics--image fusion models for renal cell carcinoma (RCC) are commonly evaluated primarily by discrimination. Using 396 patients from the KiTS23 dataset, we evaluated whether adding radiomics to four image-model families improved probabilistic performance in addition to discrimination. Seventeen individual models and four probability-average ensembles were assessed using discrimination, probability calibration, and proper scoring measures. Across 12 matched image-only versus fusion comparisons, AUC and AP improved in all 12, while Brier score and negative log likelihood (NLL) improved in 11 of 12 and expected calibration error (ECE) in eight of 12. The 3D MedVAE gated-fusion model achieved the strongest overall individual-model profile. Probability averaging across concatenation, cross-attention, and gated fusion produced favourable point estimates across all five primary metrics relative to image-only models in all four families, although paired-bootstrap support was stronger for Brier score and NLL than for ECE. These findings show that radiomics--image fusion can improve probabilistic prediction quality beyond discrimination, while calibration behaviour varies across image architectures and fusion strategies. We show that our proposed probability-average ensemble models improve discrimination and calibration simultaneously across all architectures in the study.

</details>


### [1319] [Beyond Gate Weights: Decision-Level Interpretation of Radiomics-Image Feature Fusion for RCC Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14152)
*Yuan Liang,Sourav Bhattacharjee,Abraham Campbell*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 研究表明，在3D MedVAE-radiomics模型中，用于区分肾细胞癌亚型的门控系数（structural radiomics weighting）与实际影响分类决策的影像特征贡献度（effective radiomics dominance）存在显著差异，后者远低于前者，并且影像特征项比直接影像组学特征项包含更多区分性信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究人员希望深入理解在具有门控机制的深度学习模型中，门控系数（描述中间特征的权重）与最终分类输出中的分支实际贡献度之间的区别。

Method: 研究人员采用了一个固定的3D MedVAE-radiomics模型，用于对比增强CT图像中透明细胞癌与非透明细胞癌的分类。由于模型采用线性分类头，可以将二分类决策的logit分解为门控影像项、直接影像组学项和偏置项。研究定义了“有效影像组学主导性”为直接影像组学项在非偏置分支贡献总和中的比例，并将其与结构影像组学权重进行比较。此外，还使用了分支定向排列、集成梯度和Shapley风格分析来识别影响直接影像组学项的影像组学描述符。

Result: 在内部评估中，平均结构影像组学权重为0.823，而平均有效影像组学主导性仅为0.148，两者之间存在中等程度的关联（ρ = 0.290）。门控影像项比直接影像组学项保留了更强的判别排序信息。在探索性外部评估中也观察到类似的结构到有效权重差异。分支定向排列、集成梯度和Shapley风格分析进一步识别了影响直接影像组学项的影像组学描述符。由于影像组学也生成门控信息，门控影像项仍然依赖于影像组学，因此不应将相加的分支贡献解释为总输入影响。

Conclusion: 研究结论是，结构门控权重和决策层面的分支贡献是门控特征融合中不同的方面，应该分开解释。结构门控权重并不直接反映最终决策中各分支的实际贡献大小。

Abstract: Gate coefficients describe how a fusion layer weights intermediate features, but they do not necessarily reflect the magnitude of branch contributions at the classifier output. We investigate this distinction in a fixed 3D MedVAE--radiomics model for clear cell versus non-clear cell renal cell carcinoma classification from contrast-enhanced CT. Because the model uses a linear classification head, the binary decision logit can be decomposed exactly into a gated image term, a direct radiomics term, and a bias. We define effective radiomics dominance as the direct radiomics term's share of the summed absolute non-bias branch contributions and compare it with structural radiomics weighting. Internally, mean structural radiomics weighting was 0.823, whereas mean effective radiomics dominance was 0.148, with a modest case-wise association (\r{ho} = 0.290). The gated image term retained substantially stronger discriminative ranking information than the direct radiomics term. The same structural-to-effective discrepancy was observed in exploratory external evaluation. Branch-targeted permutation, integrated-gradient, and Shapley-style analyses further identified radiomics descriptors influencing the direct radiomics term. Because radiomics also generates the gate, the gated image term remains radiomics-dependent, so additive branch contribution should not be interpreted as total input influence. These findings show that structural gate weighting and decision-level branch contribution represent distinct aspects of gated feature fusion and should be interpreted separately.

</details>


### [1320] [Generative Quantum Machine Learning Methods for Cancer Detection using Augmented Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15110)
*Sophia Knutson,Nandika Goyal,Gennaro De Luca,Glen Uehara,Tanay Kamlesh Patel,Andreas Spanias*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本研究利用生成式量子机器学习（QML）方法，在乳腺超声图像数据集（BUSI）上生成合成图像，以扩充数据集，并与仅使用真实数据训练的卷积神经网络（CNN）进行比较，发现在完全使用合成数据训练的CNN中，AUC-ROC达到了80.2%，优于使用真实数据训练的模型（76.0%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 癌症图像数据集普遍存在样本量有限、类别不平衡（恶性样本少于良性样本）的问题，导致模型训练效果不佳。作者希望利用量子机器学习（QML）的优势，如高维特征表示和量子纠缠，来解决这些挑战。

Method: 研究提出了一种生成式QML方法，用于在压缩的乳腺超声图像数据集（BUSI）上生成合成图像。然后，使用真实图像、合成图像以及两者的组合来训练卷积神经网络（CNN）分类器，并测试其性能。

Result: 与仅使用真实数据训练的模型（AUC-ROC为76.0%）相比，完全使用合成图像训练的模型取得了更高的AUC-ROC值，达到80.2%。

Conclusion: 生成式QML方法在扩充有限且不平衡的癌症图像数据集方面显示出潜力，并且基于合成数据训练的分类器性能优于基于真实数据训练的分类器。

Abstract: Cancer detection using AI methods and image databases faces several challenges, including limited and imbalanced image datasets, long algorithm training times, and high-complexity feature generation. In particular, many cancer image datasets contain very few malignant examples compared to benign ones, limiting the amount of minority-class data available for training. Although classical AI and especially deep learning methods have had some success in providing cancer diagnostics, Quantum Machine Learning (QML) methods may offer advantages through high-dimensional feature representations, generative data augmentation, and the exploitation of feature correlations through quantum properties such as entanglement. In this paper, we propose using a generative QML method on the compressed breast ultrasound image dataset (BUSI) to generate synthetic images and hence augmented datasets for classifier training. In particular, we train a convolutional neural network with real, synthetic, and a combination of real and synthetic images. We test the algorithm on real images and provide comparative results for all three training cases. Our results show that the classifier trained entirely on synthetic images achieved an AUC-ROC of 0.802 (80.2%), compared with 0.760 (76.0%) for the real-data baseline.

</details>


### [1321] [Hybrid Context Forests and Bilateral Viterbi Matching for 3D Rib Centerline Tracing in CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16047)
*Quan Wang*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为 Ribline 的三阶段框架，用于自动从胸部 CT 图像中提取和编号肋骨中心线，解决了肋骨交汇、软骨钙化、脊柱后凸和肋骨可见性差等挑战，并在标准数据集上取得了优异的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 胸部 CT 图像中自动提取和编号所有 24 根肋骨的中心线对于肋骨可视化、骨折检测和手术导航至关重要，但由于肋骨交汇、软骨钙化、脊柱后凸和肋骨可见性差等原因，这项任务具有挑战性。

Method: Ribline 是一个三阶段框架：1) 建立一个以肺尖和脊柱中线为坐标系的框架，并利用感知后凸的方位角来排序每个肋骨上的点；2) 结合解剖学锚定的语义上下文森林 (SCF) 和轻量级 3D U-Net 进行混合体素检测；3) 通过概率骨架分解、双侧 Viterbi 动态规划分配肋骨索引，并利用模板恢复和法平面中心化 (RibSnake) 进行曲线优化。

Result: 在 Siemens Corporate Research 2 mm 胸部 CT 基准测试集上，Ribline 实现了 2.05 mm 的标签 Chamfer 距离，0.886 (3 mm) 和 0.945 (4 mm) 的标签 clDice，97.2% 的标签准确率（278/286 根肋骨），在评估集上零假阳性曲线。在 5 折交叉验证中，在所有 59 个标注扫描（1402 根肋骨）上，中位数为 2.39 mm，平均为 3.64 mm，标签准确率为 91.8%。

Conclusion: Ribline 框架能够有效地从胸部 CT 图像中自动提取和编号肋骨中心线，克服了现有方法的局限性，并在多个评估指标上取得了最先进的结果。

Abstract: Automatic extraction and anatomical numbering (R01-R12, L01-L12) of all 24 rib centerlines in thoracic CT is essential for unfolded rib visualization, fracture detection, and surgical navigation, but remains challenging due to adjacent-bone confluence, calcified costal cartilage bridges, kyphotic pose variation, and partial visibility of terminal ribs. We present ribline, an open-source three-stage framework combining: (1) an automatically detected lung-apex and vertebral-midline coordinate frame with a kyphosis-aware azimuthal angle for point ordering along each rib; (2) a hybrid voxel detector fusing an anatomically anchored Semantic Context Forest (SCF) with a lightweight 3D U-Net; and (3) a global stage that decomposes the probability skeleton into candidate curves, assigns rib indices via a bilateral Viterbi dynamic program coupled across both hemithoraces, and refines curves via template recovery and normal-plane centering (RibSnake). On the Siemens Corporate Research 2 mm thoracic CT benchmark (47 training and 12 evaluation scans), our pipeline achieves a labeled Chamfer distance of 2.05 mm, labeled clDice of 0.886 (3 mm) and 0.945 (4 mm), 97.2% labeling accuracy (278/286 ribs), and zero false-positive curves on the evaluation split, and 3.64 mm (median 2.39 mm) with 91.8% labeling accuracy across all 59 annotated scans (1,402 ribs) in 5-fold cross-validation.
  Code: https://github.com/wq2012/ribline
  Pretrained Models: https://huggingface.co/collections/wq2012/ribline

</details>


### [1322] [Uncertainty-Aware Cortical Surface Reconstruction and Spherical Registration for Heterogeneous Brain MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16595)
*Jesper Duemose Nielsen,Karthik Gopinath,Andrew Hoopes,Adrian Dalca,Axel Thielscher,Juan Eugenio Iglesias,Oula Puonti*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种仅使用合成MRI数据训练的神经网络，可用于几乎任何类型的MRI扫描，以估计大脑皮层表面，并提供不确定性估计和球形配准。该模型在标准T1w扫描上表现良好，并在低分辨率、非T1w扫描上优于现有方法，且推理速度快，可用于大规模临床MRI数据分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于深度学习的皮层表面分析方法主要针对高分辨率T1w扫描，限制了其在更广泛的MRI数据上的应用。研究者希望开发一种能够处理各种MRI扫描（包括低分辨率和非T1w）的通用模型，并提供皮层表面的不确定性估计以及配准到标准空间的功能。

Method: 开发了一个在合成MRI数据上训练的神经网络。该网络能够从几乎任何类型的MRI扫描中预测皮层表面，并提供每顶点的不确定性估计以及到fsaverage空间的球形配准。模型在合成数据上训练，以实现跨不同扫描类型的泛化能力。

Result: 该模型在1x1x1 mm3 T1w扫描上的性能与其他最先进的深度学习方法相当，并在低分辨率、非T1w扫描上优于其他方法。预测的不确定性与低分辨率扫描的整体质量相关，并能突出显示1x1x1 mm3 T1w扫描中表面重建较差的区域。预测的球形配准结果与其他方法相当。

Conclusion: 所提出的神经网络模型通用性强，能够处理各种MRI扫描，并提供有用的不确定性估计和配准功能。该模型有望实现对大规模临床MRI数据库的快速分析，从而发现以前难以检测的疾病相关模式。

Abstract: Surface-based cortical analysis is useful in many applications as it is a natural way to model the highly folded structure of the cerebral cortex, allowing quantities such as curvature and thickness to be easily calculated. Existing deep learning (DL) methods have focused on 1x1x1 mm3 T1-weighted (T1w) scans, thus replicating classical pipelines. Here we present a neural network that is trained exclusively on synthetic scans with random contrast and resolution. Consequently, it can be applied to almost any kind of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scan. In addition, our model provides vertex-wise uncertainty estimates of the predicted surface as well as a spherical registration to fsaverage space. Our model performs on par with other state-of-the-art DL methods on 1x1x1 mm3 T1w scans and outperforms the only other method capable of estimating cortical surfaces from low resolution, non-T1w scans. The predicted uncertainty, moreover, correlates with overall scan quality on low resolution scans and highlights areas of poor surface reconstruction on 1x1x1 mm3 T1w scans, suggesting that it can be used for quality control. Finally, the predicted spherical registrations prove comparable to other DL and classical registration methods. These qualities, when combined with the fast inference time, will provide the ability to analyze large, existing databases of clinical MRI scans, with the potential for finding disease-specific patterns that would otherwise be infeasible in a research setting.

</details>


### [1323] [Calibrating Generative Flows through Regional Probability Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16780)
*Yubo Huang,Xiongyu Hu,Xin Lai,Zixi Wang,Liao Jian,Jingzehua Xu,Chuan He*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为G-MPCF的通用质量守恒耦合流匹配方法，通过匹配概率质量来准确生成具有挑战性数据集（包括稀有事件）的样本，并在准确性和样本质量方面优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成模型在生成样本时，可能无法准确复现数据中不同区域（尤其是稀有事件）的出现频率，这会影响科学模拟和推断的准确性。

Method: 开发了通用质量守恒耦合流匹配（G-MPCF）方法，该方法将高斯源区域的概率质量匹配到加权数据区域的概率质量。这种匹配方式将期望的区域频率编码到噪声和观测值之间的对应关系中，从而在学习动力学的同时保持目标分布。

Result: 在稀有模式基准测试中，G-MPCF将相对得分误差和数值积分误差分别降低了95.0%和89.9%。在CIFAR-10数据集上，使用100:1的类别概率比时，G-MPCF将修正后的类别质量误差降低了44.6%，同时在相同的计算预算下提高了图像保真度。

Conclusion: 将区域概率校准纳入生成模型可以实现更可靠的科学模拟和推断，尤其是在稀有事件及其发生频率对理解基本机制至关重要的系统中。

Abstract: Generative models offer a powerful route to scientific simulation and discovery by enabling the study of complex populations and rare phenomena. Flow matching can generate realistic samples, yet inaccurate occurrence frequencies can distort population statistics and compromise inferences about rare events. Here we developed generalized mass-preserving coupled flow matching (G-MPCF), which matches the probability masses of Gaussian source regions to those of weighted data regions. This construction encodes the desired regional frequencies in the correspondence between noise and observations, shaping the learned dynamics while preserving the prescribed target distribution. On a rare-mode benchmark, G-MPCF reduces relative score error by 95.0% and numerical integration error by 89.9% compared with independent flow matching. On CIFAR-10 with a 100:1 class-probability ratio, it reduces corrected class-mass error by 44.6% compared with minibatch optimal transport, while improving mean image fidelity with matched computational budgets. We envision that incorporating regional probability calibration into generative modelling will support more reliable scientific simulation and inference, enabling the study of systems in which rare events and their occurrence frequencies are central to understanding the underlying mechanisms.

</details>


### [1324] [Background2Background: a self-supervised background removal framework for high dimensional microscopy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17615)
*Guangrui Ding,Haonan Lin,Rong Tang,Bethany Weinberg,Jianpeng Ao,Qing Xia,Guorong Hu,Dingcheng Sun,Jiaze Yin,Lei Tian,Ji-Xin Cheng*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为 Background2Background (B2B) 的自监督方法，通过打乱局部像素来将信号视为噪声，并利用 Noise2Noise 技术有效去除高维显微图像中的复杂背景，实现了超过 40 倍的背景抑制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维显微成像技术虽然能捕捉多维度信息，但复杂背景会严重干扰和隐藏微弱的信号。

Method: B2B框架通过局部像素打乱来破坏信号的相关性，同时保留背景结构。这种处理将信号转化为一种有效的噪声，然后利用基于 Noise2Noise 的方法进行背景移除。Noise2Noise 是一种在输入和输出中都包含噪声的情况下学习去噪模型的方法。

Result: B2B 在荧光成像、受激拉曼散射成像和中红外光热成像等多种成像模式中均取得了显著效果，实现了超过 40 倍的背景抑制，并成功揭示了原本被背景掩盖的信号。

Conclusion: B2B 是一种有效的自监督背景移除框架，适用于多种高维显微成像技术，能够显著提高图像质量并暴露隐藏的信号特征。

Abstract: High-dimensional microscopy captures features across space, time, and spectrum, but complex backgrounds obscure signals. We present Background2Background (B2B), a self-supervised background removal framework leveraging the backgrounds larger correlation relative to the signal. Local pixel shuffling disrupts signal correlations while preserving background structure, transforming signals into effective noise for Noise2Noise-based background removal. Across fluorescence, stimulated Raman scattering and mid-infrared photothermal imaging, B2B achieves over 40-fold background suppression and reveals hidden signatures.

</details>


### [1325] [Low-Altitude Agentic Networks: From UAV Connectivity to Workflow-Driven Capability Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17642)
*Baolin Chong,Fuhui Zhou,Qihui Wu,Ran Tu*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为“低空代理网络”的新型任务级网络范式，用于解决多无人机协同任务中的组织和动态适应问题。该范式将工作流逻辑与执行者身份分离，通过动态绑定操作到可行代理，并利用任务契约和结构化证据来管理任务执行，从而提高了在复杂和动态环境下的任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着低空平台（如无人机）的智能化水平提高，单个无人机的能力增强并不能解决多平台协同执行复杂任务时的组织难题。当任务依赖于分布在不同平台上的能力，并且网络、资源和移动性条件不断变化时，尤其需要一种能够动态适应和优化的组织方式。

Method: 作者提出了一种“低空代理网络”的任务级网络范式，并开发了一个参考架构。该架构将工作流逻辑与执行者身份分离，将每个可执行的操作转化为能力需求，并根据当前条件动态地将其绑定到合适的无人机代理。任务契约和结构化证据用于管理工作流执行，通过本地适应处理提供者和链路的变化，并在必要时进行高级修复。

Result: 通过基于案例研究的离散事件仿真，研究确定了该范式的一个边界工作区域。结果表明，在简单工作流和稳定条件下，传统的组织方式仍然有效；然而，当工作流依赖性紧密耦合、能力可行性在执行过程中发生变化，并且存在可行的本地恢复路径时，代理网络范式能够带来显著的优势。

Conclusion: 低空代理网络是一种有效的任务级网络范式，能够应对多无人机系统在动态和复杂的任务执行环境中遇到的组织和适应性挑战。该范式在特定条件下能够提高任务的鲁棒性和成功率，尤其是在工作流依赖性强、环境变化快且具备本地恢复能力的情况下。

Abstract: Low-altitude platforms are evolving from connected sensing nodes into autonomous agents capable of bounded task interpretation, skill invocation, and local decision making. Increasing the intelligence of individual unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), however, does not resolve the organization problem that arises when mission workflows depend on capabilities distributed across multiple platforms and provider feasibility changes with network, resource, and mobility conditions. We propose low-altitude agentic networking as a task-level networking paradigm and develop a reference architecture that separates workflow logic from executor identity. Within a validated domain-specific workflow space, each ready operation is translated into a capability requirement and dynamically bound to an agent that remains feasible under current conditions. Task contracts and structured evidence govern workflow execution, while routine provider and link changes are handled through workflow-preserving local adaptation before high-level repair is invoked. A trace-calibrated discrete-event case study identifies a bounded operating region: conventional organization remains effective for simple workflows under stable conditions, whereas agentic networking becomes beneficial when workflow dependencies are tightly coupled, capability feasibility changes during execution, and viable local recovery paths remain available.

</details>


### [1326] [Deficit-Driven Stratified Acquisition for Building STRATA-S12: An Open SAR-Optical Corpus for Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17680)
*Christian Sanchez-Leon,Dongming Chen,Dongqi Wang*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为“赤字驱动分层采集 (DDSA)”的算法，用于构建包含Sentinel-1（SAR）和Sentinel-2（光学）数据的联合配准地球观测语料库。该算法通过分层采集、严格的时间配对和多阶段质量控制，解决了现有数据集在数据覆盖和质量控制方面的不足。实验结果表明，DDSA算法能够更有效地填充数据层，并且在数据修复阶段能够以可接受的质量成本增加配对数量。最终发布的STRATA-S12语料库被证明适合用于自监督学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大多是多模态遥感数据集是通过机会性采集的，缺乏分层配额控制，并且容易受到地理区域云覆盖不均导致的数据缺失问题。这阻碍了构建高质量、可用于自监督学习的联合配准SAR-光学语料库。

Method: 提出了一种名为“赤字驱动分层采集 (DDSA)”的算法，将构建语料库视为一个约束最大覆盖问题。该算法在一个经过修正的（类别 x 季节 x 区域）分层模型上进行操作，强制执行严格的时间配对和多阶段质量门控，并通过一个包含人类干预的“赤字修复”阶段来完成采集过程。

Result: 1. DDSA算法能够从预算的初期就填充所有192个数据层，而传统的“丰富度优先”方法则在后期才填充大部分层。 2. 数据修复阶段可以弥补近39.5%的配对数据，且测量质量损失可忽略不计（89.8%通过人工审核）。 3. 几何失败（如无数据）的修复率（41.4%）高于云覆盖（18.8%），因为云覆盖具有季节性时间持续性。 4. 质量保证措施（如多阶段质量门控）导致了较高的采集尝试次数（2,928,370次）与最终发布的配对数量（740,746对）之间的比率。

Conclusion: DDSA算法是一种有效的策略，用于解决构建联合配准SAR-光学地球观测语料库时面临的采集和质量控制挑战。该算法能够实现更全面的数据覆盖，并通过一个有效的修复循环来提高配对数据量，同时保持较高的质量标准。发布的STRATA-S12语料库已被验证适合用于自监督学习任务。

Abstract: Building a co-registered SAR-optical corpus for self-supervised Earth Observation is above all an acquisition problem, yet the main multi-modal datasets are collected opportunistically, with no per-stratum quota control and no mechanism against the geographic dropout that non-uniform cloud cover leaves behind. We present Deficit-Driven Stratified Acquisition (DDSA), an algorithm that treats building a co-registered Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 corpus as a constrained maximum-coverage problem over a hemisphere-corrected (class x season x region) stratification, enforces strict temporal pairing and a multi-stage quality gate, and closes the loop during acquisition with a human-in-the-loop deficit-repair stage. Measured on its own product, the algorithm yields three results a single-pass acquisition cannot report. Deficit-driven ordering makes a partial run a covering one: it holds every one of the 192 strata populated from the first few percent of the budget, where an abundance-first order leaves most strata empty until the end. Whether a failed attempt can be recovered depends on the temporal persistence of its cause, not the kind of defect: geometric failures such as nodata are among the most repairable (eta = 41.4%) while cloud is among the least (eta = 18.8%), because a cloudy location is cloudy on most dates of its season. The repair loop supplies 39.5% of the released pairs at no measurable quality cost, with 89.8% surviving manual review. The quality guarantee has a price: 2,928,370 acquisition attempts produced 740,746 released pairs. We release the corpus, STRATA-S12, with STAC/PDS4-aligned FAIR sidecars, and a pre-registered linear-probe check confirms it is fit for self-supervised pre-training. A metadata-level coverage comparison against SSL4EO-S12 and SEN12MS situates the corpus over a shared frame; systematic cross-corpus and cross-method comparison is left to follow-up work.

</details>


### [1327] [Augmenting Real-time Visualization in Minimally Invasive Surgery with Particle Filtering and Depth-Aware Occlusion Handling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18422)
*Anuska Sarkar,Partha Acharya,Vishnu Nandury,Kaustav Basu,Subhamoy Mandal*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出了一种实时混合框架，用于微创手术（MIS）中的遮挡处理和深度感知跟踪，该框架结合了YOLO、粒子滤波和MiDaS，能够准确检测遮挡、预测深度并实时运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微创手术中，手术器械造成的遮挡会模糊兴趣区域（ROI），影响手术精度。因此，需要一种能够处理遮挡并提供深度信息的跟踪系统。

Method: 结合了增强版YOLO进行目标检测、粒子滤波（PF）进行跟踪，以及基于MiDaS的单目深度估计。通过计算器械与ROI之间的距离阈值来检测遮挡。

Result: 实现了0.85的置信度下鲁棒的器械检测，有效的遮挡事件处理，以及平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.34 cm、均方根误差（RMSE）为0.53 cm的准确深度预测。与立体深度测量相比，MAE为0.65 cm，RMSE为0.66 cm。遮挡检测准确率为81.95%，实时性能为38.7 FPS。

Conclusion: 该框架在处理MIS中的遮挡和提供深度信息方面表现出色，具有临床相关性，有望用于术中图像引导导航和决策支持。

Abstract: We present a real-time, hybrid framework for occlusion handling and depth-aware tracking in minimally invasive surgeries (MIS). Occlusions caused by surgical instruments often obscure the region of interest (ROI), affecting surgical precision. To address this, our approach integrates enhanced You Only Look Once (YOLO) based detection, Particle Filtering (PF), and monocular depth estimation using Multiple Depth Estimation Accuracy with Single Network (MiDaS). Occlusion is detected using a distance-based threshold between instruments and ROI. Experimental results demonstrate robust instrument detection with a confidence score of 0.85, effective occlusion event handling, and accurate depth prediction with an MAE of 0.34 cm and RMSE of 0.53 cm. Independent phantom-based validation against stereo depth measurements yielded an MAE of 0.65 cm and RMSE of 0.66 cm. The framework further achieved an occlusion detection accuracy of 81.95\% while maintaining real-time performance at 38.7 FPS. Preliminary surgeon feedback indicates that the proposed visualization framework is clinically relevant and holds promise for future intraoperative image-guided navigation and decision support in MIS.

</details>
